gist: Disclaimer: channel does not promote drugs, alcohol or intoxicants.
Disclaimer: content shared is for information and education only.
Disclaimer: committed to a positive, responsible environment and community guidelines.
Disclaimer: viewers asked to watch content with caution.
Greeting, welcome and thanks to the audience for joining.
Says he will first cover two or three housekeeping points and recalls the class from two weeks ago.

hindi: जिसमें यह शब्द कहा गया कि गुरुद्वारे में आप पैसे दे आए। तो पैसे देने के लिए जो भाषा उपयुक्त की गई वो यह कही गई मेरे द्वारा कि पैसों को लिटरली बस फेंक दिया जाए।
says: Recalls his earlier remedy: money offered at a gurudwara should be given in a detached way, literally 'thrown away' in the sense of letting go, not offered with expectation.
ambiguity: Planet is not named in this sentence; Jupiter is inferred from the later sentence about Jupiter improving. 'Throw' is figurative per his own clarification.
classical_check: Classical texts recommend dana to a guru or temple for Jupiter but do not say to throw money; the detachment idea fits the dana-without-ownership principle.

gist: Some viewers commented that throwing money insults the gurudwara.
He says that is their own thinking and moves on.

hindi: यदि पूरा देखेंगे ध्यान से वीडियो में ये कहा गया है कि धन को इस प्रकार से छोड़कर वहां आया जाए कि समझो छोड़ दिया फेंक ही दिया जैसे टिश्यू पेपर होता है ना भूल गए।
says: Clarifies the remedy: leave the money at the gurudwara so completely that you treat it as discarded, like a used tissue, and forget about it.
classical_check: Silent; no classical text gives this tissue-paper framing of dana.

hindi: हम धन दे के याद रखते हैं कि मैंने गुरुद्वारे में इतना पैसा दिया तो वो दिया नहीं। इसलिए वहां छोड़ आए खत्म कर दिया भूल गए
says: Principle: a gift you keep remembering and counting is not truly given; the remedy only works if you drop the account in your mind.
classical_check: Agrees in spirit with the Gita idea of giving without attachment to the fruit; not a Jyotish text rule.

hindi: जिस प्रकार मनुष्य को एक टिश्यू पेपर को यूज़ करके याद भी नहीं रखता इस प्रकार धन को गुरु घर में छोड़ देने से उस धन का सम्मान है
says: Says that leaving money at the guru's house in this forgetting manner is itself respect to that money, just as nobody remembers a tissue after using it.
ambiguity: The analogy is his own; the claim that this honours the money is a value statement, not a chart rule.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: और बुध वहां छोड़ने से आपका बृहस्पति इंप्रूव होगा
says: Claims that leaving the money there in this way improves your Jupiter (guru, wisdom, wealth karaka).
ambiguity: Caption word 'बुध' (Mercury) is almost certainly a mis-caption of 'बस' (just); Mercury is not intended. Only Jupiter is recorded.
classical_check: Classical Jupiter remedies include dana and guru service; a gurudwara donation fits loosely, the detachment condition is his addition.

hindi: अन्यथा आपको यह अहंकार आएगा कि आपने गुरु घर के अंदर बहुत सारा धन दिया और उसके द्वारा लोगों का भला किया
says: Warns that if you remember the donation you will develop pride that you gave a lot and helped people, which defeats the remedy.
ambiguity: He does not name a planet for the ego; ego is classically Sun, but he is talking in the Jupiter context.
classical_check: Silent in Jyotish texts; consistent with general dharma teaching against donor pride.

gist: If you understand the intent it is fine, otherwise he apologises.
Says this clarification matters because pointless controversy pushes knowledge aside and causes arguments.
Offers a full apology to those who took offence.
Second point: the classes so far are meant to give knowledge, including this astrology class.
If it were only knowledge he would open a chart and recite planets by house, but that is not the style here.
People booking appointments overload the website so much that it has to be closed.
Says there is pressure to raise the fee a lot, which he does not want to do.
A higher fee would make the rich richer and those who truly need help would not get through.
If someone feels they are paying too much, he returns the money with folded hands and blocks them.
Calls this his own swagger, since he will do it regardless.
When the website opens a whole month is booked in one day and 100 to 200 people stay on the waiting list.
Tells clients that the person they are talking to is blunt and quite different.
Do not expect any scholarly knowledge from the consultation.
He will just tell your fortune bluntly and finish the matter.
Many people complain that they cannot get an appointment or consultation.
Asks them to keep patience.

hindi: कौन सा ऐसा ग्रह है जो ऐसी स्थिति बना सकता है कि आप किसी भी अच्छे ज्योतिषी, किसी भी अच्छे ज्ञानी, विद्वान इत्यादि से आपका संपर्क जल्दी करा दे जो बहुत जल्दी से आपके कार्य करा दे।
says: Poses the question of which planet can bring you quickly into contact with a good astrologer or learned person who gets your work done fast; the answer given next is the Sun.
ambiguity: The planet is only named in the next sentence.
classical_check: Sun is karaka of authority, advisers and people of standing; contact with learned people is more usually Jupiter, so this emphasis is his own.

hindi: बहुत जल्दी से आपके राज दरबार संबंधित कार्यों में सफलता दे।
says: The same planet gives quick success in dealings with the state or royal court, meaning government and authority matters.
classical_check: Agrees: Sun is the classical karaka of government, rulers and authority.

hindi: आपके कोर्ट, कचहरी, मुकदमे, अटके हुए काम यह सारे के सारे सुलझा दे।
says: Says this planet resolves court cases, litigation and stuck pending work.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Sun rules authority and government offices; litigation is more commonly read from 6th house and Saturn or Mars, so the Sun-for-court claim is his emphasis.

hindi: यह वही ग्रह है सूर्य।
says: Names the answer to his question: the planet that gives quick access to good advisers, state success and case resolution is the Sun.
classical_check: See previous rows; Sun as authority karaka is classical.

gist: Announces that today's class is on the Sun.

hindi: देवों में सबसे बड़ा देव देवताओं का भी भगवान भगवान ही स्वरूप एक प्रकार से
says: Describes the Sun as the greatest of the gods, in a way the god of the gods and a form of the divine itself.
ambiguity: Caption repeats words; meaning is Sun as supreme deity.
classical_check: Agrees with Surya's status as the visible deity in Vedic and Puranic texts.

gist: Says they are studying this deity today and reached this class by his grace.
Repeats that the Sun is the biggest deity and is called Surya Dev.

hindi: हम जो धरती पर रहते हैं, वह धरती पर रहते हैं और जिंदा है तो सिर्फ इसलिए क्योंकि हमारे पास सूर्य है।
says: Claims we live on earth and are alive only because the Sun exists for us, so the Sun is the source of life.
classical_check: Agrees: Sun is atma karaka and giver of life force (prana) in classical texts.

hindi: इस सूरज सन सूर्य ग्रह की एक खासियत है। बिन मांगे देता है।
says: States the Sun's distinctive trait: it gives without being asked.
classical_check: Silent; a character trait he draws from the Sun's natural role.

hindi: अगर आपको अपना सूर्य नष्ट करना है यानी आपके जीवन में सूर्य का प्रभाव डेड तो फ्री की खूब गिफ्ट ले। आपका सूर्य नष्ट होता जाएगा।
says: Claims that accepting free gifts steadily destroys the Sun's influence in your life.
ambiguity: Whether this weakens the natal Sun or only the Sun's results in life is not stated.
classical_check: Silent; a behavioural rule of his own.

gist: Corrects a slip ('sorry, free ones') and repeats that taking free gifts will destroy the Sun.

hindi: इसलिए फ्री की गिफ्ट कभी मत लो। फ्री कुछ नहीं होता।
says: Gives the do-not: never accept free gifts, because nothing is truly free.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: Repeats that life exists by the Sun's grace.
Caption 'this is our taking' is garbled and unclear.
Voices an objection that Brahmins surely take things free.

hindi: ब्राह्मण तो भिक्षा में लेते हैं। फ्री कहां है? वो दान के बदले आशीर्वाद देते हैं।
says: Answers the objection: a Brahmin taking alms is not taking free, because he gives blessings in return for the donation.
classical_check: Agrees with the dana-for-ashirvad exchange in traditional dharma texts.

gist: Says free is not the issue here.

hindi: ब्राह्मण को देके तो मजा है। ब्राह्मण देवता ही शुक्र और बृहस्पति है। जब इनके क्लासेस होंगी तो वो भी आएगा।
says: Says giving to a Brahmin is rewarding, identifies the Brahmin deity with Venus and Jupiter, and defers detail to the Venus and Jupiter classes.
ambiguity: Unclear whether he means the Brahmin as a person or the Brahmin principle ruled by these planets.
classical_check: Agrees that Jupiter is the Brahmin and priest karaka; Venus as Brahmin ruler is the common caste view (Venus Brahmin in some texts, Jupiter in others).

hindi: तो ब्राह्मण भी फ्री नहीं ले रहा। वो हक से ले रहा है।
says: Concludes the Brahmin is not receiving free either; he receives as a rightful due.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: क्योंकि ब्राह्मण को देने मात्र से आप अपने नेगेटिव ग्रह को समर्पित कर रहे हैं।
says: Claims that simply giving to a Brahmin offers up your negative planets, which is why it works as a remedy.
ambiguity: No specific planet; it applies to any afflicted planet.
classical_check: Agrees with the classical dana remedy for malefic planets.

hindi: जैसे मान ले आप सूर्य अग्नि में आप कुछ भी डाल देते हैं तो अग्नि नष्ट नहीं होती। वह चीज शुद्ध हो जाती है। उसका स्वरूप बदल जाता है।
says: Uses the Sun as fire: whatever you drop into fire does not destroy the fire, the thing is purified and changes form; he uses this to explain how the receiver absorbs a donated burden.
ambiguity: Sun and fire are treated as one here.
classical_check: Agrees with the Sun-agni equation and the homa idea of offering into fire.

hindi: अग्नि के बनाए बिना कुछ भी नहीं बनता। ग्लास भी नहीं बनता। इस्पात नहीं बनता। यह अग्नि है जो स्वरूप बदलने में मदद करती है।
says: Fire is the agent of transformation: nothing, not even glass or steel, is made without it, so the Sun-fire principle governs change of form.
classical_check: Silent; Sun/fire as transformer is his extension of the classical agni nature of the Sun.

hindi: और जो ब्राह्मण है वो देवता के लिए पूजा अग्नि भी करती है।
says: The Brahmin performs fire worship for the deity, meaning ritual fire is part of the Brahmin's work.
ambiguity: Caption has a mixed gender verb and is slightly garbled.
classical_check: Agrees: Brahmins conduct yajna and agnihotra.

hindi: क्षत्रिय भी करता है।
says: Adds that the Kshatriya also performs this fire worship, linking fire to the warrior-ruler class as well.
ambiguity: Short fragment; assumed to continue the fire-worship point.
classical_check: Agrees that Kshatriyas performed Vedic sacrifices; Sun is the Kshatriya planet in classical varna assignment.

hindi: यानी आपके दिए हुए दान को पी जाने की ताकत ब्राह्मण में है।
says: The Brahmin has the capacity to absorb, literally drink up, the donation you give, taking the associated negativity along with it.
classical_check: Silent; the idea that the recipient absorbs the donor's dosha appears in folk tradition and some dana texts.

hindi: क्योंकि किसी को तो दोष भोगना है। फ्री में तो कुछ नहीं है।
says: Because someone has to bear the dosha, there is no free transfer; the receiver bears the fault that the donor offloads.
classical_check: Silent in Jyotish; consistent with the dana-pratigraha dosha idea in dharma literature.

hindi: अक्सर देखा होगा ब्राह्मण लोग दान लेते हैं और बेचारे कंगाल और भिखारी रहते हैं। उनको वो उतारना नहीं आता।
says: Observes that Brahmins who accept donations often stay poor because they do not know how to discharge the burden they absorb.
ambiguity: Jupiter is implied by the next sentence about the Jupiter class.
classical_check: Silent; an observational claim of his, not a text rule.

gist: Asks why the priest helps others but not himself and defers the answer to the Jupiter class.
Says he has no cheat notes for that topic right now.
Joke begins: a student prepared notes for a chemistry exam and turned up.
Joke dialogue: the student insists he prepared biology and will write biology paper instead of chemistry.
Punchline: he will give chemistry on biology day; the point is the work must get done.

hindi: दोष मुक्ति के लिए सिर्फ ब्राह्मण ही उपयुक्त है।
says: Says that for getting rid of a dosha the only suitable recipient of your donation is a Brahmin.
ambiguity: Whether Brahmin means birth caste or a qualified priest is not stated.
classical_check: Classical dana texts do name Brahmins as the proper recipients; silent on exclusivity.

gist: Remark about the colour on his slide being copied and pasted.
Jokes that a bit of style is needed on the slide.
Jokes that the slide looks like the Sun itself is speaking, too bright and hot, making you sweat.

hindi: तो यह हमारे सौर मंडल में हमारे पास जीवन जीने की शक्ति जीवन देने की ताकत सूर्य के पास है।
says: In our solar system the power to sustain and give life rests with the Sun.
classical_check: Agrees: Sun is jiva/prana karaka.

hindi: इसलिए इसे परमपिता कहते हैं। पिता नहीं परमपिता
says: Because of this life-giving role the Sun is called Parampita, the supreme father, and not merely father.
classical_check: Agrees that Sun is pitri karaka (father); the 'supreme father' framing is his own.

hindi: हमारे शरीर के अंदर विभिन्न चक्र बने हुए हैं।
says: Starts a body-map explanation: the human body contains several chakras, which he will link to planets.
classical_check: Chakras come from yoga and tantra, not from Parashari Jyotish.

hindi: और विभिन्न चक्रों के अंतर्गत जो कुंडलिनी है ये कुंडलिनी जब मूव करती है तो इस कुंडलिनी का मूवमेंट मूलाधार से गोल-गोल गोल घूम करके थर्ड आई पे खत्म हो जाता है।
says: Describes kundalini rising in a spiral from the root chakra (muladhara) and finishing at the third eye.
ambiguity: Standard yoga texts end the climb at sahasrara, he places the end of the spiral at the third eye and then speaks of sahasrara later.
classical_check: Differs from tantra, where kundalini ends at the crown; not a Jyotish text matter.

hindi: तीसरे नेत्र के ऊपर यह हमारा भूमि है, जल है, अग्नि है, वायु है और यह गगन तत्व।
says: Lists the five elements in order, earth, water, fire, air and space, as the layers of the chakra ladder.
ambiguity: The caption says 'above the third eye' but he means the elements run up to the third eye; the order below is the standard yogic one.
classical_check: Agrees with the standard pancha mahabhuta sequence of the lower five chakras.

hindi: यह पंचभूत तत्वों के ठीक पश्चात ऊपर हमारे नेत्रों के तीसरा बीच में केंद्र में शिव का तीसरा नेत्र कहा जाता है।
says: Just beyond the five elements, at the centre between the eyes, sits what is called Shiva's third eye.
classical_check: Agrees with the ajna chakra placement.

hindi: यह सूर्य और चंद्रमा का स्थान है।
says: Says the third eye is the seat of the Sun and the Moon in the body.
classical_check: Ajna is associated with the two luminaries in some yogic systems, not in Parashari texts.

hindi: ये हमें सहस्त्रार के ठीक नीचे मिलता है। तीसरा नेत्र।
says: The third eye is found just below the crown chakra (sahasrara).
classical_check: Agrees with chakra order, ajna below sahasrara.

hindi: ये क्या है? यहां से हमारी कॉन्शियसनेस आती है और अलग-अलग चक्रों पे हिट करती है।
says: Says our consciousness descends from this point and strikes the different chakras one after another.
classical_check: Not a Jyotish claim.

hindi: यह हमारा थर्ड आई है जो फिल्टर करता है। सही गलत का फैसला।
says: The third eye acts as a filter and the faculty that decides right from wrong.
classical_check: Consistent with ajna as the centre of discernment in yoga.

hindi: यहां पर हमारे शरीर के अंदर सूर्य प्लेस्ड है। थर्ड आई पर सूर्य इसकी प्लेसमेंट है।
says: Places the Sun in the body at the third eye.
ambiguity: Which side he calls the Sun's is implied by saying the Moon is on the left.
classical_check: Silent in Parashari texts; comes from yogic body-mapping.

hindi: और इसकी लेफ्ट साइड पर चंद्रमा की प्लेसमेंट है।
says: The Moon is placed on the left side of the third eye region.
classical_check: Fits the ida (left, lunar) and pingala (right, solar) nadi idea of yoga.

hindi: सूर्य क्या है? एनर्जी बॉडी। और चंद्रमा क्या है? कॉजलल बॉडी। कारण शरीर कि भाई क्यों पैदा हुए हो?
says: Calls the Sun the energy body and the Moon the causal body, the body that answers why you were born.
ambiguity: Assigning karana sharira to the Moon is his own mapping.
classical_check: Differs from the usual view where Moon is mind (manas) and Sun is atma; karana sharira for the Moon is not found in Parashara.

hindi: तो सूर्य क्या है? सन हमारी सोल है जिसमें हमारा मन भी सम्मिलित है तब हम जन्म लेते हैं।
says: Says the Sun is our soul and it includes the mind too; we take birth with this.
ambiguity: Contradicts the usual rule that mind belongs to the Moon; in the previous row he gives the Moon the causal body.
classical_check: Sun as atma agrees with classical texts; folding the mind into the Sun differs from Moon as manas karaka.

hindi: यानी जन्म लेने के लिए सूर्य चाहिए।
says: Birth itself requires the Sun, so the Sun is the pre-condition for life in a body.
classical_check: Agrees that Sun is atma and life-force karaka.

hindi: सूर्य अगर है तो हमारा शरीर धमक रहा है।
says: If the Sun is strong in a person, the body glows and has a vibrant presence.
ambiguity: No placement or strength criterion is given for what counts as the Sun being present.
classical_check: Agrees in general: strong Sun gives vitality and a commanding body.

gist: People often ask how to strengthen their aura.

hindi: ओरा क्या है? ओरा है ही सूर्य।
says: Defines the aura as simply the Sun in you, so aura strength equals Sun strength.
classical_check: Silent; aura is not a classical Jyotish concept, but Sun as tejas is.

hindi: आपका सूर्य डाउन है। आपकी ओरा डाउन है।
says: If your Sun is down, your aura is down too, the two move together.
ambiguity: 'Down' is not defined as debilitated, afflicted or weak; it is used loosely.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: आप बुझे बुझे और टूटे हुए आपका सूर्य खत्म है। सूर्य खत्म है। मनोबल खत्म है। जीवन ऊर्जा खत्म है।
says: A person who looks dull and broken has a finished Sun, meaning lost morale and lost life energy.
ambiguity: 'Finished' is rhetorical, not a technical state.
classical_check: Agrees in direction: weak Sun gives low confidence and vitality.

hindi: मृत्यु की ओर पास बहुत ज्यादा जल्दी आप जाएंगे। बीमारियां घेर लेंगी।
says: Claims a very weak Sun brings an earlier approach to death and surrounds you with illnesses. Flagged: this is a death and health statement, to be recorded only and not used for prediction.
ambiguity: No threshold for how weak the Sun must be.
classical_check: Weak Sun giving poor health is classical; a death claim has no stated rule here.

hindi: आपने देखा है कहा गया है कि सूरज रहते-रहते खाना खा लो। सारे माइक्रोब्स खत्म हो जाते हैं। और सूरज के जाने के पश्चात माइक्रोब्स आते हैं।
says: Advises eating before sunset because he says sunlight kills microbes and they return after the Sun leaves.
ambiguity: A hygiene or health claim, not a chart rule.
classical_check: Silent in Jyotish; common Ayurveda and Jain advice.

hindi: जैन धर्म में विशेष कहा गया है कि सूर्य के रहते ही भोजन करो। बाद में मत करो। क्योंकि माइक्रोब्स आएंगे।
says: Cites Jain practice: take food only while the Sun is up and not afterwards, because of microbes.
classical_check: Agrees with the Jain rule of not eating after sunset (ratri-bhojan tyaga).

gist: Caption says these microbes cannot dissolve in your body; meaning is unclear.

hindi: इसलिए कहते हैं अरे पुरानी रजाई को धूप लगा दो। पुराने कपड़ों को धूप लगा दो। धूप लगा दो।

hindi: यानी आपका सूर्य इतना महत्वपूर्ण है कि विटामिन डी मात्र एक रीडिंग है जो बता रही है कि सूर्य डाउन है।
says: The Sun matters so much that a vitamin D lab value is only a reading that shows the Sun is down.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: इसलिए विटामिन डी को संभालना बहुत जरूरी।
says: Therefore looking after your vitamin D levels is very important.
ambiguity: A health recommendation rather than a chart rule; no supplement or dose is stated.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: Asks how to set vitamin D while sitting at home since the body does not go in the sun.

hindi: उसके लिए आपको अपनी मानसिकता में सूर्य ठीक करना है।
says: The fix when you cannot get sunlight is to repair the Sun in your mindset.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: मानसिकता सूर्य कहां है? सूर्य यहां बैठा है अभी तीसरे नेत्र पे जब आपका मुंह लटका हुआ है सूर्य डाउन है।
says: The mental Sun sits at the third eye, and when your face is hanging low, the Sun is down.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: जब आप कह रहे हो वाह! आनंद है, सूर्य सेट है।
says: When you are saying 'wow, I am in bliss', your Sun is set, meaning in good order.
ambiguity: 'Set' means arranged or adjusted, not the Sun setting.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: अब सूर्य सेट करने के लिए क्या करें? स्माइल।
says: Remedy to set the Sun right: smile.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: आपके जीवन में क्या करते हैं आप? गले से ऊपर उठते हैं।
says: Says that with a smile you rise above the throat level, out of the lower chakras.
ambiguity: Caption is choppy; the intended link is to the earlier throat and lower-chakra discussion.
classical_check: Not Jyotish.

hindi: आप जब स्माइल करते हैं कि सुबह उठ के क्या करना चाहिए जी? स्माइल।
says: Do on waking: the first thing in the morning should be a smile.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: आप मात्र स्माइल करें शरीर का ड्रामा ही करें। आप इस चक्कर से ऊपर उठ जाएंगे उस क्षण के लिए कॉन्शियसनेस।
says: Even a faked smile as pure body acting lifts you out of the lower cycle, at least for that moment, into higher consciousness.
ambiguity: The sentence runs into the next chunk.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: कॉन्शियसनेस का पोर्टल जो एक ओंकार है वो आपका सूर्य है।
says: The gateway to consciousness, the Ek Onkar, is your Sun.
classical_check: Silent; spiritual mapping of Sun to the One.

hindi: यानी निराकार सूर्य का अपना क्या है? कुछ नहीं स्थिर है। स्टेबल रहता है। कहीं नहीं जाता कहीं नहीं आता।
says: Describes the Sun's inner nature as formless and fixed: it owns nothing, stays stable and neither goes nor comes.
ambiguity: He means the Sun is stationary within the solar system's frame.
classical_check: Agrees with Sun as sthira (fixed) in character.

hindi: पूरे सोलर सिस्टम को घसीट रहा है। रोशनी ही फेंकता है।
says: The Sun drags the whole solar system along and only throws out light.
classical_check: Agrees with the Sun as king and center.

hindi: सूर्य शब्द से धर्म बना है।
says: Claims the word dharma comes from the Sun, so the Sun is the root of dharma.
ambiguity: Etymology claim.
classical_check: Differs: dharma comes from the Sanskrit root dhri (to hold), not from surya; Sun as karaka of dharma is classical though.

hindi: आप जो काम करते हैं ना रेगुलर भाई 7:00 बजे बोतल खुलेगी। आपका धर्म है। नहीं भैया मैं तो सुबह उठते ही मंदिर जाऊंगा। धर्म है यानी आपका नियम।
says: Gives examples, a daily 7 pm drink or a morning temple visit, to show dharma means your own regular discipline, whatever it is.
ambiguity: He uses a joking example; it is not an endorsement of drinking.
classical_check: Differs from the classical normative meaning of dharma as righteous duty.

hindi: आपके जीवन में जो भी स्टेबिलिटी और नियम है वह धर्म है।
says: Whatever steadiness and rule you hold in your life is your dharma.
classical_check: Differs in emphasis from the classical meaning.

hindi: सूर्य का धर्म क्या है? सूर्य शब्द से धर्म बना है। धर्मात्मा बनाता है सूर्य।
says: The Sun is what produces a dharmatma, a person of firm righteous character.
ambiguity: The first part repeats the etymology claim.
classical_check: Agrees that Sun is karaka of dharma, righteousness and soul quality.

hindi: आपका धर्म क्या है? आपका धर्म है। भैया हम तो चोरी करेंगे। वो तुम्हारा धर्म है।
says: Even a thief following his own fixed habit is following his dharma in this definition, since dharma is simply your consistent rule.
ambiguity: Provocative example; his definition is descriptive, not approving.
classical_check: Differs from classical dharma which excludes adharma such as theft.

hindi: दुर्योधन का धर्म क्या था? साम दाम दंड भेद। मैं तो राजा बनूंगा। धर्म है।
says: Duryodhana's own dharma was to become king by any means, so it also counts as dharma in his sense of firm personal rule.
classical_check: Differs from the Mahabharata verdict, which calls Duryodhana's path adharma.

hindi: इसलिए धर्म की परिभाषा क्या है? सबका अपना-अपना धर्म। लाखों किस्म के लोग, लाखों किस्म के डीएनए, लाखों किस्म की बुद्धि, लाखों धर्म।
says: Concludes that dharma is individual: millions of types of people, DNA and minds give millions of dharmas.
classical_check: Agrees partly with svadharma, one's own duty.

hindi: तो एक धर्म क्या है? सनातन धर्म। यानी सब धर्मों को मैं एक्सेप्ट करता हूं। सनातन ऑल इंक्लूसिव यह सूर्य है।
says: The one dharma is Sanatan, which accepts all dharmas; this all-inclusive principle is the Sun.
classical_check: Silent; spiritual mapping of Sun to Sanatan.

hindi: सूर्य यह नहीं कहता ओ वहां गर्मी हो रही है। मैं कम कर दूं? नो। सूर्य ने सिर्फ अग्नि देनी है।
says: The Sun never reduces its heat to suit anyone; its only job is to give fire, which is the model of unchanging character.
ambiguity: The sentence crosses the chunk boundary.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: आपके जीवन में आपका चरित्र है भैया मैं सपाट ऐसे ही चलूंगा। औरों के लिए नहीं बदलूंगा।
says: A Sun-like character says 'I walk straight as I am and will not change for others'.
classical_check: Agrees with the fixed, self-willed Sun nature.

hindi: ना आपकी हड्डियां जाएंगी, ना दांत जाएंगे, ना आपकी आंत खराब होगी, आपकी आंखों की रोशनी भी रहेगी।
says: With such a firm Sun-like character the bones, teeth, gut and eyesight stay in order. Flagged: health claim, recorded only.
classical_check: Agrees that Sun governs bones and eyes; teeth and gut are not classically Sun.

hindi: आप ऐ ड्रामेबाज बनते। आप बड़े सख्त जान होते हो। ऐसे लोग बड़े पक्के रहते हैं।
says: People with a strong Sun are tough and firm, not drama-makers.
ambiguity: The caption sentence is rough; the sense is a contrast between drama and firmness.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: जो बड़े पक्के रहते हैं उनका शरीर भी ठीक चलता है। यानी शरीर बता रहा है आपका सूर्य कैसा है?
says: Firm people keep a body that works well, so the condition of the body is a mirror of how your Sun is.
classical_check: Agrees in spirit that Sun stands for vitality.

hindi: आपके स्वभाव में आपका कोई दीन ईमान नहीं है। कोई सिर पैर नहीं है।
says: A person with no principles or consistency in their nature shows a weak Sun.
ambiguity: The weak-Sun conclusion is implied by contrast with the earlier sentences.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: Voices an imagined objection about melting at the sight of a poor man's heart and asks why.

hindi: आपको धर्म जानना है कि तुझे धर्म अनुसार आपके कर्मों की सजा मिली है।
says: To know your dharma you must see that you are receiving the consequence of your own karma according to dharma.
ambiguity: Caption is choppy.
classical_check: Agrees with the doctrine of karma-phala.

hindi: यह कहा जाता है कि ईश्वर कण-कण में विद्यमान है। बिना उसकी इच्छा के एक पत्ता भी नहीं हिल सकता।
says: Cites the standard teaching that God is in every particle and not even a leaf moves without his will.
classical_check: A popular saying; not a Jyotish rule.

hindi: तो यह सोच के बताओ हमने कौन से पाप किए? जब उसकी इच्छा के बिना पत्ता नहीं हिल सकता तो हम किस खेत की मूली है जो पाप कर ले?
says: Argues from that premise that we cannot be the doers of sin either, since nothing happens without God's will.
ambiguity: This fatalist position conflicts with the karma-phala claim made a sentence earlier.
classical_check: Conflicts with the doctrine of free agency in karma.

hindi: हम किस खेत की मूली है जो पुण्य कर लें? हम किस खेत की मूली है कि दान कर लें? ये हमारी मूर्खता है।
says: By the same reasoning we cannot claim to do merit or charity either, and believing we do is foolishness, which links back to giving without remembering.
classical_check: Matches the Gita non-doership view.

hindi: जो व्यक्ति ये जान गया वो साक्षी भाव में चला गया।
says: A person who realises this enters the witness state, observing without claiming to be the doer.
classical_check: Sakshi bhava is a Vedantic idea.

hindi: सूर्य हमें साक्षी भाव देता है।
says: The Sun is the planet that gives us the witness attitude.
ambiguity: The sentence continues into the next chunk.
classical_check: Agrees in spirit with Sun as atma karaka.

hindi: साक्षी भाव हो जाने मात्र से हमारा मुन्ना दाता बन जाता है। अंधा देता है।
says: Once the witness attitude arrives the person becomes a giver, and gives without looking, like a blind man.
ambiguity: 'Munna' (child) and 'blind gives' are garbled; likely 'mind' and giving without discrimination.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: जिस व्यक्ति के जीवन में राजा के समान चीजें प्राप्त होती हैं यार कमी कोई नहीं है। हर जगह जाओ मजे में होता है। उसका सूर्य बलवान है।
says: A person who gets king-like comforts, lacks nothing and is comfortable everywhere has a strong Sun.
ambiguity: No chart criterion is given for 'strong'.
classical_check: Agrees: strong Sun gives royal status and ease.

hindi: उसने अपने कर्मों के द्वारा जान लेना है कि मेरे सूर्य में कितनी ताकत है।
says: You should judge the strength of your own Sun from the results of your actions in life.
classical_check: Silent; an outcome-based test, not a chart test.

hindi: वो प्रमोशन की भीख नहीं मांगता। वो चीज मांगता ही नहीं। पहले प्रकट हो जाती है। यानी उसका सूर्य बहुत बलवान है।
says: A man whose promotions come without begging, before he asks, has a very strong Sun.
classical_check: Agrees in effect: strong Sun gives career recognition.

hindi: उसकी कुंडली में सूर्य इस प्रकार से प्लेस्ड है कि उसको ज्ञान है।
says: In such a person's chart the Sun is placed in a way that gives him knowledge, though the exact placement is not named.
ambiguity: No house or sign given for this placement.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: सूर्य हमारी क्या है? आत्मा। हम जिंदा कैसे हैं? इस सूर्य की वजह से सौरमंडल जिंदा है।
says: The Sun is the soul, and just as the solar system lives because of the Sun, we live because of the soul.
classical_check: Agrees: Sun is atma karaka.

gist: Says the Sun will end in about 6.5 billion years.
Without the Sun the earth would not be held by gravity and would roll away and perish.

hindi: तो सूर्य क्या कर रहा है? सूर्य ने बांधा हुआ है। तो हम बंधे हुए हैं एक शरीर में।
says: The Sun binds the planets in orbit and in the same way the soul binds us into one body.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: जैसे ही मृत्यु होती है, शरीर सड़ने लगता है, बदबू आती है, कहते हैं भैया फेंक दो, बीमार पड़ जाएंगे।
says: At death the body begins to rot and people want it removed, which he uses to show that the soul, the Sun, was what held the body together. Flagged: mortality talk, no prediction.
ambiguity: The sentence crosses the chunk boundary.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: लोग लाश है। यानी अंदर से निकला क्या है? आत्मा।
says: What leaves the body at death, leaving a corpse, is the atma.
classical_check: Agrees with the Vedantic soul concept.

hindi: आत्मा का परिवेश माना जाता है। कोई चीज निकलती है। कोई कहता है आत्मावात्मा कुछ नहीं होती। पर कुछ तो निकलता है।
says: Answers the sceptic who denies the soul: even if you reject the word, something certainly leaves the body.
classical_check: Not Jyotish.

hindi: हम आत्मा कह रहे हैं। वो वो क्या है? वो है सूर्य।
says: What we call the atma is the Sun.
classical_check: Agrees: Sun is atma karaka.

hindi: अगर आप में जान है और आप अपने शरीर को मन को तन को चला रहे हैं। हारते नहीं। स्थिर बुद्धि रहते हैं वो सूर्य।
says: If you have vitality and steer body and mind without giving up and with a steady intellect, that steadiness is the Sun in you.
classical_check: Silent; sthira buddhi is Gita language.

hindi: सूर्य स्थिरता से चलता है वो कोई नहीं देखता सही क्या गलत क्या अच्छा क्या बुरा क्या है
says: The Sun moves steadily and does not judge what is right or wrong, good or bad.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: इसलिए शब्द कहा जाता है आत्मज्ञानी आत्मा का ज्ञान करने वाला अच्छे बुरे सही गलत से परे हो जाता है
says: The self-realised person, the atmajnani, goes beyond good and bad and right and wrong, like the Sun.
classical_check: Agrees with the Vedantic atmajnani ideal.

hindi: यहां पर दोनों कुंडलिनी के वेव्स इदा और पिंगला सिंगुलरिटी में आ जाते है यानी आप ना अच्छा मानते किसी बात का ना बुरा मानते क्या हो जाता है यू अंडरस्टैंड
says: At the third eye both kundalini currents, ida (Moon) and pingala (Sun), merge into singularity, so you neither take anything as good nor as bad.
ambiguity: He does not name Sun and Moon here; ida and pingala are mapped by me from his earlier placement of Moon on the left.
classical_check: Ida lunar and pingala solar is standard in yoga texts.

hindi: यूजलेसनेस व्यर्थता लीला है संसार कुछ नहीं और शिव अघोरी भस्म लपेटे मस्ती में रहते हैं बस वही है वो है तो हम जिंदा
says: Calls worldly life uselessness and play (leela), like Aghori Shiva smeared with ash living in bliss, and says that one principle keeps us alive.
ambiguity: The closing words are garbled; 'that is the Sun' is probably implied.
classical_check: Not Jyotish.

hindi: मर गए तो निकला क्या अंदर से? आत्मा। यानी आत्मा हमारी सूर्य है।
says: When we die what leaves is the atma, so the atma is our Sun.
ambiguity: Repeats the earlier definition but states the equation outright.
classical_check: Agrees with Sun as atma karaka.

hindi: यह हमारी आत्मा कहां से कार्य कर रही है? ये यहां से आती है।
says: Says the soul works from the point he indicates, the third eye region, where he places the Sun.
ambiguity: He points at the body; the location is inferred from earlier rows.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: Trailing fragment 'in anger' that continues into the next batch.

hindi: हम क्या करते हैं? माथा पीटते हैं। पसीना आता है माथे पे।
says: Continuing the anger example: in anger people slap their forehead and sweat appears on the forehead, the place where he put the Sun.
ambiguity: The opening words 'in anger' sit at the end of the previous batch.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: यहां क्यों नहीं आता पसीना? यहां अलग आता है। यहां सबसे पहले आता है।
says: Sweat shows first at the forehead and differently from elsewhere, because the Sun's seat at the third eye reacts first to anger.
ambiguity: He points to the forehead; the Sun link is inferred from the earlier placement.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: सूर्य गर्म हो जाता है। भकने लगता है हमारा। और सूर्य को नष्ट करने की स्थिति बन जाती है।
says: In anger the inner Sun overheats and flares, which sets up the conditions for destroying your Sun.
ambiguity: 'Bhakne' is slang for flaring up.
classical_check: Silent; anger as a Sun and Mars quality is traditional.

hindi: क्रोध में आत्मा रहती कहां है? आत्मा लिवर में रहती है।
says: Says the soul resides in the liver.
ambiguity: This conflicts with his earlier statement that the soul works from the third eye and in other places it is tied to the heart.
classical_check: Differs: Vedic texts place the atma in the heart (hridaya); liver is Jupiter's organ in Jyotish.

hindi: हमारे सनातन में मृत्यु पश्चात व्यक्ति को जलाते हैं। जलाने के पश्चात उसके लीवर का एक टुकड़ा आत्माराम नाम का उसको हाथ में लेकर उसका तर्पण किया जाता है कि ये लीवर का टुकड़ा है।
says: Describes a cremation custom in which a piece of the liver, called Atmaram, is taken in hand for the water offering after the body is burnt.
ambiguity: Ritual detail is his own account; death ritual, not a prediction.
classical_check: Not found in Garuda Purana or common rites as described; silent or unverified.

hindi: बचा हुआ आत्माराम इसको हमने पितरों को समर्पित किया।
says: The remaining Atmaram piece is dedicated to the ancestors with the line 'we offered this to the pitri'.
classical_check: Silent; offering to pitris is a standard rite, the liver part is not documented here.

hindi: यानी तीनों लोक का स्वामी सूर्य जो है वो आत्मा उसकी जो हमारा ऑपरेट करती है वो लिवर से करती है।
says: The Sun is lord of the three worlds and its soul-power runs our body through the liver.
classical_check: Silent; liver is classically Jupiter, not Sun.

hindi: लिवर का देवता कौन है? बृहस्पति।
says: The ruling deity, meaning karaka, of the liver is Jupiter.
classical_check: Agrees: Jupiter is the classical karaka of the liver.

hindi: बृहस्पति देव क्या करते हैं? वो गुरु है।
says: Jupiter's role is that of the guru, the teacher.
classical_check: Agrees: Jupiter is guru karaka.

hindi: सूर्य है एक ओंकार निराकार। कुछ नहीं कहता कुछ नहीं करता। कुछ नहीं करूंगा।
says: The Sun is the formless Ek Onkar that neither says nor does anything and simply is.
classical_check: Silent; spiritual mapping of Sun to the formless.

hindi: वास्तु की कक्षा यदि आप देखें उसमें 12 आदित्य 11 रुद्र आठ वशु ये 33 कोटि दो प्रजापति और ब्रह्मा होते हैं।
says: Recalls from the Vastu class that 12 Adityas, 11 Rudras and 8 Vasus plus two more make the 33 types of deities, with Prajapati and Brahma also in the picture.
ambiguity: The remaining 2 are taken here as Prajapati and one other; classical lists name the two Ashwini Kumaras or Indra and Prajapati.
classical_check: Agrees on 12 + 11 + 8 + 2 = 33; the identity of the last two differs between texts.

gist: Says these are the deities, closing the list of 33 types from the previous part.

hindi: ये देवताओं के अंदर भी 12 ही 12 क्यों? 12 महीने 360 डिग्री का पूरा का पूरा कॉसमोस जहां ये घूम रहा है 12 राशियां मेष वृष मिथुन कर्क इत्यादि
says: Explains why the number 12 recurs: the year has 12 months and the 360 degree cosmos is divided into 12 zodiac signs, Aries, Taurus, Gemini, Cancer and so on.
classical_check: Agrees: 12 signs of 30 degrees each make the 360 degree zodiac.

hindi: इन राशियों में 12 खाने हैं कुंडली के 12 खानों के अंदर ये गोल-गोल घूम रहे हैं 12 ही ग्रह
says: The signs give twelve boxes in the horoscope, and twelve planets circulate through those twelve boxes, so his scheme has 12 planets for 12 houses and signs.
ambiguity: '12 planets' is his own count including Uranus, Neptune and Pluto and the two nodes.
classical_check: Differs: Parashari Jyotish uses 9 grahas; the 12-planet scheme is his own extension.

hindi: सूर्य ने 12 टुकड़ों में संसार को सेटिंग करके रखी हुई है
says: The Sun has arranged the world in twelve pieces or divisions.
classical_check: Silent; consistent with the Sun traversing the twelve signs yearly.

hindi: हमारे ये 12 टुकड़े जो हैं ये हमारे जीवन में 12 ज्योतिर्लिंग 12 आदित्य 12 121 के साइकिल पे चलते हैं।
says: These twelve divisions show up in our life as the twelve jyotirlingas and twelve Adityas, running in cycles of twelve.
ambiguity: '12 121' is garbled in the caption and may be twelve-times-twelve.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: आप मजे की बात देख के चलेंगे। यूरेनस, नेप्च्यून, प्लूटो जो यह गोला गोला करके घूमते हैं। यह भी सूर्य की वजह से ही घूमते हैं।
says: Even the far planets Uranus, Neptune and Pluto circle only because of the Sun.
classical_check: Agrees with astronomy; the three are outside Parashari Jyotish.

hindi: यूरेनस ये सब ज्योतिष में ही काम आएगा।
says: Says Uranus and the other outer planets will be put to use in astrology, meaning in his readings.
classical_check: Differs from traditional Jyotish, which omits them.

hindi: यूरेनस 12 गुना में सात 84 साल में गोल गोला घूम के बदलता है।
says: Uranus spends about 7 years in each sign and so takes 12 times 7, which is 84 years, to go round the zodiac.
cells_derived_method: A transit lasts 7 years in a sign; the house it affects depends on the lagna, so the same sign falls on a different house for each lagna.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Uranus in Taurus in the 1st house (Taurus lagna) means about 7 years of sudden change in self, body and identity.
Derived: Uranus in Taurus in the 8th house (Libra lagna) means about 7 years of sudden upheavals around shared money, inheritance and hidden matters.

classical_check: Agrees with astronomy: Uranus takes about 84 years and about 7 years per sign; not in Parashari texts.

hindi: नेपच्यून वरुण 12 * में 14 कितने हो गए? 164 164 साल में राशि बदलता है।
says: Neptune, called Varuna, spends about 14 years in a sign, which he works out as about 164 years for the whole round.
ambiguity: 12 times 14 is 168, not 164; he corrects it in the next part. Real period is about 165 years.
classical_check: Agrees with astronomy at about 165 years; outside Parashari Jyotish.

hindi: ऐसा ही कुछ होगा। 68 होगा।
says: Corrects his arithmetic for Neptune, saying the figure comes to about 168 years (the caption cuts the leading digit).
ambiguity: Caption reads '68'; context shows 168.
classical_check: 12 times 14 is 168; actual orbit about 165 years.

hindi: प्लूटो यह 12 * में 21 लगभग 250 कितने साल में 250 265 60 कितना जो भी आ जाए मोटे तौर पे लगभग लगभग
says: Pluto takes roughly 21 years a sign, about 250 years for a full round, though he is unsure of the exact figure and gives it only roughly.
ambiguity: He mentions 250 and 265 loosely; 12 times 21 is 252.
classical_check: Agrees roughly: Pluto takes about 248 years; its time per sign varies from 12 to 31 years, so 21 is an average.

hindi: बृहस्पति 12 महीने एक साल में पूरे के पूरे कार्यक्रम को घोल घूम के बदलता है। एक राशि में जाता है।
says: Jupiter stays about twelve months, one year, in each sign and moves to the next sign yearly.
cells_derived_method: The house Jupiter transits depends on the lagna; a one-year stay in each sign touches a new house each year.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Jupiter in Cancer in the 5th house (Pisces lagna), a year of Jupiter in its exalted sign in the house of children and merit.
Derived: Jupiter in Capricorn in the 8th house (Gemini lagna), a year of Jupiter in its debilitated sign over the house of sudden events and shared resources.

ambiguity: The caption wording 'whole programme' is garbled; the sign-a-year reading is the sensible one.
classical_check: Agrees: Jupiter spends about a year in a sign and about twelve years for the zodiac.

hindi: 12 * में 12 144 साल के बाद में महाकुंभ आता है।
says: Twelve times Jupiter's twelve-year cycle gives 144 years, after which the Maha Kumbh comes.
classical_check: Agrees with the tradition that Maha Kumbh falls after twelve Purna Kumbhs, every 144 years.

gist: Asks rhetorically how all these figures fit together.

hindi: सूर्य का जो गोला है सूर्य का गोला है इतना बड़ा यह गोला यह रेडियस है सेंटर से 432000 मील का है यह 432000 मील का
says: States that the radius of the Sun's globe is about 432,000 miles.
classical_check: Agrees with astronomy: the Sun's radius is about 432,000 miles.

gist: Checks a number with the audience and moves on.

hindi: 432000 मील का सूर्य का घेरा है पूरा कितना हुआ 8 लाख 64000
says: The Sun's full width is therefore 8,64,000 miles, twice the radius.
classical_check: Agrees: diameter about 864,000 miles.

gist: Sets up a question: how many seconds are there in one day.

says: A day has 86,400 seconds and half a day has 43,200, numbers that echo the Sun's 864,000 mile width and 432,000 mile radius.
classical_check: Arithmetic is correct; the numerological link to the Sun's size is an observation, not a Jyotish rule.

hindi: हमारा युग कितने का होता है? 432000 वर्ष का। उससे बड़ा युग द्वापर त्रेता 432 * टू टाइम्स।
says: Our present yuga, Kali, is 432,000 years long and the larger yugas are whole multiples of that figure, Dvapara twice and Treta three times.
ambiguity: The caption only says 'two times' for Dvapara and is garbled about Treta; the multiples 2 and 3 are classical.
classical_check: Agrees: Kali 432,000, Dvapara 864,000, Treta 1,296,000 and Satya 1,728,000 years.

hindi: ये कैसे सेट है? यानी कोई बहुत तगड़ा मैथमेटिक्स है।
says: The fit of these figures, he says, shows a very strong mathematics is behind the design of the cosmos.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: यानी अगर आप मैथमेटिशियन बनते हैं तो सूर्य की ताकत चाहिए। ज्योतिषी बनते हैं तो सूर्य की ताकत चाहिए। आप कैलकुलेशन करते हैं सूर्य की ताकत।
says: Becoming a mathematician or an astrologer, or doing calculation at all, needs the Sun's strength.
classical_check: Differs: mathematics and calculation are usually Mercury; astrology is Jupiter or Mercury; the Sun link is his emphasis.

hindi: आप मैनिफेस्टेशन की टेक्निक सिखाते हैं सूर्य की ताकत।
says: Teaching manifestation techniques also runs on the Sun's power.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: आपने अपने जीवन में सूर्य सेट किया हुआ है। इसलिए आप दूसरों को सिखा देते हैं गुरु बनके। बृहस्पति बन गए। दूसरे को सिखा दिया।
says: If you have your Sun set in order in your own life, you can teach others as a guru, becoming a Jupiter to them.
ambiguity: This conflicts with the next sentences, where the teacher's own Sun is said to be broken.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: खुद आया क्योंकि सूर्य है ही नहीं। इसलिए दूसरे को तो सूर्य ऑन कर देता है। गुरु अपना नहीं ऑन कर पाता क्योंकि उसका अपना सूर्य कर्मों के द्वारा नष्ट हुआ पड़ा है।
says: A guru can switch on another person's Sun but not his own, because his own Sun was ruined by his past actions.
ambiguity: The first clause is garbled. This contradicts the earlier row that says a set Sun lets you teach.
classical_check: Silent; echoes the saying that the teacher is not always his own beneficiary.

hindi: इसलिए वो औरों को सिखाता है वो लोग रॉकेट बन जाते हैं। खुद क्यों नहीं बना?
says: His students shoot up like rockets, yet the teacher himself does not rise, and he asks why.
classical_check: Silent; matches the old remark that the priest helps others but not himself.

hindi: क्योंकि गुरु के पास ताकत है सूर्य बनाने की लेकिन सूर्य के पास ही सूर्य होने की ताकत है।
says: A guru has the power to make a Sun in others, but only the Sun itself has the power of being the Sun.
ambiguity: The sentence continues into the next chunk.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: लेकिन सूर्य कैसे होगा? ये आपके चरित्र कर्म और विचारों के द्वारा सेट होता है।
says: The Sun in you is built through your character, your actions and your thoughts.
classical_check: Silent; a conduct-based remedy.

hindi: अगर आप वो नहीं कर सकते तो आपकी कुंडली में पड़ा हुआ सूर्य जहां है वहां पर पड़ा पड़ा नष्ट हो के वेस्ट हो जाएगा। आपकी जिंदगी व्यर्थ है।
says: If you do not build the Sun through conduct, the Sun lying in your chart simply decays and is wasted in whichever house it sits, and life is wasted too.
cells_derived_method: The house the Sun sits in decides which area of life is wasted, and the sign decides how much was on offer: an own or exalted Sun wastes more potential, a debilitated one wastes less.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: exalted Sun in Aries in the 10th house (Cancer lagna), a great career and status potential is wasted if character is not built.
Derived: Sun in Leo, its own sign, in the 1st house (Leo lagna), self-confidence and leadership potential is lost without discipline.
Derived: Sun in Taurus in the 6th house (Sagittarius lagna), the strength to win disputes and manage health routines goes unused.
Derived: Sun in Libra, debilitated, in the 12th house (Scorpio lagna), foreign-link and spiritual potential is lost and the damage is milder as the Sun starts low.

ambiguity: 'Life is wasted' is rhetorical; it is not a predictive rule.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: Stresses again how important and powerful the Sun is for our life.

hindi: अगर हमने इसको नहीं समझा तो हमारे जीवन के अंदर व्यर्थ है बाकी चीजें और बाकी कर्म करते रहना।
says: If the Sun is not understood first, all other efforts and actions in life are futile, so the Sun must be fixed before other planets.
ambiguity: A priority claim about method, not a chart rule.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: Notes a pyramid printed on the dollar note, starting a tangent.
Asks why the dollar is so strong and rules the world.
Says beings from the Orion galaxy came in Egyptian times and stayed for lakhs of years, called Anunnaki.
Says they came and mined gold and took it to the Orion galaxy.
Says there are many strange stories about this and he covered them in an earlier class on aliens.
Claims they used all the gold to build the ozone layer.

hindi: ओजोन लेयर सूर्य की नेगेटिव किरणों से धरती को प्रोटेक्ट करती है।
says: The ozone layer protects the earth from the Sun's harmful rays, so the Sun has a harmful side that needs a shield.
classical_check: Agrees with science that ozone blocks ultraviolet; no Jyotish rule.

hindi: अगर ओजोन डिप्लीट हो जाए, घट जाए तो हम मारे जाते हैं।
says: If the ozone layer depletes, we are in danger, because the Sun's harmful rays reach us unfiltered.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: Blames digging, global warming and carbon emissions for destroying the ozone layer.

hindi: यानी हमारे पास सूर्य के नेगेटिव इंपैक्ट्स आ रहे हैं।
says: As the shield thins, the Sun's negative impacts are reaching us.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: तो जिस व्यक्ति के शरीर में सूर्य के नेगेटिव इंपैक्ट आ रहे हैं। यानी हड्डियां वीक हो रही है, आंखें वीक हो रही है, पेट खराब हो रहा है, लिवर पे इफ़ेक्ट आ रहा है। हार्ट के अंदर दिक्कत आ रही है।
says: A person suffering the Sun's negative effects shows weak bones and eyes, stomach and liver trouble and heart trouble. Flagged: health claim, recorded only.
ambiguity: No chart condition is given for 'negative impacts'.
classical_check: Agrees that afflicted Sun relates to bones, eyes and heart; stomach and liver link is his.

hindi: उस व्यक्ति के शरीर में प्रजनन की क्षमता खत्म हो गई।
says: That person's reproductive capacity is gone. Flagged: fertility claim, recorded only.
classical_check: Agrees in part: afflicted Sun can reduce vitality and fertility, but this is stated absolutely.

hindi: मन महात्मा मर चुकी है। प्रेम खत्म हो गया है। और दूसरों को रोशनी देने की ताकत खत्म।
says: The mind and spirit in such a person has died, love has ended and he can no longer give light to others.
ambiguity: 'Man mahatma' is garbled; read as the inner spirit.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: उल्टा खुद को रोशनी चाहिए। यानी उसके सूर्य का सत्यानाश हो गया। उसकी ओज़ोन लेयर डिप्लीट हो गई।
says: Instead he now needs light himself, meaning his Sun is wrecked and his personal ozone layer is depleted.
ambiguity: Uses 'ozone layer' as a metaphor for the Sun's protective effect in the person.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: सो, ओज़ोन लेयर डिप्लीट कहां हुई है? वो नीचे घूम रहा है। बृहस्पति के नीचे कुड़ रहा है, सड़ रहा है, लड़ रहा है, ईर्ष्या है, क्लेश करता है, रोता पीटता है।
says: Such a person lives below Jupiter on his ladder, fretting, quarrelling, envious, causing strife and wailing.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: उसके जीवन में प्लूटो ऑन हो रहा है।
says: Pluto, the death planet, is switching on in his life. Flagged: death-related, recorded only.
ambiguity: No chart condition is given for Pluto being 'on'.
classical_check: Pluto is not in Parashari Jyotish.

hindi: आए दिन मन मरे जा रहा है और धीरे-धीरे इंस्टॉलमेंट्स में मरेगा और सड़-सड़ के मरेगा।
says: His mind dies day by day and he will die slowly in instalments. Flagged: death statement, not to be used as a prediction.
ambiguity: Mostly rhetoric about mental decline; the sentence runs into the next chunk.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: Imagines the man in an ICU bed saying his tension was useless and he did not need it.

hindi: तब वो व्यर्थता समझेगा, जब वो व्यर्थता उसे लील चुकी होगी, सूर्य से बहुत दूर जा चुकेगा।
says: He understands the pointlessness only after it has swallowed him, when he has gone far from the Sun.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: इस इजिप्शियन शब्द सभ्यता में रा सन गॉड होता था। रा आर ए सन गॉड सूर्य ये सूर्य ही भगवान है।
says: In Egyptian civilisation Ra was the Sun god, which he takes as proof that the Sun is God.
classical_check: Agrees that Ra is the Egyptian Sun god; this is comparative mythology, not Jyotish.

hindi: वहां पर भी सूर्य को भगवान कहा गया कि व्यक्ति विशेष अवतार बनने लगे।
says: There too the Sun was called God and certain individuals, such as rulers, began to be treated as its avatars.
ambiguity: Caption is rough.
classical_check: Pharaohs as sons of Ra is historical; the link to Jyotish is only the royal Sun karaka.

hindi: इसके एक आंख सिंगल आंख पिरामिड बना करके इसके ऊपर डॉलर के नोट के ऊपर है।
says: A single eye placed over a pyramid on the dollar note is read as the Sun's eye.
ambiguity: The eye is linked to the Sun only by his reading.
classical_check: Silent; the Eye of Providence is a Western symbol.

gist: Says the dollar is watching the whole world with one eye.

hindi: हम नॉर्थ ईस्ट के अंदर इवल आई आंख लगाते हैं। वो घर एक नेत्र से पूरे घर को देखता है।
says: Vastu link: we put an evil-eye (nazar) symbol in the north-east of a house and it watches the entire house with a single eye.
ambiguity: Whether the north-east is chosen for the Sun's sake is not said.
classical_check: Silent; Vastu assigns the north-east to Ishanya and Jupiter, not to the Sun.

hindi: वो यह नेत्र सूर्य का नेत्र है। यह दाया नेत्र है।
says: That watching eye is the Sun's eye, and it is the right eye.
classical_check: Agrees: the Sun is the karaka of the right eye in men.

hindi: राइट आई बाई आंख भी सूर्य के पास है। लेकिन वो चंद्रमा के द्वारा
says: The left eye also belongs to the Sun, but it works through the Moon.
ambiguity: The caption merges right-eye and left-eye words; the sentence runs into the next chunk.
classical_check: Agrees in part: Moon is the left eye karaka; routing it through the Sun is his addition.

hindi: राइट आंख की प्रॉब्लम है तो सूर्य देवता।
says: For a problem in the right eye the deity to turn to is the Sun. Flagged: health issue, recorded as a remedy pointer only.
classical_check: Agrees with traditional Surya worship for eye troubles, such as the Aditya Hridayam.

gist: Says the eye on the dollar has helped it conquer the world.
Says through wars and changing times they kept this power printed on their currency.
Says Americans do use consciousness, each individual does.
Remarks that the orange 2000 note died while the green 500 note returned and will survive.

hindi: यह बुध का आकाश है जो सूर्य का ही हिस्सा है। इसीलिए हरे रंग के इस नोट की भयंकर वैल्यू है।
says: Green is Mercury's sky colour, and Mercury is part of the Sun, so green notes carry great value. Flagged: no money or investment advice drawn.
ambiguity: 'Mercury's sky' (akasha) is unusual; he may mean space element or the colour only.
classical_check: Agrees that green is Mercury's colour and that Mercury stays close to the Sun; the currency inference is his.

hindi: यह आंख आपके पास जब रहेगी क्या आप दूर से ही कोई चीज को आकर्षित कर सकते हैं? यही मैनिफेस्टेशन की कला है।
says: When you hold the Sun's eye you can attract things from a distance, and that is the art of manifestation.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: नौकरी नहीं मिल रही। तुमसे आकर्षण नहीं आ रहा नौकरी का। तुम्हें प्यार नहीं मिल रहा। तुम्हें प्यार खींचने की ग्रेविटी खत्म है।
says: Failing to get a job or love means you have lost the pulling power, the gravity, to draw them in, which is a weak Sun.
ambiguity: The weak-Sun conclusion is implied by the topic.
classical_check: Silent; job success under a strong Sun is classical, love is usually Venus.

hindi: तुम्हारी सेहत ठीक नहीं हो रही। सही डॉक्टर नहीं मिल रहा, सही जोशी नहीं मिल रहा, सही कपड़े नहीं मिल रहे, सही सोफा नहीं मिल रहा, शादी नहीं हो रही बच्ची की।
says: Poor health, no right doctor or astrologer, no right clothes or sofa and a daughter not getting married are all listed as signs that the Sun's attracting power is missing.
ambiguity: A broad list; marriage is normally Jupiter and Venus, doctors normally Sun or Mars.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Sun is karaka of health and doctors; the others are stretched.

hindi: तुम्हारे अंदर सूर्य खत्म है।
says: Tells the audience that the Sun inside them is finished or exhausted, meaning the person's own Sun principle (self, soul-power, authority) has been drained.
ambiguity: Said to a general audience, not about a specific chart; it is a rhetorical statement, not a placement rule.
classical_check: Sun as atma karaka and source of vitality is classical; the claim that most people have lost their Sun is his own emphasis.

hindi: सूर्य ने बांध के रखा हुआ पूरे ब्रह्मांड को।
says: Claims the Sun holds the whole universe bound together, like the gravitational and organising centre of the system.
classical_check: Surya as soul of the world (jagat atma) is in BPHS and the Surya Siddhanta tradition; consistent.

hindi: आपने क्यों नहीं बांध के रखा? आपका सूर्य आप नष्ट कर रहे हैं।
says: Blames the listener: the Sun holds the universe together but you have not held yourself together, so you are destroying your own Sun through your conduct.
ambiguity: Moral exhortation more than a chart rule; no placement is named.
classical_check: Classical texts treat Sun weakness as a chart condition; the idea that behaviour weakens it is his own karma-based framing.

gist: Says it is necessary to understand how powerful the Sun is, before the examples that follow.

hindi: ऐसा कौन सा बच्चा होता है जो खुरलू फुरलू फुरलू करता है।
says: Poses the first example of a strong Sun: the child who looks careless and fidgety, playing around instead of grinding at books.
ambiguity: Sentence is a setup; the point is completed in the next two sentences.
classical_check: Silent; Sun as intellect-of-the-moment/clarity is a modern teaching reading of Sun's karakatva.

hindi: थोड़े से पेपर पढ़ता है और एग्जाम में लाजवाब परफॉर्म करता है।
says: That carefree child reads only a few papers yet scores outstandingly in the exam, which he offers as the visible result of a strong Sun.
cells_derived_method: Strong Sun gives efficient performance for little effort; it would be read through the house where Sun sits: Sun in the 4th or 5th house (education houses) or in Leo/Aries would show it more in studies, Sun in the 10th in professional performance.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Sun in its own sign Leo in the 5th house (lagna Aries) would be the clearest case of effortless academic and creative performance.
Derived: Sun exalted in Aries in the 10th house (lagna Cancer) would show the same sharp performance in career exams and public tests.
Derived: Sun debilitated in Libra in the 4th house (lagna Cancer) would be the opposite, hard study effort for modest result.

classical_check: Classical texts give Sun clarity and decisiveness but do not list exam performance specifically; his example is an applied reading.

hindi: सूर्य स्ट्रांग है। उसकी ब्रेन उसकी आंख वही वाले क्वेश्चंस को पिक कर लेती है। जो एग्जाम में आने
says: Explains the mechanism: with a strong Sun the student's brain and eye automatically pick out exactly those questions that will come in the exam, so Sun governs selective vision and insight.
cells_derived_method: Sun rules the eye and focused perception; the strength of this effect depends on Sun's sign dignity and house. Sun in a kendra or trikona with dignity gives sharp discrimination, while Sun in a dusthana or debilitated gives blurred focus.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Sun exalted in Aries in the 1st house (lagna Aries) gives the sharpest single-point focus.
Derived: Sun debilitated in Libra in the 8th house (lagna Pisces) would show poor targeting and scattered attention.

ambiguity: The sentence is cut at the chunk end ('which will come in the exam'); meaning is clear from the next lines.
classical_check: Sun as karaka of eyes (especially right eye) and of clarity is classical; exam-question picking is his illustration.

hindi: जिन लेडीज को मेरा वाला पिंक नहीं मिलता। ढूंढ रही है। 100 साड़ियां खोल दी। पिंक क्यों नहीं मिल रहा? अरे भाई सूर्य वीक है।
says: Gives the opposite example: a woman who cannot find her pink among a hundred opened saris is said to have a weak Sun, because the eye fails to pick the right object quickly.
cells_derived_method: Weak Sun (debilitated in Libra, combust-afflicted, or in 6/8/12) shows trouble in quick selection and finding things. For a woman, the 7th/5th house Sun would colour choices in partner and fashion; in the 12th it shows loss of the right item.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Sun debilitated in Libra in the 12th house (lagna Scorpio) would show wandering, losing things and indecision in choosing.
Derived: Sun in Aquarius (Saturn's sign, a sign hostile to Sun) in the 6th house (lagna Virgo) shows effort-heavy selection.

ambiguity: Humorous example; he does not say which house or sign the weak Sun is in.
classical_check: Silent; a weak Sun giving poor discrimination is an extension of the karaka.

hindi: तुम्हारे को आंख से अट्रैक्ट करके वो चीज खटाक से मिलनी चाहिए।
says: States the standard: your eye should be drawn to the thing you need and you should find it instantly, which is what a healthy Sun gives.
classical_check: Silent on this phrasing; consistent with Sun's rulership of vision.

hindi: यह आपके कर्मों के द्वारा सेट होगा।
says: Says this state of the Sun is set right through your own karma, meaning deeds and conduct, not by luck.
ambiguity: 'This' is vague; he is closing the Sun-strength example and pointing at karma as the lever.
classical_check: Karma-based remediation is a common tradition claim; no specific text cited.

hindi: सूर्य धर्म धर्म का देवता है। धर्म चलाता है।
says: Names the Sun as the deity of dharma who also runs dharma, so Sun is the karaka of righteousness and duty.
cells_derived_method: Sun's dharma role links to the 9th house (dharma) and 1st house (self); Sun in the 9th shows dharmic conduct, Sun in the 6th/8th/12th strains it.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Sun in own sign Leo in the 9th house (lagna Sagittarius) gives strong dharma, a righteous father and teachers.
Derived: Sun exalted in Aries in the 12th house (lagna Taurus) gives dharma worked out through detachment and foreign or spiritual places.

classical_check: Agrees: Sun is karaka of father, dharma and soul in BPHS.

hindi: सूर्यवंशी राम है। राम भगवान सूर्यवंशी हैं।
says: Notes that Lord Rama belonged to the solar dynasty, using him as the proof that Sun stands for dharma and kingship.
classical_check: Rama as Suryavamshi (Ikshvaku line) and Sun as his associated graha is traditional; Rama is the avatar linked to Sun.

hindi: 12 कला संपूर्ण कहा जाता है।
says: Says Rama is called complete in 12 kalas, so the Sun's 12-fold completeness is tied to the figure of Rama.
ambiguity: Caption does not say 'Rama' in this sentence; reading follows the previous sentence. Sun with 12 kalas can also tie to 12 signs/12 adityas.
classical_check: Tradition counts Rama as 12-kala and Krishna as 16-kala avatar; consistent.

hindi: 12 राशियों का स्वामी एक प्रकार से जोड़िए जो पैदा हुआ है राशियां जो पैदा है वो सूर्य की वजह से है।
says: Claims the 12 signs are born from the Sun, since the twelve divisions arise from the Sun's annual passage, so in a sense the Sun is master of all twelve signs.
cells_derived_method: Gives a basis for treating each sign as a 30-degree solar month; the Sun's own sign Leo anchors the rest. No separate house effect.
ambiguity: Caption is garbled in the middle; the claim that the signs exist because of the Sun is clear, the 'lord of all signs' wording is less sure.
classical_check: Zodiac as Sun's yearly path is astronomical; calling Sun lord of all signs is not classical (each sign has its own lord).

hindi: इसलिए सूर्य देवता मर्यादा के देवता है।
says: Concludes that the Sun is the deity of maryada, meaning limits, decorum and discipline, because it keeps the whole system in order.
classical_check: Maryada as Sun's quality is his reading (Rama is called maryada purushottam); not a listed karakatva in BPHS.

hindi: हृदय हमारा मर्यादा से चलता रहे तो पूरी जिंदगी ठीक है ना भाई?
says: If the heart keeps running with discipline then the whole life stays in order; he links the heart organ to Sun's maryada.
cells_derived_method: Sun in the 4th house (heart house in natural zodiac) or in Leo/Cancer areas touches the heart; strength of Sun there shows the heart functioning with discipline.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Sun exalted in Aries in the 4th house (lagna Capricorn) would give a strong heart and steady inner life but a restless home.
Derived: Sun debilitated in Libra in the 4th house (lagna Cancer) would burden the heart-centre and the mother's comfort. Heart-health reading is traditional symbolism, not a diagnosis.

ambiguity: The sentence starts at the chunk break (38:00 to 39:05).
classical_check: Sun as karaka of heart is classical (BPHS lists heart, bones, right eye).

hindi: सारे खून खून ने क्या करना है? खून हमारा झाड़ू लगाने वाला लिक्विड है।
says: Describes blood as the body's sweeping liquid, a cleaning fluid, and asks what its job is; he sets up the Sun-heart-blood chain.
ambiguity: Blood is usually Mars (and red blood corpuscles Mars in modern teaching); here he links blood circulation to the Sun-heart.
classical_check: Classical texts give blood to Mars and heart to Sun; he is merging them in a modern physiology way.

hindi: वो जहां जाता है ऑक्सीजनेटेड ब्लड छोड़ता है और गंदा वाला कार्बन डाइऑक्साइड का ब्लड खींच के ले जाता है।
says: Gives the physiology: blood delivers oxygenated blood where it goes and pulls back the dirty carbon-dioxide blood, which is the cleaning action he credits to the heart-Sun system.
ambiguity: Biology explanation used as analogy; not a chart rule.
classical_check: Silent; modern physiology applied to Sun karakatva.

hindi: तो शरीर फिट है। शरीर में लुब्रिकेशन हो रही है। हर जगह वाशिंग चल रही है। वाशिंग मशीन चल रही है।
says: Says when circulation works the body is fit, lubricated and being washed everywhere like a running washing machine; healthy Sun-heart means constant internal cleaning.
ambiguity: Metaphor only.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: शरीर में लाल खून के द्वारा कचरा कूड़ा निकाल के बाहर फेंक देते हैं सांस के थ्रू।
says: States that red blood carries waste out of the body, which is thrown out through the breath, giving the heart-lungs route as the Sun's cleaning channel.
ambiguity: Mixes Sun (heart) with Mars-like blood and Mercury/Moon-like breath; he does not name those planets here.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: तो बॉडी के अंदर सारी सफाई, क्लीनिंग, आत्मा शुद्ध करने का कार्य कौन कर रहा है? हार्ट।
says: Answers his own question: the one doing all the cleaning and purifying of the soul inside the body is the heart, so the heart is the Sun's seat and purifier.
classical_check: Heart for Sun is classical; the cleaning-of-soul angle is his own.

hindi: आत्मा कहां रहती है? लिवर। आत्मा जल रही है।
says: Appears to say the soul lives in the liver and that the soul is burning; the point is that organ distress is felt as the soul burning.
ambiguity: Liver here is probably a slip or a spoken idiom (burning liver, 'jigar'); heart is the Sun's organ and liver is Jupiter's. Possibly he said 'heart' and the caption wrote 'liver'.
classical_check: Contradicts the classical split (Sun heart, Jupiter liver); flag as unreliable.

gist: Common Hindi idioms: you hurt my soul, you stabbed my heart, you tore my heart; he says we keep saying such words.
More idiom: you broke my heart in two, brother; then telling the listener, do not say such things.

hindi: तुम्हें पता नहीं है। तुम्हारे इस दिल के वाकई टुकड़े हो रहे हैं। ये घाव लगे जा रहे हैं। दिल सह रहा है।
says: Warns that when you speak such heart-breaking phrases, the heart really is being cut into pieces and wounded, so harsh speech damages the Sun-heart; flagged as a tradition claim, not a medical statement.
ambiguity: Speech-affects-heart is a spiritual claim; no medical diagnosis is being made.
classical_check: Silent; Sun-heart is classical, the word-power point is his.

gist: Mock dialogue: I got scared, I got scared; sister why scared, what happened to be afraid of.

hindi: परमात्मा को भूल गए ना?
says: Gives the cause of fear: you are afraid because you have forgotten the Paramatma, the supreme soul, which he treats as the root of Sun weakness.
classical_check: Silent; faith as the cure for fear is devotional teaching.

hindi: जैसे ही आप परमात्मा को भूल गए। परम आत्मा के भूलते ही आत्मा लाचार हो जाती है।
says: The moment you forget the supreme soul, your own soul (atma, the Sun principle) becomes helpless; atma strength depends on remembering the Paramatma.
classical_check: Sun as atma karaka is classical; the link to remembering God is devotional.

hindi: आपका सूर्य वीक कर दिया है आपने।
says: Direct charge to the listener: by forgetting God you have made your own Sun weak; it frames Sun weakness as self-caused.
ambiguity: Does not mean the natal Sun is debilitated; he is speaking of functional weakness.
classical_check: Silent; classical weakness comes from dignity, house and combustion, not conduct.

hindi: आपका सूर्य कमजोर होने से आपको विविध प्रकार की समस्याएं जीवन में आती हैं।
says: A weak Sun brings many different kinds of problems into life, so Sun is the root planet whose weakness spreads trouble across areas.
cells_derived_method: The area of life hit depends on which house the weak Sun occupies and which houses it rules, since Sun lords one sign-based house per lagna.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: debilitated Sun in Libra in the 10th house (lagna Capricorn) would trouble career, authority and reputation.
Derived: debilitated Sun in Libra in the 2nd house (lagna Virgo) would trouble wealth, speech and family standing.
Derived: debilitated Sun in Libra in the 7th house (lagna Aries) would trouble partnerships and show an overbearing or weak spouse dynamic.

classical_check: Agrees in general: afflicted Sun harms father, status, health and authority.

hindi: यदि एक अकेला सूर्य ठीक है तो बाकियों को खींच-खच के ना धो के सेट कर देता है।
says: If the Sun alone is fine, it drags the other planets along and sets them right, as if washing them clean; a strong Sun can compensate for weaknesses elsewhere in the chart.
cells_derived_method: Compensation works through Sun's conjunction, aspect and dispositor links to other planets. A strong Sun in a kendra with many planets near it would lift them, though combustion within about 10 degrees damages the nearest ones.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Sun in own sign Leo in the 1st house (lagna Leo) is the cleanest case of one strong planet supporting the whole chart.
Derived: exalted Sun in Aries in the 10th house (lagna Cancer) gives public authority that lifts weak planets associated with it.

ambiguity: Conflicts partly with combustion: planets very close to Sun get burned, not lifted. He raises this later in the batch.
classical_check: Partly differs: classical tradition says a strong Sun gives strength to chart but also combusts near planets.

hindi: इसलिए आपको आशीर्वाद की क्षम ताकत समझनी बहुत जरूरी है।
says: Therefore you must understand the power of blessings (ashirwad), which he presents as the practical route to strengthening the Sun.
ambiguity: Caption word 'क्षम' probably means 'kshamata' (capacity).
classical_check: Seeking elders' blessings for Sun is a standard tradition remedy (father, elders); not in BPHS verbatim.

hindi: आशीर्वाद हम क्यों बोलते रहते हैं सारे टाइम? आशीर्वाद लो, आशीर्वाद लो।
says: Explains why he keeps repeating 'take blessings': it is the recurring instruction he gives for fixing life problems tied to the Sun.
ambiguity: Whose blessings is not specified in this sentence; the answer comes in the next one.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: क्योंकि अगर कोई किंग साइज देवता ही पड़ा हो तो लाइफ में दिक्कत क्या है?
says: Gives the reason: if a king-sized deity (the Sun) is pleased and with you, there is no difficulty left in life; blessings please the Sun.
ambiguity: Caption 'पड़ा हो' is odd; probably means 'is in your favour' or 'is behind you'.
classical_check: Silent; devotional logic.

hindi: अकेला सूर्य 5000 प्लस डिग्री टेंपरेचर है इसके कोर इसके आखरी आखिरी एरिया पे 5000 सोच नहीं सकते आप और अंदर तो कई लाख सेल्सियस है।
says: Uses astronomy to show the Sun's power: about 5000-plus degrees at its outer region and several lakh degrees Celsius inside; actual surface is about 5500 C and the core about 15 million C, so his inner figure is understated.
ambiguity: Caption numbers are noisy; he calls the outer region 'core' and then says the inside is higher.
classical_check: Silent; astronomy, not Jyotish.

hindi: ये सारे के सारे ग्रह 600 बार इस सूर्य में समा सकते हैं।
says: Claims all the planets together could fit inside the Sun about 600 times, a size comparison to show Sun's dominance; this is close to the real volume ratio of roughly 600.
classical_check: Silent; checks out astronomically (Sun's volume is about 600 times that of all planets combined).

gist: Emphasis filler: so big, so enormous, cannot even say how big the Sun is.

hindi: ये एक छोटे से गेंद के बच्चे को छोटे से बेबी को लेके घूमता रहता है।
says: The huge Sun keeps moving around carrying a small ball-like baby with it; he introduces Mercury in this image, setting up Mercury's constant nearness to the Sun.
ambiguity: The sentence runs into the next chunk where the baby is named as Mercury.
classical_check: Astronomically true that Mercury never strays far from the Sun (about 28 degrees maximum elongation).

hindi: बुध को ये बुध ग्रह है। ये छोटा बेबी है। खिलौने जैसे बुध को लेके सूर्य घूमता रहता है। गेंद है इसकी।
says: Names the little baby as Mercury and says the Sun goes around with Mercury like a toy or ball, so Mercury is always in the Sun's company in the chart.
cells_derived_method: Mercury stays within a sign of the Sun, so in any chart Mercury is in the Sun's sign or the one before/after. A house-based reading: Mercury shares the Sun's house or sits in the adjacent house.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Sun and Mercury together in Capricorn in the 10th house (lagna Aries) is the standard Budha-Aditya setting, intellect serving authority.
Derived: Sun in Leo in the 3rd house (lagna Gemini) with Mercury in Leo or Cancer or Virgo, giving a communicator who works for status.

classical_check: Agrees with the classical fact that Mercury is never more than one sign from the Sun.

hindi: इसीलिए हमने पिछली क्लास में बात की छो रहा है बुध। पापा के घूम रहा हूं मैं। घर नहीं जाऊं। यह ऐसे गोल-गोल घूमता है और पापा के अनुसार चलता है।
says: Recalls last class: Mercury is the child saying 'I keep going around Papa, I won't go home'; it circles the Sun and moves according to the father's pace, so Mercury follows Sun.
ambiguity: Caption begins with a garbled phrase ('छो रहा है'); read as 'the little one'.
classical_check: Mercury as Sun's close companion (and son-like) is accepted in teaching; classical texts call Mercury the prince (kumara).

hindi: इस सूर्य के देवता का जो राजकुमार राज स्त्री राशि मानी जाती है।
says: Calls Mercury the prince of the Sun deity, in a sentence that tails off into something about a feminine sign; the prince role is clear but the sign remark is garbled.
ambiguity: 'राज स्त्री राशि' is unclear; may refer to Mercury's even/feminine signs Virgo, or just be noise.
classical_check: BPHS gives Mercury the title of prince (kumara) in the planetary cabinet; consistent.

hindi: बुध स्त्री नपुंसक ग्रह है।
says: Says Mercury is a feminine-neuter planet, neither fully male nor female, which is his gender class for Mercury.
ambiguity: Classical texts call Mercury neuter (napunsaka); he adds 'feminine' as well.
classical_check: Differs slightly: BPHS gives Mercury and Saturn as neuter; some say Mercury is a eunuch with feminine tone. His 'stri' addition is non-standard.

hindi: स्त्री राशि स्त्री ग्रह माना जाता है। ये स्त्री नपुंसक ग्रह है। इसके आगे पीछे मंडराता रहता है।
says: A female sign and female planet are considered together as feminine, and Mercury is feminine-neuter, hovering around the Sun, front and back, always close.
ambiguity: First clause is unclear whether he means female signs (even signs) host female planets or is explaining Mercury's gender through its sign Virgo.
classical_check: Mercury's own signs include Virgo (feminine sign) and Gemini; his gender point is only partly classical.

hindi: तभी पापा की प्यारी परी बेटा तो राजा बेटा है ही। लेकिन पापा की प्यारी बिटिया। कौन सी बिटिया? छोटी।
says: Compares Mercury to papa's beloved little daughter: the son is a prince anyway, but the small daughter is the dearest, which is why Mercury clings to the Sun.
ambiguity: Planet-as-family-member analogy; not a chart rule by itself.
classical_check: Silent; classical texts give Mercury as the young one (kumara) but not as daughter.

hindi: इसलिए, मां पुत्र को बहुत प्रेम देती है। पिता पुत्री को बहुत प्रेम देता है।
says: General rule of opposite-gender affection: a mother loves her son deeply and a father loves his daughter deeply; he uses this to explain why Sun (father) is fond of Mercury (the little daughter-like child).
cells_derived_method: Gives the template for relations among planets by family role: Sun father with Mercury/Venus daughter-type, Moon mother with Mars/Jupiter son-type. No fixed house effect.
ambiguity: This is a family-psychology claim, not a classical friendship rule.
classical_check: Classical friendships: Sun-Mercury are neutral/friend per BPHS (Mercury treats Sun as friend, Sun treats Mercury as friend); consistent in direction.

hindi: नपुंसक मींस अभी उसमें पुंसकत्व नहीं है। अभी संतान उत्पत्ति की शक्ति नहीं है।
says: Defines 'napunsak' for Mercury as not yet having masculinity or the power to beget offspring, i.e. Mercury is a child who has not reached maturity.
ambiguity: Maturity reading of 'napunsak' is his own, not the classical meaning of neuter.
classical_check: Differs: classical napunsaka is a gender class used in planetary grouping, not 'immaturity'.

hindi: फिर है शुक्र। शुक्र कौन है? ऐश।
says: Moves to Venus and defines it in one word as 'ash', meaning luxury, pleasure and enjoyment.
classical_check: Agrees: Venus is karaka of luxury, enjoyment and comforts.

hindi: सूर्य राजा है। ऐश के देवता के पास आते ही ऐश समाप्त हो जाती है।
says: The Sun is the king, and as soon as he comes near the deity of luxury (Venus) the luxury ends, so Sun's nearness ends Venus's enjoyment.
cells_derived_method: Sun near Venus (conjunction, within about 10 degrees) burns Venus; effect shows in the house where both sit. 7th: marriage joy dims; 2nd: family wealth comfort; 12th: bed pleasures; 5th: romance.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Sun and Venus together in Libra in the 7th house (lagna Aries); Venus in own sign but combust, so the marriage pleasure is reduced by the partner's dominance.
Derived: Sun and Venus together in Taurus in the 2nd house (lagna Aries); Venus's comfort and food/family pleasure are scorched by Sun's ego.
Derived: Sun and Venus together in Libra in the 5th house (lagna Gemini); romance and creative pleasures dry up.
Derived: Sun and Venus together in Virgo in the 12th house (lagna Libra); Venus is debilitated and combust, bed pleasures and foreign comforts are lost.

ambiguity: He does not state the orb; 'near' is implied.
classical_check: Agrees with combustion (asta): Venus loses strength within about 10 degrees of Sun (8 when retrograde).

gist: Sets up an imaginary scene: suppose someone is sitting in the place of luxury, I am saying this in words (continues in next chunk).
Imagined party: drinking, fun, boys and girls, gambling, cards, betting; asks what happens if the king walks in.

hindi: बंद कर बंद कर सारा खत्म कर दे भाई। शुक्र नष्ट हो गया।
says: Punchline of the party story: everyone shuts it all down at once when the king arrives, which is how Venus is destroyed in Sun's presence; the stop is immediate, not gradual.
cells_derived_method: Venus indulgence stops under Sun's pressure. Reading by house of the conjunction shows which pleasure is forced to stop.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Sun and Venus together in Taurus in the 10th house (lagna Leo); glamour or luxury career is cut short by authority, the boss shuts it down.
Derived: Sun and Venus together in Libra in the 4th house (lagna Cancer); comforts and vehicles at home are curtailed by a stern authority figure.

ambiguity: Whether this is mere conjunction or any aspect is not stated here.
