classical_check: Agrees with combustion of Venus; classical texts also say combust Venus damages marital happiness.

hindi: हर ग्रह के पास अलग-अलग टेंपरेचर हैं।
says: Says each planet has its own temperature, setting up the idea that planets differ in heat and that this affects how they react to the Sun.
ambiguity: Planet temperature is astronomy used as a lead-in to the Sun-and-Mars example that follows.
classical_check: Silent; heat/cold nature of planets is classical (Sun, Mars hot; Moon, Venus cool), but he is using physical temperatures.

hindi: सूर्य के साथ के मंगल पे दिन में प्लस डिग्री होती है सेल्सियस की और रात में - 100 डिग्री।
says: Mentions Mars's physical temperature swing, high positive in the day and about minus 100 at night, as an illustration that Mars depends on the Sun for heat.
ambiguity: Caption number for day temperature is missing ('प्लस डिग्री'); the night figure is a rough planetary-science value.
classical_check: Silent; astronomy aside.

hindi: ये कहता है पापा आएंगे तो हम गर्म होएंगे। पापा नहीं आएंगे हम गर्म नहीं होएंगे।
says: Mars speaks like a child: if Papa (the Sun) comes I will heat up, if not I stay cold; Mars's energy and aggression depend on the Sun's presence or support.
cells_derived_method: Mars with or aspected by Sun gets heat and courage; far from Sun it stays cool. Houses show where: 3rd (courage), 10th (drive), 1st (body energy).

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mars exalted in Capricorn in the 10th house (lagna Aries) with Sun in Capricorn or Aries gets fired up in career, a decisive leader.
Derived: Mars and Sun together in Leo in the 3rd house (lagna Gemini) gives bold, forceful effort and sibling or communication authority.
Derived: Mars debilitated in Cancer in the 12th house (lagna Leo) with no Sun link stays cold, low drive.

ambiguity: He does not say the exact link (conjunction or aspect) that makes Mars hot.
classical_check: Classical texts treat Sun and Mars as friends; hot-planet synergy is accepted.

gist: Garbled lines about Earth having its own atmosphere and distance from the Sun, mixed with a half-quoted verse; no clear claim.

hindi: 12 का युग सहस्त्र योजन 8 मील पर भानु 9 करोड़ 60 लाख 9 करोड़ 73600 कितना हुआ? इतने मील दूर सूरज है।
says: Works out Hanuman Chalisa's 'yug sahasra yojan' as 12,000 x 1000 x 8 miles, about 9 crore 60 lakh (96 million) miles, and says that is the distance of the Sun; actual average is about 93 million miles.
ambiguity: Caption number sequence is noisy (9 crore 73600 appears to be a misfire); the 96 million figure is consistent with the arithmetic.
classical_check: Not a Jyotish rule; Hanuman Chalisa figure is close to modern 93 million miles.

gist: Repeats that Tulsidas had already told the Sun is 9 crore 60 lakh miles away and starts quoting the verse again.
Completes the verse and says it was said about Hanuman (swallowing the Sun as a sweet fruit).
Garbled number recitation (121000 and 8, 12 and 8) while he rechecks his arithmetic.

hindi: अब ये इतनी दूर धरती से है 96 मिलियन माइल्स दूर कहते हैं इसे।
says: Restates in modern units that the Sun is about 96 million miles from Earth, taking it that the old verse and modern astronomy agree.
ambiguity: Modern average is about 93 million miles, so he rounds up.
classical_check: Not a Jyotish rule.

hindi: 96 मिलियन माइल्स तो यहां पर धरती को टेंपरेचर इतनी प्यारी मिल गई है कि सूरज देवता ने हमें आग लगा के फूंक नहीं रखा। तो हम यहां बढ़िया से जिंदा है।
says: At this distance Earth gets a gentle temperature, so the Sun has not burnt us up and we survive comfortably; distance moderates Sun's heat.
cells_derived_method: Distance-moderates-Sun idea leads to the later rule that planets close to Sun are burnt and distant ones are safe; applies to combustion orbs.
classical_check: Silent; the combustion link is the real astrological use.

hindi: शुक्र देवता का क्या खेल है? शुक्र शुक्र तो ऐश का अड्डा है। वहां तो ऐश होती है भैया।
says: Asks what Venus's game is and answers that Venus is the very den of pleasure where luxury is the norm.
classical_check: Agrees: Venus is the planet of pleasure and luxury.

hindi: ऐश में तो सवाल ही नहीं उठता। राजा के आने पे कोई गंदा काम हो जाए।
says: In Venus's den there is no question of misconduct when the king comes; meaning the presence of Sun suppresses dirty or indulgent behaviour that Venus would allow.
ambiguity: Sentence is cut and a little confused: 'no question arises' could also read 'the question is, what if something dirty happens when the king arrives'.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: इसलिए सूर्य शुक्र को नष्ट कर देता है।
says: Therefore the Sun destroys Venus; the formal conclusion of the king-and-party analogy.
cells_derived_method: Venus is wiped out in the house of the conjunction. For lagnas where Venus rules kendras or dusthanas, the loss differs: Venus as 7th lord for Aries lagna loses marriage joy; Venus as 2nd and 9th lord for Virgo lagna harms wealth and fortune.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: for lagna Aries, Venus is 2nd and 7th lord and Sun with it in the 7th house wipes out the partner's pleasure side.
Derived: Sun and Venus together in Taurus in the 9th house (lagna Virgo); Venus is 5th and 10th lord, luck and career are burnt.

ambiguity: Does not mention the orb or the case where Venus is far from Sun.
classical_check: Agrees with combustion of Venus.

hindi: आपकी कुंडली के अंदर अभी सब समझ जाएंगे। आप यहीं से व्यवहार कि कौन सा ग्रह किसके पास आता है वो नाश करता है, प्लस करता है।
says: Method statement: use this behaviour logic for every planet pair in your chart, whichever planet comes near which, it either destroys or adds to it; the analogy is the key to reading conjunctions.
cells_derived_method: Each conjunction pair is judged by role: king, child, luxury, soldier, and so on. The effect location depends on the house of the conjunction.
ambiguity: Garbled phrase 'आप यहीं से व्यवहार'; read as 'learn behaviour from here'.
classical_check: Classical conjunction results exist, but he teaches a character-based method instead.

hindi: इसलिए शुक्र का ऐश अय्याशी खत्म हो जाती है सारी की सारी।
says: So all of Venus's luxury and debauchery ends completely when the Sun joins; stresses totality of the loss rather than a partial reduction.
ambiguity: Total loss is rhetoric; classical combustion has degrees of strength loss.
classical_check: Overstates: classical says Venus loses strength proportional to closeness, not always total.

hindi: जब सूर्य देवता वहां पर मंडराने लगते हैं तो सूर्य शुक्र की राशि में आता है तो शुक्र की ऐसी की तैसी हो जाती है।
says: When the Sun hovers around and enters Venus's sign, Venus is ruined; this makes Sun's transit or placement in Taurus or Libra a harsh setting for Venus matters.
cells_derived_method: Sun in Taurus or Libra puts the king in Venus's house; in Libra Sun is also debilitated. The house shows which pleasures are hit, and for natal charts Venus itself may be elsewhere.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Sun in Taurus in the 2nd house (lagna Aries) puts the king in Venus's house of wealth and speech; family comforts and food habits are dominated.
Derived: Sun debilitated in Libra in the 10th house (lagna Capricorn); both Sun and Venus matters suffer, career status is weak and luxury work is pinched.
Derived: Sun in Taurus in the 7th house (lagna Scorpio); the spouse is dominating over comforts and the marriage party life ends.
Derived: Sun debilitated in Libra in the 4th house (lagna Cancer); home comforts and vehicles are hit while the heart-centre is weak.

ambiguity: He says 'Venus's sign' generally; Libra could also be counted under Neptune in his scheme. Could also mean transit of Sun over these signs.
classical_check: Silent on Sun-in-Venus-sign as destroying Venus; Libra debilitation of Sun is classical, Taurus is neutral/inimical for Sun.

hindi: पार्टी बाजी खत्म बहू घूंघट निकाल लेती है। बेटा नचनिया के पास जाना बंद करता है। जुए का अड्डा समाप्त हो जाता है। दारू पार्टी सब खत्म। यानी कि
says: Describes the visible results once the king (Sun) is around: partying ends, the daughter-in-law covers her face, the son stops visiting dancers, the gambling den closes and drinking parties stop; indulgent behaviour in a Venus-linked area is suppressed.
ambiguity: This is a moral picture of suppression, not a claim about material loss; effect valence is mixed because stopping vice is good morally and bad for Venus's comfort.
classical_check: Silent; the social-behaviour description is his own.

hindi: सूर्य ने जब भी बर्बाद किया है तो शुक्र को बर्बाद किया है।
says: Whenever the Sun has ruined something among the planets, it is Venus that it has ruined; Venus is the planet the Sun's closeness always damages.
cells_derived_method: Damage shows in the house holding the Sun-Venus pair; the house topic (marriage in 7, wealth in 2, home comfort in 4, creativity in 5) tells which Venus pleasure is lost.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Sun exalted and Venus together in Aries in the 7th house (lagna Libra); Venus is combust, so married comfort is crushed by an overbearing partner.
Derived: Sun and Venus together in Taurus in the 4th house (lagna Aquarius); Venus is in own sign but burnt, vehicles and home comforts are strained.
Derived: Sun and Venus together in Pisces in the 11th house (lagna Taurus); Venus is exalted yet combust, gains from pleasure-related networks stall.

ambiguity: No orb stated.
classical_check: Agrees with Venus combustion (asta) when within about 10 degrees of Sun.

hindi: शुक्र क्या करता है? मृत संजीवनी। मृत संजीवनी कहता है दोबारा जिंदा।
says: Venus's special power is mrit sanjivani, the art of bringing the dead back to life; Venus revives what has died or been ruined.
classical_check: Agrees with the Shukracharya tradition: Venus (Shukra) alone knows Sanjivani vidya.

hindi: गए पापा फिर से जुए निकाल ले, पत्ते निकाल ले।
says: Once Papa (the Sun) has gone away, Venus's side comes back to life and the gambling dice and cards come out again; Venus recovers when it is no longer under Sun's pressure.
cells_derived_method: When the Sun moves out of Venus's combust range, in a transit or in the natal gap between the two, Venus pleasures revive. The house of Venus shows which area comes back.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Venus in own sign Taurus in the 5th house (lagna Capricorn) with the Sun far away (more than about 10 degrees) revives romance, games and entertainment fully.
Derived: Venus exalted in Pisces in the 12th house (lagna Aries) with Sun distant revives bed pleasures and foreign comforts.

ambiguity: Could also be read as Sun's transit leaving Venus's sign; he speaks in an analogy.
classical_check: Silent as a dynamic rule; consistent with combustion ending once the orb opens.

hindi: लॉटरी और सट्टा ये भी तो शुक्र संबंधित है। नहीं नहीं लॉटरी सट्टा शुक्र नहीं है।
says: Raises lottery and speculation as a Venus matter, then corrects himself: lottery and speculation are not Venus. (Recorded as what he said; no investment advice implied.)
ambiguity: A self-correction mid-sentence; the final position is 'not Venus'.
classical_check: Differs from some texts that tie speculation to the 5th house and Venus/Rahu; he removes Venus.

hindi: मंगल और सूर्य शनि भी है उसमें अलग-अलग मींस दो नंबर से तीन नंबर से करोगे तो शनि है।
says: Says lottery and speculation belong to Mars and Sun, and Saturn also enters in different ways; if the money comes by 'number two' or 'number three' (shady or irregular) routes, then it is Saturn.
cells_derived_method: Gambling and speculative gains shown through Mars (risk), Sun (windfall, authority), Saturn (illicit or hidden income). Houses 5 and 8 (and 11 for gain) carry the topic: any of these planets in 5/8/11 would be where it fires.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mars in own sign Scorpio in the 5th house (lagna Cancer) gives bold risk-taking in speculation.
Derived: Saturn in own sign Capricorn in the 8th house (lagna Gemini) shows hidden or irregular income and sudden swings.

ambiguity: 'दो नंबर / तीन नंबर' in Hindi slang means illegal or unaccounted money; it could also be read as 2nd or 3rd house. I take the slang meaning.
classical_check: Silent on this split; classical speculation is 5th and 8th house with Rahu or Mars.

gist: Says he will explain this topic later.

hindi: तो शुक्र का क्या हाल है? 471 डिग्री सेल्सियस शुक्र के ऊपर टेंपरेचर है।
says: Gives Venus's surface temperature as about 471 degrees Celsius, which is roughly the real figure (about 465 to 470 C) and the hottest of all planets.
classical_check: Not a Jyotish rule; astronomically accurate.

hindi: शुक्र इतना ज्यादा गर्म है। इतना ज्यादा गर्म है कि पूछो नहीं। आग है
says: Stresses Venus is unbelievably hot, like fire; so Venus is a fiery planet in its physical nature even though it signifies pleasure.
ambiguity: Classical nature of Venus is cool and watery; he is using physical temperature only.
classical_check: Differs from the classical sattvic, cool nature of Venus; the claim is physical, not a Jyotish nature.

hindi: तो यह याद रखें शुक्र हमेशा सूर्य के आगे हाथ जोड़ के चलता है।
says: Remember that Venus always walks with folded hands before the Sun, meaning Venus stays respectful and close to the Sun and bows to its authority.
cells_derived_method: Venus is never more than about 47 degrees from the Sun, so it is in the Sun's sign or within 1 to 2 signs of it. Pairs: Sun and Venus in same house, or Venus in the 2nd/12th (or 11th/3rd) from Sun's house.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Sun in Aries in the 10th house with Venus in Pisces or Taurus; Venus bows to a career authority, creative work under a boss.
Derived: Sun in Leo in the 1st house (lagna Leo) with Venus in Cancer or Virgo near it; pleasure and charm serve the personality.

ambiguity: Uses the astronomical fact for a devotional image.
classical_check: Agrees with the astronomical limit (Venus max elongation about 47 degrees).

hindi: आपकी कुंडली के अंदर अगर सूर्य ठीक है, घर के अंदर किसी बड़े का सूर्य ठीक है, तो आपके बच्चे ना हाथ जोड़ के चलेंगे आपके आगे।
says: If the Sun is good in your own chart and in the chart of an elder in the house, then your children will walk with folded hands in front of you, obedient and respectful.
cells_derived_method: The 5th house is children; the Sun's condition in the 1st, 5th and 9th houses would colour this. A well-placed Sun in 1, 5 or 9 in own or exalted sign gives obedient children and authority; Sun debilitated or in 6/8/12 weakens it.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Sun in own sign Leo in the 5th house (lagna Aries) is the strongest setting for authority over children.
Derived: Sun exalted in Aries in the 9th house (lagna Leo) gives respectful family culture with father as authority.
Derived: Sun debilitated in Libra in the 8th house (lagna Pisces) weakens parental authority; children do not listen.

ambiguity: Mixes the native's Sun with an elder's Sun, so it is family-chart reasoning, not a single-chart rule.
classical_check: Silent as a rule; Sun as father and authority karaka is classical.

gist: Describes parents who complain that their children have become debauched, drinkers, smokers, drug users and thieves.

hindi: इसका मतलब चोरी करते बुध खराब हो गया।
says: If a child steals, it means Mercury is spoiled; theft is read as a Mercury affliction (cleverness and trade turned crooked).
cells_derived_method: Mercury afflicted by Rahu, Saturn or Mars, or Mercury in a dusthana (6/8/12), is the natal pattern for dishonesty. Houses 3 (skill) and 6 (theft) carry it.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mercury debilitated in Pisces in the 6th house (lagna Libra) with Rahu or Saturn aspecting is the clearest pattern of theft and trickery.
Derived: Mercury in own sign Gemini in the 8th house (lagna Scorpio) with Rahu gives secret schemes and hidden dealings.

classical_check: Mercury as significator of thieves and deceit is traditional (Mercury is a trickster); agrees.

hindi: अयाशी करते इंद्र खराब हो गया।
says: If a person is into debauchery, then Indra (Uranus in his scheme) is spoiled; promiscuous or erratic indulgence is a Uranus affliction.
ambiguity: Indra equals Uranus in his 12-planet scheme; classical texts do not use Uranus.
classical_check: Silent; outer planets are outside classical Jyotish.

hindi: साथ में शुक्र का भी नाश पिट गया। वरुण का सत्यानाश है।
says: Along with Uranus, Venus is also wrecked and Varuna (Neptune) is ruined; indulgence and intoxication together spoil Venus and Neptune.
ambiguity: Varuna is Neptune in his scheme; link to intoxication is via the previous sentences.
classical_check: Silent on Neptune; Venus-pleasure link is classical.

gist: Caption says they are interested in taking blessings; likely a dropped 'not', so the meaning cannot be fixed.

hindi: सिर्फ सूर्य के रहते यह हो सकता है कि घर में सारे आपकी सुने। सूर्य इतना बलवान है।
says: Only while the Sun is in order can it happen that everyone at home listens to you; the Sun is so powerful that it alone decides household obedience.
cells_derived_method: Household command shows through Sun in the 4th (home) and 1st (self) or Sun's strength in the lagna lord role. Strong Sun in 1, 4 or 10 gives command; weak Sun does not.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Sun in own sign Leo in the 4th house (lagna Taurus) makes the head of the house the final voice.
Derived: Sun debilitated in Libra in the 1st house (lagna Libra) leaves the person without natural command; the family does not follow.

classical_check: Silent as a rule; Sun as head-of-family karaka is classical.

hindi: अगर आपने सूर्य सेट किया है तो ही आपके बच्चे आपका कहना मानेंगे सुनेंगे। नहीं तो कहेंगे भाड़ में जाए मां और बाप तुम्हारी ऐसी की तैसी।
says: Only if you have set your Sun right will your children obey; if not, they will tell their parents to go to hell; he is saying children's disrespect traces back to the parent's unfixed Sun.
ambiguity: Says 'set the Sun' without naming the remedy; earlier lines point to blessings and conduct.
classical_check: Silent; a tradition claim about parental Sun and filial respect.

hindi: इसके अतिरिक्त धरती आ गई। फिर मंगल मंगल बेटा है इसका।
says: Next Earth comes into the family of the Sun, then Mars, who is the Sun's son; Mars is placed as the son in the Sun's household.
ambiguity: Earth is not a graha in classical Jyotish; he lists it as a body in the solar family.
classical_check: Mars as son of the Sun is not classical (Mars is the son of Earth/Bhumi in Puranas); differs.

hindi: मंगल के साथ अधी मित्रता है इसकी।
says: Says the Sun has a (very strong) friendship with Mars; the first word is garbled and could be 'complete' or 'half'.
ambiguity: 'अधी' is garbled: could be 'पूरी', 'अधिक' (more), or 'आधी' (half).
classical_check: Agrees that Sun and Mars are natural friends in BPHS.

hindi: मंगल सेनापति है राजा का। सेनापति के पास जाएगा। क्या होगा? बढ़िया चेक करेगा ना।
says: Mars is the commander of the king; whatever goes to the commander gets inspected carefully, which sets up Mars as the body's inspector of the food that arrives.
ambiguity: The subject of 'will go to the commander' is not named; he means the food or the matter.
classical_check: Agrees: Mars is the senapati (commander) in the planetary cabinet.

hindi: आपने यहां से खाया। यहां की नाभि है। नाभि पे मंगल है।
says: What you eat from the mouth arrives at the navel, and Mars sits at the navel; the navel region and its digestive fire belong to Mars.
ambiguity: Gestures are lost in the captions; 'यहां' stands for mouth and navel.
classical_check: Differs: classical body mapping gives Mars the blood, marrow, muscles; the navel and digestive fire are usually Sun or Mars-Sun (Agni); partly consistent.

hindi: हनुमान देवता है। ये हनुमान ही ऐसा है जो छोटा बेबी सूर्य को खाने भी आए तो पापा कहते हैं चल कोई बात नहीं।
says: Hanuman is the deity of Mars; even when baby Hanuman came to eat the Sun, the Sun the father just said never mind, showing the Sun tolerates Mars as a beloved child.
ambiguity: Retells the story of Hanuman leaping at the Sun as fruit, to argue Sun-Mars warmth.
classical_check: Hanuman as the deity linked to Mars is a common remedy tradition; classical devta for Mars is Kartikeya/Hanuman in popular practice.

hindi: प्यारा बेबी है। खा तो तू सकेगा नहीं। पर ठीक है कोई बात नहीं। मेरा प्यारा बच्चा है।
says: The Sun says the baby is dear, he cannot really eat me anyway, but it is fine; Sun is indulgent and unthreatened by Mars's aggression.
cells_derived_method: Mars with Sun in conjunction is not burned as other planets are in his reading; the commander stays intact under the king. Applies to Sun-Mars conjunctions in any house.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Sun in own sign Leo with Mars in the 10th house (lagna Scorpio) is a strong career-authority pairing, not a combust loss.
Derived: Sun exalted in Aries in the 3rd house with Mars, who is also in his own sign (lagna Aquarius) gives bold effort.

ambiguity: Classical combustion applies to Mars too within about 17 degrees; he treats Mars as safe.
classical_check: Differs: classical tradition lists Mars as combust within about 17 degrees of Sun.

hindi: ऐसे ही सेनापति है। राज चलाने के लिए कौन है? सेनापति।
says: The commander is such a figure; the one who actually runs the kingdom is the commander, so Mars is the executive power of the Sun's rule.
classical_check: Agrees with Mars as army chief; running the state through the commander is his gloss.

hindi: तो ये बुद्धि हमारी चल रही है खोपड़ी। तीसरा नेत्र चल रहा है।
says: Our intellect works in the skull and the third eye is running; he introduces the third eye (between the brows) as the seat of thinking.
ambiguity: Does not name the planet for the third eye here; later lines tie it to Sun.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: सोचने समझने की ताकत शक्ति कहां से आ रही है? जब हम यहां खाते पीते हैं और मंगल धधक के कहता है खत्म भस्म।
says: The power to think comes from the food we eat: Mars blazes at the navel and burns the food to ash, converting it into energy.
classical_check: Silent; digestive fire as Mars-Agni is a teaching gloss.

hindi: तो आपका ब्रह्म यहां से ऑन होता है और जीवन जीने की शक्ति चलती है।
says: Your Brahma (creative consciousness) switches on from the navel and the power to live runs from there; the navel centre is the origin of life energy.
ambiguity: Alludes to Brahma born from Vishnu's navel lotus.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: आपका मंगल शोरली डिस्टर्बड होगा। अगर आपका सूर्य खराब होना है तो आपका पेट खराब होगा ही होगा तो आपकी बुद्धि भ्रष्ट होएगी ही होएगी।
says: If your Sun is going bad then your Mars is surely disturbed, your stomach will go wrong and your intellect will surely get corrupted: the chain Sun, Mars (navel and stomach), brain. Traditional claim, not a medical statement.
cells_derived_method: Afflicted Sun with afflicted Mars, shown by combustion, Rahu or Saturn on either, or both in dusthanas. Mars in the 6th or Sun in the 5th harmed by malefics would touch digestion and intellect together.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Sun debilitated in Libra in the 5th house (lagna Gemini) with Mars aspected by Saturn gives muddled intellect and weak digestion in the traditional reading.
Derived: Mars debilitated in Cancer in the 6th house (lagna Aquarius) with Sun afflicted points to digestion trouble and poor judgement, as a traditional pairing.

ambiguity: The sentence splits across the chunk break (45:04 to 46:06).
classical_check: Silent as a chain; Sun-Mars affliction harming digestion and intellect is a loose traditional reading.

hindi: आपका दिमाग चलेगा नहीं। क्लेरिटी ऑफ़ विज़न नहीं होगी। साफ दिखेगा ही नहीं।
says: Result of that chain: your brain will not work, there will be no clarity of vision and nothing will look clear; poor Sun-Mars health means muddled thinking.
ambiguity: 'Vision' means mental clarity, not eyesight, although Sun also rules the eye.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: Quotes people saying 'I do not understand, what do I do?'.

hindi: भाई तुम्हारा मंगल ठीक कर लो।
says: The remedy for confusion is: fix your Mars; strengthening Mars is the first fix for mental unclarity.
ambiguity: Method for fixing Mars not given in this sentence.
classical_check: Silent on this particular use of Mars remedy.

hindi: मंगल ठीक करने से राहु भी कुछ नहीं कर पाता।
says: Once Mars is fixed, even Rahu cannot do anything to you; a healthy Mars makes the native Rahu-proof.
cells_derived_method: Mars in own or exalted sign (Aries, Scorpio, Capricorn) or in strong kendra would hold against Rahu's conjunction or aspect. Houses show where Rahu's harm is blocked.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mars in own sign Aries in the 1st house (lagna Aries) with Rahu in aspect is claimed to hold; Rahu's confusion does not stick.
Derived: Mars exalted in Capricorn in the 6th house (lagna Leo) holds against Rahu in a conflict house.
Derived: Mars debilitated in Cancer in the 4th house (lagna Aries) is weak and would not protect against Rahu's disturbance at home.

classical_check: Silent; Mars-Rahu is classically an angarak yoga, a harmful combination, which conflicts with 'Mars holds Rahu'.

hindi: और राहु सूर्य को ग्रहण लगा देता है। लेकिन मंगल का कुछ नहीं कर पाता।
says: Rahu eclipses the Sun but cannot do anything to Mars; Rahu hurts Sun but not Mars.
cells_derived_method: Rahu with Sun is the eclipse yoga (grahan); where it sits shows the weakened area. Rahu with Mars is untouched in his view.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Rahu with Sun in Leo in the 1st house (lagna Leo) eclipses identity, the self-image is clouded.
Derived: Sun in Gemini in the 9th house with Rahu (lagna Libra) clouds father's matters and dharma.
Derived: Sun exalted in Aries in the 10th house with Rahu clouds the career and public standing.

classical_check: Rahu-Sun conjunction as an eclipse affliction (pitru dosha) is classical; saying Mars is immune differs, since Mars-Rahu is an angarak yoga.

hindi: आप मजे की बात देखेंगे आपने यहां से दारू पी। राहु अंदर गया।
says: Interesting point: when you drink alcohol through the mouth, Rahu enters the body; alcohol is read as Rahu.
classical_check: Agrees that Rahu rules intoxicants and poisons.

hindi: बृहस्पति कहता हां मैं फिल्टर करूं खाना हटा। पहले दारू को हटाऊंगा।
says: Jupiter (the liver, in his body map) says he will filter, moving the food aside and removing the alcohol first; Jupiter is the body's filter.
classical_check: Agrees: Jupiter is karaka of the liver in the classical body map.

hindi: दारू सबसे आसान है लिवर के लिए फिल्टर करना। लिवर के अंदर कौन से ऐसे यंत्र लगा रखे हैं खाना रोक के 24 घंटे में दारू साफ कर देता है बॉडी से वो।
says: Claims alcohol is the easiest thing for the liver to filter, stopping other food and clearing the alcohol from the body within 24 hours; physiology claim stated loosely, real clearance time varies with the amount.
ambiguity: The 24-hour figure is rough; it is a physiology aside rather than a Jyotish rule. No advice on drinking is intended.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: कई चीजों को पचाने में ज्यादा टाइम ले सकता है। राहु को कहता है साफ।
says: The liver may take longer to digest many other things, but to Rahu (alcohol) it says clear off at once; Jupiter dispatches Rahu quickly.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: बृहस्पति गुरु के आते ही तो राहु की जान निकल जाती है। तो वो कहता है आओ साफ करूं।
says: As soon as Jupiter the guru comes, Rahu's life goes out of him; Jupiter overpowers Rahu, and Jupiter says come, I will cleanse you.
cells_derived_method: Jupiter conjunct or aspecting Rahu subdues it. Houses show where: Jupiter in the 5th/9th aspecting Rahu in the 1st/3rd/5th/7th/9th/11th reduces Rahu's confusion in that area.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Jupiter in own sign Sagittarius in the 9th house (lagna Aries) with Rahu aspected calms foreign and dharma confusions.
Derived: Jupiter exalted in Cancer in the 1st house (lagna Cancer) casting aspect on Rahu in the 5th, 7th or 9th removes illusion from the self.
Derived: Jupiter in own sign Pisces in the 3rd house (lagna Capricorn) with Rahu in 7th (aspect) blunts Rahu's pull in partnerships.

ambiguity: Jupiter with Rahu in the same house is classically guru-chandala yoga and is mixed, which he does not mention here.
classical_check: Partly differs: conjunction is guru-chandala, usually a harmful yoga; aspect from Jupiter does reduce Rahu.

hindi: लेकिन पेट में दारू गई। नशा मात्र होगा कहां? यहां सूर्य को ग्रहण लग गया। सूर्य को ग्रहण लगाता
says: But once alcohol is in the stomach, where does the intoxication arise? In the head, where the Sun is eclipsed; Rahu eclipses the Sun inside the head.
ambiguity: Sentence runs into the next chunk.
classical_check: Silent; consistent with Rahu eclipsing the Sun.

hindi: है। राहु कहा जाता है राहु जैसा ग्रह ग्रह नहीं होता है। यह एक प्रकार का छाया ग्रह है। काल्पनिक ग्रह माना जाता है।
says: Rahu is not a real planet like the others; it is a shadow planet, regarded as imaginary.
classical_check: Agrees: Rahu is a chhaya graha (shadow planet), a lunar node.

hindi: ये यहां पर है तो आपको नशा कहां होता है? यहां होता है।
says: With Rahu sitting in the head region, intoxication is felt in the head; the effect of Rahu is located in the mind and brain.
ambiguity: Gesture-based; 'here' is the head.
classical_check: Silent; Rahu as head of the serpent is traditional.

hindi: अब कहते हैं सूरज भी गया, चंदा मामा भी गए। दोनों को नशा लग गया। ग्रहण लग गया ना सूर्य पे।
says: Both the Sun and the Moon get intoxicated and eclipsed by Rahu; Rahu's intoxication clouds both luminaries, the soul and the mind.
cells_derived_method: Rahu with Sun or Moon forms grahan yoga; the house shows which area is clouded: Moon-Rahu in the 4th disturbs the mind and home, Sun-Rahu in the 10th the career.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Moon exalted in Taurus with Rahu in the 4th house (lagna Aquarius) clouds peace of mind and home.
Derived: Sun in own sign Leo with Rahu in the 10th house (lagna Scorpio) clouds public image and authority.

classical_check: Agrees: Rahu with Sun or Moon is the grahan yoga.

hindi: नाभि क्या करती है? नाभि चलती रहती है। मंगल है यहां। हनुमान है यहां। हनुमान कॉन्शियसनेस।
says: The navel keeps running because Mars, Hanuman, sits there; Hanuman stands for a steady consciousness at the navel that does not stop under intoxication.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: यानी कि राहु मंगल को नष्ट नहीं कर सकता। सूर्य को भरवा देता है।
says: So Rahu cannot destroy Mars, but it befuddles the Sun; the last word is garbled and probably means confuses or fills with illusion.
ambiguity: 'भरवा देता है' is garbled; likely 'भ्रमा देता है' (makes it confused).
classical_check: Differs on Mars: classical angarak yoga says Rahu with Mars is harmful.

hindi: इल्लुजन आपको पितर याद आ जाते हैं। समझ नहीं आता।
says: Under illusion (Rahu's effect) you start remembering your ancestors and cannot make sense of things; the Sun's eclipse brings pitar memories and confusion.
ambiguity: Joking reference to drunk people who suddenly recall their forefathers.
classical_check: Sun as pitru karaka eclipsed by Rahu is the classical pitru dosha idea; consistent.

hindi: इसलिए कोई कृपा चाहिए उस समय नशेड़ी आदमी को घर पहुंचाने के लिए क्योंकि सूर्य हिल गया है।
says: That is why a drunk man needs someone's grace to reach home, because his Sun has been shaken; the Sun is the navigation or guiding power that gets lost.
ambiguity: Humorous illustration.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: शनि ऑन हो गया है। सर सुस्ती का भी इसी से सुस्ती सारी सूर्य की वजह से। उठा नहीं जा रहा।
says: When the Sun is shaken Saturn switches on, bringing heaviness and sluggishness; all laziness, he says, comes from a weak Sun, so you cannot get up.
cells_derived_method: Weak Sun with strong Saturn dominating (Saturn in a kendra aspecting Sun, Sun in Libra or Saturn's signs) gives heaviness. Houses 1 and 6 show body inertia, 10 shows work inertia.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: the debilitated Sun in Libra with Saturn in the 1st house (lagna Libra); Saturn is strong there (lagna Libra) gives body inertia and slow starts.
Derived: Sun in Aquarius (Saturn's sign) in the 10th house (lagna Taurus) gives sluggishness and delay in career action.

classical_check: Silent as a rule; Sun-Saturn enmity and Saturn as laziness karaka are classical.

hindi: सुबह 9 घंटे सो के भी नींद पूरी नहीं हो रही। विटामिन डी चेक कराओ सबसे पहले तो।
says: If you still feel unrested after 9 hours of sleep, first get vitamin D checked, linking tiredness to the Sun's vitamin; this is a health suggestion, not a diagnosis or treatment plan.
ambiguity: Medical suggestion recorded as said; flagged, not endorsed.
classical_check: Silent; Sun-sunlight-vitamin D is a modern gloss.

hindi: और इमीडिएटली जाके पैर पकड़ो किसी के। या तो बृहस्पति के गुरु बना लो या कोई सूर्य पापा के। नहीं तो पितर याद कर लो।
says: Remedy: go at once and touch someone's feet; either take a guru (Jupiter figure) or a father figure (Sun), or else remember your ancestors.
classical_check: Seeking guru and father's blessing, and ancestor remembrance (pitru tarpan), are standard tradition remedies.

hindi: यह तो करने से मात्र से आपके शरीर में ऊर्जा आनी शुरू हो जाएगी।
says: Claims that merely doing this will start bringing energy into your body; the remedy is said to act quickly.
classical_check: Silent; a tradition claim about quick effect.

hindi: ताकत नहीं है। ध्यान नहीं है शरीर में। क्या करेंगे? यह आशीर्वाद और कृपा का खेला है।
says: When there is no strength or attention in the body, what can you do? It is a play of blessing and grace, so the fix is relational and spiritual rather than mechanical.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: यहां मंगल हो गया। मित्र है। बृहस्पति गुरु है। अब
says: With the Mars story done, he notes Mars is a friend and moves on to Jupiter, the guru.
ambiguity: 'मित्र है' could mean Mars is a friend of the Sun or of Jupiter; both are classically true.
classical_check: Agrees: Mars is a friend of both Sun and Jupiter.

hindi: बृहस्पति सारी की सारी सूर्य की किरणें यहां लेता है। धरती को खींच के रखता है। धरती को अंदर नहीं जाने देता।
says: Jupiter takes in all the Sun's rays, holds the earth by attraction and does not let it fall into the Sun; Jupiter is the stabilising guardian that keeps planets from collapsing inward.
ambiguity: A physics-style claim; Jupiter's gravitational shielding of the inner system is a modern idea, while falling into the Sun is his image.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: बृहस्पति गुरु है। ये इसका पूर्ण मित्र पूर्ण प्रेमी है। और सूर्य भी यहां आ के कहता है।
says: Jupiter the guru is the Sun's complete friend and full lover; the friendship runs both ways.
cells_derived_method: Jupiter and Sun together (or in mutual aspect) get mutual support without combustion damage in his view. The house shows what grows: 9 (dharma), 5 (learning), 1 (self).

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Sun in own sign Leo with Jupiter in the 9th house (lagna Sagittarius) is a strong dharma and fortune pairing.
Derived: Sun exalted in Aries with Jupiter in the 5th house (lagna Sagittarius) is strong for education and children.

classical_check: Agrees: Jupiter is a friend of the Sun in BPHS, and Sun is a friend of Jupiter.

hindi: बनाया तो मैंने ही है तुझे। पर तू गुरुदेव है। क्योंकि तू ही मुझे साकार रूप देता है। मैं निराकार हूं।
says: The Sun says he created Jupiter, but Jupiter is the guru, because it is Jupiter who gives the Sun a form; the Sun is formless, Jupiter makes the divine take shape.
ambiguity: Sun as nirakar versus Jupiter as sakar is his own philosophy.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: साकार में क्या है? राम है, कृष्ण है, देवी है, गणपति है, भैरव है। ये रूप जितने बने ये बृहस्पति ने ज्ञान द्वारा बनाए।
says: All the embodied forms such as Ram, Krishna, Devi, Ganapati and Bhairav were created by Jupiter through knowledge; Jupiter is the planet of deity-forms and their lore.
classical_check: Silent; Jupiter as karaka of knowledge and religion is classical.

hindi: बेटा तू ये वाला देवता पूछ तू वो वाला ये वाला देवता यहां काम करेगा। बृहस्पति ने प्लेसमेंट कर रखी है कि इस इस ग्रह के द्वारा ये ये देवता एक्टिवेट होंगे।
says: Jupiter has fixed a placement chart saying which deity is activated through which planet; if you worship the right deity for the right planet it works; the planet-to-deity assignment is Jupiter's teaching.
ambiguity: First clause is garbled but the meaning is clear from the second sentence.
classical_check: Agrees with the graha-devata scheme (Sun-Rama or Surya, Mars-Hanuman, and so on).

hindi: बृहस्पति ने ही इनको भी घसीट रखा है। शनि इत्यादि को। चलो मेरे पीछे पीछे पूछ की तरह।
says: Jupiter has also dragged along Saturn and the others, telling them to follow behind like a tail; Jupiter leads the slower outer planets.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: और शनि वगैरह कह रहे हैं मैं तुझे पीछे खींच रहा हूं। यह कॉस्मिक घटना एक्चुअली होती है कि शनि बृहस्पति को घसीटता है।
says: Saturn and the rest say they are pulling Jupiter back; he adds that it is an actual cosmic event that Saturn drags Jupiter, so the pull runs both ways.
ambiguity: This slightly contradicts the previous sentence that Jupiter leads; he accepts both.
classical_check: Silent; Jupiter-Saturn gravitational interplay is astronomical, not classical Jyotish.

hindi: इसको यूरेनस, नेपच्यून और प्लूटो। लेकिन ये सब अल्टीमेटली फिर बृहस्पति के आकर्षण में घसीटे जा रहे हैं।
says: The same applies to Uranus, Neptune and Pluto, but ultimately all of them are being drawn along in Jupiter's attraction; Jupiter is the centre of the outer-planet group.
classical_check: Silent; the outer planets are not in classical Jyotish.

hindi: लेकिन ये मदद कर रहे हैं बृहस्पति की। सारे बृहस्पति के मददगार हैं कि हमारे को पीछे छुपे रहने दे। सूर्य खा जाएगा। हमें पीछे हम नहीं जा सकते आगे।
says: The outer planets act as Jupiter's helpers and ask to stay hidden behind it, because the Sun would devour them; none can go ahead of Jupiter toward the Sun.
ambiguity: Caption ends mid-thought at the chunk break; the last words say they cannot go ahead.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: ये तो मतलब सूरज को तो आग लगा देगा। काम, क्रोध, लोभ, मोह, अहंकार, ईर्ष्या, भय सब भस्म कर देता है सूर्य।
says: The Sun burns up lust, anger, greed, attachment, ego, envy and fear; the Sun's fire destroys the inner vices.
cells_derived_method: A strong Sun in the 1st, 5th, 9th or 10th, especially in Leo or Aries, gives this vice-burning clarity; a weak Sun leaves vices intact.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Sun exalted in Aries in the 1st house (lagna Aries) burns inner vices fast and gives a strong ego-free self.
Derived: Sun debilitated in Libra in the 12th house (lagna Scorpio) lacks the fire, so envy and fear persist.

classical_check: Silent; Sun as purifier of ego is a spiritual reading.

hindi: जब आप कहते हैं यह शब्द कहा गया कि शिवजी ने तीसरा नेत्र खोला और सारे राक्षस भस्म हो गए। राक्षस भस्म कैसे हुए?
says: When scripture says Shiva opened his third eye and all demons were burnt, how did the demons burn? He reads the third eye as the Sun's fire destroying vices.
classical_check: Silent; demons as inner vices is an allegorical reading.

hindi: आप किसी ज्ञानी व्यक्ति से बात करो थोड़ी देर में वो कहेगा आपके सामने तो मेरे प्रश्न ही खत्म हो गए।
says: Talk to a wise person for a while and he will say that in front of you his questions simply ended; a person with strong Sun dissolves other people's doubts.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: वो प्रश्न कौन करने वाला था? मुन्ना कोई काम क्रोध की बात, लोभ मोह की बात तो कैसे खत्म हुए? क्योंकि तीसरा नेत्र से अटैक मार के फेंक के मारेगा सूर्य। ये ले जवाब।
says: The questions he carried were his lust, anger, greed and attachment; they ended because the Sun's third-eye strike throws back the answer; vices are the questioner and the Sun answers by attack.
ambiguity: Garbled in places.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: वो कहेगा यार मेरी तो बेइज्जती हो गई भाई। इसलिए लोग चुप हो जाते हैं। सुप्त अवस्था में चले जाते हैं।
says: The questioner feels humiliated, so people go silent and fall into a dormant state; strong Sun power makes others shrink back into silence.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: हर पर्सन का अपना सोलर सिस्टम है। हर पर्सन का यही सोलर सिस्टम है।
says: Every person carries his own solar system inside; the chart is a model of the solar system at the person level.
classical_check: Agrees in spirit: the birth chart is the personal map of the planets.

hindi: वर्किंग कहां से कर रहा है डिपेंड करता है। उसका जो रूलिंग प्लनेट है रूलिंग प्लनेट सूर्य है सबका।
says: How it works depends on where it operates from; the ruling planet of everybody is the Sun, so the Sun sits at the centre of each person's system.
ambiguity: 'Ruling planet' here is not the lagna lord; it means the central planet.
classical_check: Differs from the classical meaning of ruling planet (lagna lord or day lord).

gist: Garbled: if good it is everyone's, everyone has a Sun, then what about date-of-something; no clear claim.

hindi: जो डेट ऑफ़ बर्थ से डेट ऑफ़ बर्थ से जो चलता है उसमें वही तो उपाय किए जाते हैं कि बाकी ग्रहों का डाइलट कर दिया जाए।
says: In the system that works from date of birth (numerology), the remedies are meant to dilute the other planets; the DOB method handles other planets by reducing their strength.
ambiguity: Sentence is partly garbled; 'dilute' may mean reducing the influence of other numbers or planets.
classical_check: Silent; numerology is outside classical Jyotish.

hindi: ऑलरेडी वन हो। क्या चीज? मूल्यांक।
says: Already one; one of what? the moolank (root number); the root number one is the Sun's number in this numerology reading.
ambiguity: Caption is short; reading 'one' as the Sun's number is inferred from the Sun-centred argument.
classical_check: Silent; in numerology 1 is the Sun's number.

gist: Says moolank (birth-date root number) belongs to numerology, which is a separate subject that he will not go into here.

hindi: ज्योतिष की हमारी क्लास में यह एक दो तीन चार नंबर ही धुल जाएंगे।
says: In this Jyotish class the numerology numbers one, two, three and four will simply be washed away; the chart, not the date-of-birth number, is the base of reading.
ambiguity: 'धुल जाएंगे' is odd; read as 'will be dissolved or set aside'.
classical_check: Agrees that classical Jyotish is chart-based and does not use numerology.

hindi: सबसे बर्बाद नंबर सबसे ऊंचा हो सकता है। यह आपकी कुंडली डिसाइड करेगी।
says: The most ruined number (planet) can turn out to be the highest; your chart decides which, so an afflicted planet is not automatically weak in outcome.
cells_derived_method: Outcome depends on the planet's house and sign in the chart: an afflicted planet in a dusthana can still rise (like the Vipareeta idea), while the same planet in a kendra may be hurt. Needs the (house, sign) cell to judge.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mars in own sign Scorpio in the 6th house (lagna Gemini) afflicted by malefics can still win enemies and rise.
Derived: Jupiter exalted in Cancer in the 8th house (lagna Sagittarius) can be damaged in outcome even though strong by sign.

ambiguity: 'Number' here seems to mean planet; it follows the numerology digression.
classical_check: Partly agrees: dusthana lords in dusthanas give Vipareeta Raja yoga, a classical case where bad becomes good.

hindi: बहुत केस स्पेसिफिक है। यूनिवर्सल रूल को भूल जाओ। वो तो नॉर्मल सी बात है।
says: Reading is very case-specific; forget universal rules, they are only ordinary generalities, so every result must be judged in the individual chart.
classical_check: Agrees with classical practice of weighing every combination in context.

hindi: शनि का तेल चढ़ा दो। ऐसे नहीं होता। नुकसान भी करता है।
says: Warns against the blanket remedy of offering oil to Saturn: it does not work that way and can even do harm, because remedies must fit the chart.
classical_check: Differs from common Saturn-oil-donation advice (Shani tel daan) given as a universal remedy.

hindi: इसी इसी शनि इत्यादि का सत्यानाश होता है। इसीलिए डर के रहते हैं सूर्य के आगे।
says: This is how Saturn and similar planets are ruined by the Sun, which is why they stay in fear in front of the Sun; Sun suppresses Saturn.
cells_derived_method: Sun with Saturn in the same house or in mutual aspect (7th) weakens Saturn's results there. Where Saturn is a house lord, that house suffers.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: the debilitated Sun in Libra and Saturn in the 7th house (lagna Aries); Saturn is at its best there, but Saturn's delay and discipline in partnership is cut by the Sun's pressure.
Derived: Saturn in its own sign Aquarius together with the Sun in the 4th house (lagna Scorpio); Saturn's slow comfort-building at home is overridden.
Derived: Saturn in its own sign Capricorn together with the Sun in the 10th house (lagna Aries); a boss-versus-labour tension that dims Saturn's work gains.

classical_check: Agrees that Sun and Saturn are natural enemies; classical combustion of Saturn is within about 15 degrees.

gist: Reminds the class to remember where these planets sit in different positions.

hindi: सूर्य चंद्रमा को कभी नष्ट नहीं करता। उसके साथ है। उसको जीवन ही वो दे रहा है।
says: The Sun never destroys the Moon; it stays with it and actually gives it life, since the Moon shines by the Sun's light; Sun-Moon conjunction is not harmful in his view.
cells_derived_method: Sun and Moon together (new moon) are read as support rather than destruction; the house shows where. Sun-Moon in the 10th gives public life energy, in the 4th it feeds the mind and home.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Sun exalted and Moon together in Aries in the 10th house (lagna Cancer) gives strong public standing fed by an energetic mind.
Derived: Moon exalted in Taurus together with the Sun in the 2nd house (lagna Aries) gives family wealth and a calm voice.
Derived: Sun debilitated in Libra with Moon in the 12th house (lagna Scorpio) gives dreamy retreat but the Sun's weakness can drain energy.

classical_check: Differs: classically a Moon very near the Sun (amavasya, within about 12 degrees) is combust and weak.

hindi: हमारी जो एनर्जी बॉडी है वो स्पिरिट बॉडी है। उसमें स्काई एलिमेंट और ईथर एलिमेंट है।
says: Our energy body is the spirit body, and it is made of the sky (akasha) and ether elements, which he associates with the Sun.
ambiguity: He does not name the planet in this sentence; the next lines tie it to the Sun.
classical_check: Silent; classical texts give akasha to Jupiter, so assigning it to Sun differs.

hindi: उसके साथ जो मुन्ना आया है मन कॉजलल बॉडी इस धरती पर करने क्या है? वो चंद्रमा है।
says: Along with that comes the mind, the causal body that has to do things on earth, and that is the Moon; Moon is the causal body or mind.
ambiguity: Caption garbled around 'मुन्ना'; the equation mind = causal body = Moon is clear.
classical_check: Agrees that Moon is manas (mind) karaka; calling it the causal body is his gloss.

hindi: चंद्रमा के साथ मिलके यह आत्मा बन गया।
says: The spirit body joins with the Moon (mind) and together they became the atma, the soul as people experience it.
classical_check: Silent; classically Sun alone is atma karaka and Moon is manas.

hindi: इसलिए कहा जाता है मरने के पश्चात आत्मा में से पितर निकलते हैं। कहां जाते हैं? चंद्रलोक पर।
says: It is said that after death the pitars emerge from the soul and go to Chandraloka, the Moon's world; ancestors are tied to the Moon. Afterlife belief, not a prediction.
classical_check: Agrees with the Puranic idea that pitars reside in Chandraloka (pitru loka via Moon).

hindi: और आत्मा कहां जाती है? पुनः ईथर में विलीन। वो सूर्य पर चली जाती है।
says: And the atma goes back to dissolve in ether, meaning it goes to the Sun; the soul's final home is the Sun.
classical_check: Agrees with the tradition that the liberated soul goes through the Sun (surya dwar).

hindi: जो स्पिरिट बॉडी है एनर्जी बॉडी वो सूर्य पर चली जाती है।
says: The spirit or energy body goes to the Sun after death, while the other part goes elsewhere.
ambiguity: Repeats the previous sentence in different words but adds the energy-body label.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: जो कॉजलल बॉडी है वो चंद्रमा पर पितृ।
says: The causal body goes to the Moon as the pitar (ancestor); so the pitar are the mind-layer residing on the Moon.
ambiguity: The sentence splits across the chunk break (50:04 to 51:05).
classical_check: Agrees with Moon as the abode of pitars.

hindi: इसलिए पितरों के लिए किया जाता है।
says: Therefore the rites are done for the ancestors, to take care of their Moon-world body; the object of the rite is not stated in the caption.
ambiguity: Verb object missing (shraddha or worship); meaning is inferred from the next lines.
classical_check: Agrees with the practice of pitru karma.

hindi: इसीलिए स्त्रियों से सारी चंदा मामा की पूजा कराते हैं। ये ले चांद देख ले। चांद देख के व्रत तोड़ना। चांद की पूजा कर लो।
says: This is why women are made to worship the Moon (Chanda Mama), see the moon and break their fast after seeing it; moon worship by women is a causal-body practice.
ambiguity: Refers to vrats such as Karwa Chauth.
classical_check: Moon worship vrats are a traditional practice; his causal-body reason is his own.

hindi: ये सारा का सारा इसी कारण है कॉजलल बॉडी सेट करने के लिए।
says: All of this is for the same reason, to set the causal body right; moon rituals are meant to straighten the mind-layer.
classical_check: Silent; his interpretation.

hindi: ये पुरुष है। ये स्त्री है प्रकृति।
says: This is purusha and this is prakriti: Sun is the male principle and the others (Moon among them) are the feminine nature principle.
ambiguity: Pointing words; which planet is which is inferred from context.
classical_check: Agrees: Sun is a masculine planet, Moon feminine.

hindi: राहु बुध ये दोनों के दोनों सूर्य के रहते बिल्कुल पड़ोस में है। कोई लफड़ा नहीं।
says: Rahu and Mercury both stay right in the Sun's neighbourhood and there is no trouble in that, so Sun with Rahu or Mercury is not automatically a problem.
cells_derived_method: Mercury is always within a sign of the Sun, so it is a natural neighbour. Rahu can sit anywhere, so Sun with Rahu is a specific placement.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Sun and Mercury together in Gemini in the 3rd house (lagna Aries) is peaceful and communicative.
Derived: Sun exalted in Aries with Rahu in the 11th house (lagna Gemini); his view says no problem here unless Jupiter fails to support.

ambiguity: Rahu is not always next to the Sun; he seems to mean when they are together. Conflicts with the next sentence.
classical_check: Differs for Rahu: Sun-Rahu is a classical grahan yoga; Mercury near Sun is the common Budha-Aditya yoga (fine).

hindi: लफड़ा सिर्फ तब है जब बृहस्पति सपोर्ट नहीं कर रहा।
says: The trouble arises only when Jupiter is not giving support; Jupiter's backing is what prevents Rahu or Sun troubles.
cells_derived_method: Jupiter's aspects (5th, 7th, 9th from its own house) onto the Sun-Rahu pair protect it; with no Jupiter aspect or link, the eclipse effect shows in the house of the pair.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Sun with Rahu in Leo in the 5th house (lagna Aries) with Jupiter in the 1st house aspecting it; eclipse effect on children and intellect is eased.
Derived: Sun with Rahu in Capricorn in the 10th house (lagna Aries) with Jupiter in Cancer, the 4th house, aspecting it from its strong sign; public image trouble is eased.
Derived: Sun with Rahu in Sagittarius in the 9th house (lagna Aries) with no Jupiter link; dharma and father matters stay clouded.

classical_check: Agrees that Jupiter's aspect reduces Rahu's affliction.

hindi: तो राहु सूर्य को ग्रहण लगा देता है थोड़ी देर के लिए।
says: Then Rahu eclipses the Sun, but only for a short time; the Sun-Rahu eclipse is temporary rather than permanent.
ambiguity: 'थोड़ी देर' could mean a short period, a dasha or a transit.
classical_check: Agrees that Rahu eclipses Sun; permanence of natal Sun-Rahu is stronger than he says.

hindi: राहु वह इल्लुजन है जो पता ही नहीं लगने देता। सूरज कहां है?
says: Rahu is the illusion that does not let you even know where the Sun (your clarity) is; Rahu hides the guiding light.
classical_check: Agrees with Rahu as the karaka of illusion and confusion.

hindi: जब चंदा मामा सूरज के और धरती के बीच आ जाते हैं यानी आपका मन बीच में आ जाता है तो चंद्रमा पे कौन रहता है? पितर।
says: When the Moon comes between Sun and Earth, meaning your mind comes in between, who lives on the Moon? The pitars; so a solar eclipse is read as the mind and ancestors standing between you and your soul.
classical_check: Silent; allegorical reading of solar eclipse.

hindi: जब पितरों की कृपा नहीं मिलती तो सूर्य ढक जाता है।
says: When the grace of the ancestors is not received, the Sun gets covered; lack of ancestral blessing shows as a clouded Sun.
cells_derived_method: The 9th house (ancestors, father) and the Sun's condition there carry it. Sun with Rahu or Saturn in the 9th, or Moon afflicted in the 4th, would show it.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Sun in own sign Leo in the 9th house (lagna Sagittarius) with Rahu; the ancestral line's blessing is clouded and father's matters wobble.
Derived: Moon debilitated in Scorpio in the 4th house (lagna Leo) with a Rahu link; mother and ancestral peace of mind are shaken.

classical_check: Agrees with pitru dosha: Sun afflicted in the 9th or with Rahu or Saturn.

hindi: सूर्य कहता है आत्मा आपकी कहती है मैं तुझे कुछ क्लेरिटी नहीं दूंगी।
says: The Sun, your soul, says I will give you no clarity at all; with the Sun covered the atma withholds clarity.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: बृहस्पति कहता है मैं तुझे कुछ भी समझने नहीं दूंगा। पहले पितरों को कृपा लेके आ।
says: Jupiter says I will not let you understand anything; first bring the ancestors' grace; Jupiter's wisdom is gated by ancestors' blessing.
classical_check: Silent; links Jupiter to the pitru remedy, his own view.

hindi: तुझे एक ओकार परमात्मा की कृपा चाहिए। पहले पितरों की ली नहीं ली राहु खा जाएगा।
says: You need the grace of the one supreme Paramatma, but unless you first take your ancestors' grace, Rahu will swallow you; ancestors first, then God.
ambiguity: 'ली नहीं ली' is a stammer in the caption; meaning is 'if not taken'.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: राहु के समय में दुनिया के अंदर ऐसे 90% लोग घूम रहे हैं जो कह रहे हैं मुझे समझ नहीं आ रहा क्या हो रहा है।
says: In the present Rahu time about 90 percent of people in the world go around saying they do not understand what is happening; he treats the current era as Rahu's.
ambiguity: 'Rahu's time' could be a yuga-wide era, the current transit, or a general dasha-like age; the 90 percent figure is rhetorical.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: Says 99 out of 100 people ask him what the purpose of life is.

hindi: सब राहु से ग्रसित हैं।
says: All of them are gripped by Rahu; the urge to ask what life's purpose is, is read as Rahu affliction.
classical_check: Silent; consistent with Rahu as confusion.

gist: Jokes that such people keep his shop running, beaten down and wandering from one astrologer to another.

hindi: आंसर कभी नहीं मिलता क्योंकि सूर्य डाउन है बहुत ही ज्यादा।
says: They never get an answer because their Sun is very far down; those who keep searching for meaning have a deeply weak Sun.
cells_derived_method: A very weak Sun (debilitated in Libra, combust-damaged or in dusthanas with malefic aspects) is the chart sign of lack of clarity.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Sun debilitated in Libra in the 8th house (lagna Pisces) gives hidden answers and persistent searching without finding.
Derived: Sun in Aquarius in the 12th house (lagna Pisces) gives retreat and a lack of direction in life purpose.

classical_check: Agrees that weak Sun gives weak self-knowledge.

hindi: बुध बेबी है। इसका कोई प्रॉब्लम नहीं।
says: Mercury is a baby so there is no problem for it near the Sun; he treats Mercury as safe in the Sun's company.
cells_derived_method: Sun-Mercury conjunction in any house is read as supportive (Budha-Aditya) rather than destructive, so the house topic gets intellect and authority.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mercury in Virgo, its own and exalted sign, together with the Sun in the 1st house (lagna Virgo) gives sharp analytic authority.
Derived: Sun with Mercury in Gemini in the 10th house (lagna Virgo) gives a career in speech, trade or writing under authority.

classical_check: Differs partly: Mercury is combust within about 14 degrees (12 if retrograde) in classical rules; Budha-Aditya yoga is regarded as good only when Mercury is outside the combust range.

hindi: अब सूर्य आता है शुक्र के पास। शुक्र शुक्र परफ्यूम है।
says: Now the Sun comes near Venus, and he calls Venus perfume; the image for the next argument is that Venus is a volatile fragrance.
classical_check: Agrees that Venus signifies perfumes and fragrance.

hindi: आप परफ्यूम को खुला भी छोड़ दोगे ना हवा में जो सूर्य का ही आकाश है। परफ्यूम गायब। शराब खुली छोड़ दोगे। गायब उड़ गई ना?
says: Leave perfume or liquor open in the air, which is the Sun's own sky, and it vanishes; the Sun's atmosphere makes Venus-type things evaporate even without direct fire.
ambiguity: Analogy only.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: यानी आपको अग्नि दिखानी है परफ्यूम को। भक के फूंक देगा। आप ताप दिखाओगे जरा सी गर्मी भपक गया यानी शुक्र को नष्ट कर देता है।
says: Show fire to perfume and it flares up and burns; with even a little heat it goes off in a flash, which is how the Sun destroys Venus, quickly and with little heat needed.
cells_derived_method: Venus is very sensitive to the Sun's proximity. Even a wide Sun-Venus gap in the same house, or Sun's aspect on Venus in the 7th, dims Venus's results in that house.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Sun exalted in Aries in the 7th house (lagna Libra) opposite Venus in Libra in the 1st aspecting it; Venus's charm is dimmed by partner or self-dominance.
Derived: Venus in own sign Taurus with the Sun in the 5th house (lagna Capricorn); romance and creative joy evaporate quickly.

ambiguity: No orb stated.
classical_check: Agrees with Venus combustion (asta), within about 10 degrees.

hindi: वरुण कितना बड़ा समुद्र है वरुण।
says: Varuna (Neptune in his scheme) is a vast ocean; he introduces Neptune as the sea.
classical_check: Silent; Neptune is not in classical Jyotish, though Varuna is the Vedic water deity.

gist: Repeats how vast the sea of Varuna is.

hindi: इतना बड़ा समुद्र है कि इसके दम पर भी जीवन है और वरुण सबसे महान देव है।
says: The ocean is so large that life depends on it, and Varuna is the greatest deity; Neptune sustains life and is placed highest among the gods.
ambiguity: 'Greatest' is a rhetorical claim.
classical_check: Silent; Varuna as an ancient Vedic chief god is traditional.

hindi: वरुण के पास वरुण नष्ट हो जाता है जीवन के अंदर तो आपके जीवन के अंदर ईर्ष्या इतनी बढ़ जाती है।
says: When Varuna is destroyed in life (by the Sun's pressure) jealousy grows enormously in your life; a ruined Neptune shows up as envy.
cells_derived_method: Neptune afflicted (by Sun, Rahu, Saturn) gives envy; envy shows in the 6th, 11th and 3rd houses (rivals, peers, siblings).

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Neptune with Sun debilitated in Libra in the 11th house (lagna Sagittarius); envy toward peers and gain circles.
Derived: Neptune in Pisces with a hostile planet in the 6th house (lagna Libra); envy and rivalry with colleagues.

ambiguity: Text is garbled: 'वरुण के पास वरुण नष्ट हो जाता है' likely means that near the Sun, Varuna is destroyed.
classical_check: Silent on Neptune; envy as Mars/Saturn/Rahu result is classical.

hindi: पैरों की पिंडलियां खराब हो जाती है।
says: The calves of the legs go bad when Neptune and Venus are ruined; he assigns the calf region to this pair. Tradition claim, not a medical statement.
ambiguity: The subject is implied from the previous sentence; may be about Venus alone.
classical_check: Differs: classical body maps put legs and feet under Aquarius and Pisces (Saturn, Jupiter or Mercury), not Venus.

hindi: और ये दोनों हार्ट के पास है।
says: And these two (Venus and Varuna) are near the heart in the body; Venus and Neptune act close to the heart region.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: शुक्र और यह इसलिए शुक्र नष्ट नहीं होना चाहिए।
says: Because Venus and Neptune sit near the heart, Venus must not be destroyed; keeping Venus safe from the Sun is a chart priority.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: आपके शरीर की चिकनाई लड़कियों की सबसे बड़ी प्रॉब्लम होती है। मेरे को क्रीम लगा के अति हो गई।
says: The body's smoothness or oiliness is Venus's domain, and girls' biggest complaint is dry skin despite creams; skin lubrication is a Venus matter.
ambiguity: Cosmetic skin condition, no medical diagnosis implied.
classical_check: Agrees that Venus rules skin beauty and bodily fluids.

hindi: क्योंकि बहन तेरा शुक्र डिस्टर्बड है।
says: Because, sister, your Venus is disturbed; persistent dryness or cream-dependency is read as disturbed Venus.
classical_check: Silent on this specific complaint.

hindi: सारे टाइम तुझे यही गणेश है। मैं सुंदर नहीं हूं। मैं अच्छी नहीं हूं। तेरा शुक्र डिस्टर्ब हो रहा है।
says: If you are constantly thinking I am not beautiful and not good, your Venus is getting disturbed; constant self-image worry marks a disturbed Venus.
cells_derived_method: Venus afflicted in the 1st or 7th house, or Venus debilitated in Virgo, would give low sense of beauty and worth.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Venus debilitated in Virgo in the 1st house (lagna Virgo) gives persistent self-criticism about looks.
Derived: Venus in Scorpio in the 7th house (lagna Taurus) with malefic aspect gives insecurity about attractiveness in relationships.

ambiguity: 'यही गणेश है' is garbled and ignored.
classical_check: Silent; Venus as beauty karaka is classical.

hindi: और लैक ऑफ सेल्फ कॉन्फिडेंस ये सूर्य के द्वारा आने वाली रश्मियां कम हो जाती है।
says: And lack of self-confidence means the rays coming through the Sun have reduced; low confidence is a weak Sun supply.
cells_derived_method: Sun weak in the 1st or 5th house, or Sun debilitated, would give low self-confidence.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Sun debilitated in Libra in the 1st house (lagna Libra) gives low self-confidence and reliance on others' approval.
Derived: Sun in Capricorn (Saturn's sign) in the 5th house (lagna Virgo) gives hesitant self-expression.

classical_check: Agrees that weak Sun gives weak confidence.

hindi: सूर्य की जो रश्मियां हैं वो सारी की सारी मंगल है। वो नाभि पर है। नाभि वीक हो जाती है।
says: All of the Sun's rays are Mars, located at the navel, and when the supply drops the navel becomes weak; Mars is the Sun's ray-carrier in the body.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: स्त्री की नाभि वीक नहीं होनी चाहिए। नाभि वीक होने से सिज़ेरियन ऑपरेशंस होते हैं।
says: A woman's navel must not be weak, because a weak navel leads to caesarean operations; a traditional claim linking weak Sun-Mars navel energy to surgical childbirth, not a medical statement.
ambiguity: Medical-type claim; recorded as said and flagged only.
classical_check: Silent; not a classical Jyotish rule.

hindi: मंगल कट लगाता है। सूर्य उसको रोकता नहीं। सूर्य कहता है नॉर्मल डिलीवरी करा दूंगा। मस्त रहना।
says: Mars makes the cut (surgery), the Sun does not stop it, but the Sun also says it will make the delivery normal if you stay relaxed; with a healthy Sun the outcome is normal delivery.
ambiguity: Unclear whether the Sun allows the cut or prevents it; read as a strong Sun giving normal delivery. Medical-type claim.
classical_check: Silent; Mars as surgery karaka is classical.

hindi: इसलिए काम वाली पोछा लगाती है। अगले दिन डिलीवरी करके फिर आ जाती है।
says: That is why the domestic helper keeps mopping and comes back to work a day after delivery; physically active women have strong navel energy and easy delivery.
ambiguity: Anecdotal; generalises from one class of workers.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: Mocks other ladies who fuss with tension about the baby, buying clothes and a trolley.

hindi: ये अरे बहन फ्यूचर में क्यों जा रही है? वो बच्चे के बच्चा तेरा ऑपरेशन करा देगा। सूर्य रूठ जाता है।
says: Why go into the future, sister? That worry itself will bring you an operation; the Sun sulks when you live in future anxiety.
ambiguity: Garbled middle clause; main point is anxiety about the future upsets the Sun.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: वो कहता है मर्यादा से चलो। बच्चों को मर्यादा सीख जाते हैं।
says: The Sun says walk with discipline (maryada), and children learn discipline; teaching maryada to children keeps their Sun healthy.
ambiguity: Caption turns 'सिखाते हैं' into 'सीख जाते हैं'; either way it is about learning discipline.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: कौन से बच्चे बढ़िया है? पेपर देकर आए। मस्त है कोई परवाह नहीं। क्यों? 20 तारीख को रिजल्ट आएगा। 19 तारीख के बाद रोऊंगा अगर रोना है तो।
says: Which children are good? Those who have given their paper and stay cheerful, thinking the result comes on the 20th and I will cry on the 19th evening if needed; living in the present keeps the Sun strong.
classical_check: Silent; psychological reading of Sun.

hindi: नहीं। 10 तारीख से रोना शुरू। हाय मेरे पेपर का क्या होगा? आपका सूर्य वीक हो रहा है।
says: The other kind starts crying from the 10th, what will happen to my paper; that anxiety is the Sun getting weak.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: 20 तारीख का सूर्य 20 तारीख को आएगा। 2020 में होगा। 2025 2025 में होगा। आप आगे पीछे ट्रेवल कर रहे हैं। मर्यादा छोड़ दी।
says: The 20th's Sun will come on the 20th, 2020 will happen in 2020 and 2025 in 2025; you are mentally travelling back and forth in time and have left maryada; the Sun is the present moment.
ambiguity: Years 2020 and 2025 are just examples.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: अगर आपके मन में ये वाले नियम है। और आप मर्यादा से चलते हैं। आपका सूर्य वीक नहीं होगा।
says: If these rules are in your mind and you walk with maryada, your Sun will not become weak; discipline protects the Sun.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: भूल जाओ कोई गड़बड़ कोई माई का लाल कुछ उखाड़ के दिखाए। शरीर भी ठीक होगा।
says: Forget it, no one in the world can harm you, and the body will be fine too; he promises full protection and health to the person who keeps maryada.
ambiguity: Absolute promise; a tradition claim, not a measured result.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: वरुण समुद्र देवता है। समुद्र को पूरा बांध के रखा होता है सूर्य ने। इतना बड़ा समुद्र है। सोच के चलिए।
says: Varuna is the sea deity and the Sun has kept the whole ocean bound together; think how vast that is; the Sun holds Neptune's waters in order.
ambiguity: This sits oddly with earlier lines where the Sun destroys Varuna when too close; here the Sun is the binder.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: और सूर्य का बेटा मंगल कौन? नाभि। नाभि पर भी सूर्य है। अग्नि होती है। जठराग्नि हनुमान जी की कहानी है।
says: The Sun's son Mars is the navel, and the Sun is also at the navel as the fire (jatharagni, digestive fire); this is Hanuman's story, so the navel fire is Sun-Mars together.
classical_check: Silent; digestive fire is often credited to Sun or Mars in modern texts.

hindi: सुरसा ने मुंह खोला। वरुण को एक छलांग में पार करके हनुमान निकल गए। यानी इन सबको ताकत उड़ाने की किसके पास है? मंगल।
says: When Surasa opened her mouth Hanuman crossed the sea (Varuna) in one leap; so who has the power to fly over all of these? Mars; Mars can overcome Neptune's vast ocean.
cells_derived_method: Mars strong in own or exalted sign overcomes Neptune's water/illusion effects; the house shows where the crossing happens.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mars in own sign Scorpio in the 12th house (lagna Sagittarius) can push through foreign or oceanic obstacles.
Derived: Mars exalted in Capricorn in the 9th house (lagna Taurus) gives long-distance travel and crossing of hurdles.

classical_check: Silent; Hanuman as the Mars devta is a tradition gloss.

hindi: सूर्य क्यों नहीं करता? क्योंकि सूर्य पुरुष है। बाकी सब प्रकृति। पुरुष क्या करता है? करता नहीं।
says: Why does the Sun not do it? Because the Sun is purusha and everyone else is prakriti; the male principle does not act.
classical_check: Silent; Sankhya purusha-prakriti framing.

hindi: करना प्रकृति का कार्य है। सूर्य है। विष्णु क्या करते हैं? कुछ नहीं। विष्णु है। करता कौन है? लक्ष्मी।
says: Doing is the work of prakriti; the Sun just is; Vishnu does nothing, he only exists, and Lakshmi does the work; the Sun is like Vishnu.
ambiguity: Lakshmi is not tied to a planet in this sentence; elsewhere she is associated with Venus.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: शिव शक्ति तो जो स्त्री रूप है वो कार्य करता है। पुरुष तत्व क्या करता है? मातृ शक्ति का स्रोत है। भंडार है। यह करने का कार्य।
says: In Shiva-Shakti the female form does the work, while the male element is the store and source of the mother power; the Sun is the reservoir from which feminine forces act.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: तो वरुण के अंदर क्या है? नमक। जितना नमक समुद्र में होता है, उतना वो बांध के रखता है उसको।
says: What is inside Varuna? Salt; whatever salt the sea contains, the Sun binds it in place; Neptune is salt and the Sun is the binding force.
ambiguity: Who 'he' is who binds the salt is inferred as the Sun.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: अगर आपके समुद्र में ज्वार भाटा आया, समुद्र के अंदर तूफान आया यानी सूर्य देवता ने यहां पर साथ छोड़ दिया है।
says: If tides or storms come in your sea, it means the Sun has left its support there; storms in life are the Sun withdrawing from Neptune.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: Asks why tsunamis come and why the sea throws water, and says to look into the chart.

hindi: जिसका वरुण डिस्टर्बड हो गया है। सूर्य के कारण से वरुण से दूर चला गया। नेगेटिव राशि में चला गया। उसके जीवन में तूफान आते रहते हैं।
says: For the person whose Neptune is disturbed because the Sun moved away from it, into a negative sign, storms keep coming in life.
cells_derived_method: The Sun's distance from Neptune and its sign dignity set the effect; Sun in a hostile or debilitated sign (Libra, Aquarius, Taurus) far from Neptune would be this case.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Sun debilitated in Libra in the 12th house (lagna Scorpio) far from Neptune; life storms around losses and hidden matters.
Derived: Sun in Aquarius in the 8th house (lagna Cancer) away from Neptune gives sudden upheavals.

ambiguity: 'Negative sign' is not defined; it may mean debilitation, enemy sign, or an even/feminine sign.
classical_check: Silent on Neptune.

hindi: वरुण की लाइफ साइकिल कितनी है? 14 साल प्रति राशि।
says: Neptune's life cycle is 14 years per sign, since it stays about that long in each sign; this is close to the astronomical value of about 13.7 years.
cells_derived_method: Neptune's 14-year sign stay means a person's Neptune transits one sign for a long block, so the house position changes only about every 14 years.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Neptune transiting Pisces while it is the 10th house (lagna Gemini) would colour a 14-year career phase.
Derived: Neptune transiting Aries in the 4th house (lagna Capricorn) would colour a 14-year home phase.

classical_check: Silent on Neptune; the period is astronomically consistent.

hindi: पांडवों ने 12 साल वनवास लिया। 13 साल में अज्ञातवास 14 वर्ष में लड़ाई करनी पड़ी। 14 साल राम को वनवास हुआ।
says: Gives examples of the 14-year cycle: Pandavas 12 years of exile, a 13th year incognito and then a war, and Rama's 14 years of exile; the epic numbers are loosely fitted to a Neptune cycle.
ambiguity: Caption mixes 12, 13 and 14; the Pandava exile was 12 plus 1 years, not 14.
classical_check: Differs on Pandava numbers (13 years total, not 14); Rama's 14-year exile is correct.

hindi: 14 साल ये 14 साल की साइकिल चलती है। ये 14 साल की साइकिल वरुण चलाता है कब? जब सूर्य उससे
says: The 14-year cycle is run by Varuna, and the question is when it runs: when the Sun [is in some relation to it]; the sentence is cut off and the condition is missing.
ambiguity: Sentence ends mid-clause at the end of the batch; the condition (likely Sun's distance or separation from Neptune) is not available.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: दूर हो जाता है।
says: Completes the cut-off line from the last batch: Neptune's 14-year cycle of storms runs when the Sun has moved far away from it; the Sun's distance from Neptune is the trigger.
cells_derived_method: Neptune's trouble phase applies when the Sun is far from it in the chart, for example the Sun in the opposite half of the zodiac from Neptune. The house of Neptune shows where storms fall.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Sun in Taurus in the 4th house (lagna Aquarius) with Neptune far across the chart; home-life storms during Neptune's long stay.
Derived: Sun debilitated in Libra in the 10th house (lagna Capricorn) far from Neptune; career storms and drift.

ambiguity: The first clause is a fragment; it only makes sense as the end of the previous sentence 'when the Sun [is far] from it'.
classical_check: Silent on Neptune.

hindi: सूर्य क्या करता है? नमक डाल के रखता है।
says: What does the Sun do? It keeps adding salt to the sea; the Sun keeps Varuna's water in balance by supplying salt.
ambiguity: Metaphor for the Sun's regulating role over Neptune's water.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: जब बहुत ज्यादा पानी हो जाता है समुद्र में। समुद्र कहां है आपके अंदर? पेट में। खूब पानी आ जाता है।
says: When there is too much water in the sea, where is the sea inside you? In the stomach, where a lot of water collects; Neptune's sea corresponds to the stomach and body water.
classical_check: Silent on Neptune; classical water and stomach tie to Moon and Cancer.

hindi: नमक खाया। नमक ने बांध दिया। आपके शरीर के अंदर नमक कम हो गया।
says: You eat salt, the salt binds the water, then the salt in the body drops; salt is what holds Neptune's water in check, and low salt means the Sun's binding is reduced.
ambiguity: Physiology used as analogy; not a chart rule.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: जैसे आकाश जैसे समुद्र में नमक कम। जैसे ही नमक कम होता है बचे हुए फालतू पानी को समुद्र ऊपर फेंक देता है। चलो बादल बन जाओ धरती पर गिरो।
says: As with the sky and sea, when salt falls the sea throws the surplus water upward, telling it to become cloud and fall on earth; he uses the water cycle as an image of the body expelling extra water.
ambiguity: Analogy only.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: ऐसे हमारे शरीर में नमक कम हो गया। जैसे इलेक्ट्रोलाइट्स कहते हैं इसको कम हो गए उल्टी हो जाती है।
says: In the body, when salt (electrolytes) falls, vomiting follows; he maps low electrolytes to vomiting as the body throwing out extra water, as an example of the Sun leaving Neptune.
ambiguity: A physiology statement used as analogy; recorded, not endorsed as medical advice.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: हाजमा खराब इंटेस्टाइन की बैंड बज गई। क्यों? सूर्य बहुत दूर हो गया है। सूर्य नाराज है वरुण से।
says: Bad digestion and a wrecked intestine come because the Sun has moved very far from Neptune and is displeased with it; digestive upset is read as the Sun-Neptune rift. Tradition claim, not a diagnosis.
ambiguity: No specific chart placement is given other than the Sun being far from Neptune.
classical_check: Silent; the classical body-part for digestion is the 5th house, Sun or Mars.

hindi: वरुण कह रहा है अरे मैं क्या करूं? मेरे अंदर सुनामी ले आए। इसीलिए सुनामी आती रहती है।
says: Varuna says what can I do, they brought a tsunami inside me; hence tsunamis keep coming; he reads sea disasters as Neptune's reaction when the Sun deserts it.
classical_check: Silent; natural disasters are not classically tied to Neptune.

hindi: लैंड ऑफ द राइजिंग सन जापान वहां सबसे ज्यादा सुनामी आती है क्योंकि वहीं शुरू-शुर में आता है सूरज। फिर वो दूर चला जाता है।
says: Japan, land of the rising sun, gets the most tsunamis because the Sun arrives there first and then goes far away; he ties Japan's tsunamis to the Sun's daily rising and departure rather than to tectonics.
ambiguity: Geophysical claim; Japan's tsunamis come from plate tectonics.
classical_check: Silent; not a Jyotish rule and not supported by geophysics.

hindi: प्रकृति भी ये कार्य कर रही है। आपको उल्टी हो रही है। पेट खराब हो रहा है।
says: Nature is doing the same in your body, so you vomit and your stomach goes bad; the body repeats the sea's behaviour when Sun and Neptune part.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: यानी आपके सूर्य को सात नंबर राशि का लफड़ा चल रहा है।
says: So your Sun has trouble with sign number 7 (Libra); a Sun in Libra is the case where the Sun is far from Neptune and upsets the sea inside the body.
cells_derived_method: The Sun in Libra appears in a different house for each lagna, so the topic of the trouble moves with the house: 1st (self), 4th (home), 7th (partner), 10th (career).

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Sun in Libra in the 1st house (lagna Libra) shows the trouble as ego and health vitality.
Derived: Sun in Libra in the 4th house (lagna Cancer) shows the trouble as inner peace and mother.
Derived: Sun in Libra in the 7th house (lagna Aries) shows the trouble as partners and public dealings.
Derived: Sun in Libra in the 10th house (lagna Capricorn) shows the trouble as status and career authority.

ambiguity: 'सात नंबर राशि' is read as sign number 7 (Libra), since signs are numbered Aries 1 through Pisces 12 in this series.
classical_check: Agrees: Sun is debilitated in Libra.

hindi: इसीलिए सूर्य दो नंबर और सात नंबर की राशि में सबसे सत्यानाशी है।
says: That is why the Sun is most ruinous in the signs numbered 2 and 7, Taurus and Libra; these are the two worst signs for the Sun.
cells_derived_method: Sun in Taurus or Libra ruins the Sun's house topic. The house changes by lagna: Taurus 2nd gives family-speech troubles, Taurus 10th career trouble, Libra 7th partner trouble.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Sun in Taurus in the 10th house (lagna Leo) gives a sullied name and career friction.
Derived: Sun in Taurus in the 4th house (lagna Aquarius) gives disturbed home and heart.
Derived: Sun in Libra in the 7th house (lagna Aries) gives damaged marriage and partnerships.
Derived: Sun in Libra in the 1st house (lagna Libra) gives weak vitality and identity.

ambiguity: Number 2 could be a sign number, but he later says 'दो और सात नंबर राशि' explicitly.
classical_check: Partly differs: classically only Libra is the Sun's debilitation; Taurus is an enemy sign (Venus's) but not debilitation.

hindi: वरुण से नाराज हो जाता है। तूफान आते हैं।
says: The Sun becomes angry with Varuna and storms come; once the Sun is displeased with Neptune, upheavals appear in life.
ambiguity: Starts at the chunk break, completing 'the Sun gets angry with Varuna'.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: आपको उल्टी दस्त उल्टी दस्त चलता रहता है। आपके ऑपरेशन होते रहते हैं। हार्ट की प्रॉब्लम होती है। मल्टीपल डिफरेंटली।
says: Lists the results of the Sun being angry with Neptune: continuing vomiting and diarrhoea, repeated operations and heart problems, in several different ways; these are traditional claims, not diagnoses.
ambiguity: Health outcomes are asserted without naming the house; flagged, not endorsed.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: इसीलिए सूर्य तीन नंबर राशि में बढ़िया, चार में ओके, छह में बढ़िया, दो और सात नंबर में सत्यानाश।
says: Gives his rating of the Sun by sign: good in sign 3 (Gemini), okay in 4 (Cancer), good in 6 (Virgo), and ruined in 2 and 7 (Taurus and Libra).
cells_derived_method: The sign rating is the Sun's strength; the house then decides which life area gets the good or bad effect. Good signs in strong houses (1, 5, 9, 10) give gain; the ruined signs in the same houses give loss.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Sun in Gemini in the 10th house (lagna Virgo) gives career gain through communication and trade.
Derived: Sun in Virgo in the 5th house (lagna Taurus) gives analytical intelligence and sound children matters.
Derived: Sun in Cancer in the 7th house (lagna Capricorn) gives acceptable, emotionally tied partnerships, only okay.
Derived: Sun in Libra in the 9th house (lagna Aquarius) ruins luck, father and dharma matters.

ambiguity: All numbers read as sign numbers; whether 'ok' and 'good' are far apart is not defined.
