classical_check: Partly agrees: Gemini and Cancer are friend signs for Sun, Virgo is neutral to friendly; Taurus is an enemy sign and Libra debilitation.

hindi: अगर सूर्य आपकी कुंडली में दो और सात नंबर राशि का है तो बर्बाद है।
says: If your Sun is in sign 2 or sign 7 in your chart it is wrecked; Taurus or Libra Sun means a ruined Sun.
ambiguity: Whether this is judged only in D1 or also in D9 is not said.
classical_check: Partly differs: Taurus is not a debilitation sign for the Sun.

hindi: इसे कहा जाता है कि सूर्य नीच का हो गया।
says: This condition is called the Sun becoming neech, debilitated; he labels both Taurus and Libra as Sun debilitation.
ambiguity: 'Neech' normally means only the exact debilitation sign; here it is stretched to both signs.
classical_check: Differs: classical debilitation of the Sun is only Libra.

hindi: इसलिए वरुण देवता के साथ विशेष तौर की खुंदक बन जाती है। आपके जीवन में तूफान आते हैं।
says: Therefore a special grudge forms with Varuna, and storms come in your life; a Sun in Taurus or Libra has a particular enmity with Neptune, so the sea turns on you.
ambiguity: Link to signs 2 and 7 is inferred from the sentence before it.
classical_check: Silent on Neptune.

hindi: अगर आपको लंग्स की प्रॉब्लम, चेस्ट की प्रॉब्लम, चेस्ट पे हड्डी की प्रॉब्लम, छाती में दर्द होता है, आपके जीवन के अंदर और परेशानियां है, हार्ट रिलेटेड सारी की सारी वरुण खराब।
says: Lung trouble, chest trouble, chest-bone trouble, chest pain and all heart-related problems are put down to a spoiled Varuna (Neptune). Recorded as his claim, not a diagnosis.
ambiguity: Health claim; flagged, not endorsed.
classical_check: Differs: classically chest and lungs fall to Cancer and Moon or Mercury, and heart to Sun.

hindi: क्यों? दिल टूट गया। दिल टूट गया।
says: Why does Varuna go bad? Because of heartbreak; emotional heartbreak is the cause of Neptune's damage.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: ये दिल टूटना जो क्लेश है ना जिस व्यक्ति ने माफ करना और साफ करना नहीं सीखा कोई फायदा नहीं।

hindi: राम को देखो मर्यादा सूर्यवंशी 12 कला संपूर्ण 12 जोोडियक हृदय चक्र छाती के बिल्कुल पास हार्ट

ambiguity: Equation of Pluto with Yama is his scheme (Pluto is called Yama).
classical_check: Agrees with the Puranic stories of Satyavan-Savitri and Nachiketa with Yama.

hindi: आपको मृत्यु का देवता जीवन देगा जब सूर्य की कृपा होगी तो सोच के चलो तो आपके कुंडली में यदि ऐसे ग्रह पड़े हैं तो आप तो किसी के पास भी बैठ जाओगे मरने भी नहीं दोगे उसे।
says: The god of death will give you life when the Sun's grace is there, so if such planets sit in your chart you can sit beside anyone and not let him die; the Sun-Pluto person has a life-restoring presence.
ambiguity: Colloquial; a statement about uplifting presence rather than medical power.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: ऐसा कहते हैं भाई तेरे पास बैठ के तो मेरे अंदर वापस जिंदगी लौट आई। यह सूर्य और प्लूटो का कार्यक्रम है।
says: People say brother, sitting near you brought life back into me; this is the Sun and Pluto's doing; the life-restoring presence is a Sun-Pluto signature.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: अब जो हम मेजरली कुंडली देखते हैं उसमें काल पुरुष की कुंडली कहा जाता है जिसमें हर भाव के अंदर होती राशि को डाल दिया जाता है। कि वो स्टेबल राशियां हो गई।
says: The chart we mainly read has a base called the Kalapurusha chart, where a fixed sign is placed in every house so that the signs are stable; the natural zodiac provides the fixed house-sign pairing.
classical_check: Agrees with the classical Kalapurusha (natural zodiac) with Aries as the 1st house.

hindi: कायदे की बात ले चल तो एक नंबर है। यह मंगल की राशि है। दो नंबर शुक्र की है। तीन नंबर बुध, चार चंद्र, पांच सूर्य, छह राहु, सात वरुण।
says: Gives the fixed lords of the signs: number 1 Mars, 2 Venus, 3 Mercury, 4 Moon, 5 Sun, 6 Rahu, 7 Varuna (Neptune); in his scheme Virgo goes to Rahu and Libra to Neptune.
cells_derived_method: The fixed lord of each sign sits in the corresponding kalapurusha house: Mars in the 1st, Venus in the 2nd, Mercury in the 3rd, Moon in the 4th, Sun in the 5th, Rahu in the 6th, Neptune in the 7th.
ambiguity: He gives Virgo to Rahu and Libra to Neptune rather than Mercury and Venus; elsewhere he gives both signs two lords.
classical_check: Partly differs: classically Virgo is Mercury's and Libra is Venus's; Rahu and Neptune as lords are his own scheme.

hindi: इस कुंडली के फिक्स्ड खानों में अगर हम सारे नंबर हटा दें तो ये ये ग्रह इस खाने में एक प्रकार की मलकियत लिए बैठे हैं। के भैया ये तो मेरा ही है घर।
says: In the fixed boxes of this chart, if we remove all the sign numbers, each of these planets sits in its box with a kind of ownership, saying this is my house; the natural-zodiac planet owns its own house.
classical_check: Agrees with the natural zodiac idea of house lordship in the Kalapurusha.

hindi: अब कोई बात नहीं जैसा जो बच्चा पैदा हुआ उसकी जो राशि घूमी है उसके अनुसार हो सकता है यहां वाले घर में पांच के बजाय तीन नंबर हो तो बुध का हो गया 10 नंबर हो तो शनि का हो सकता है फिर शनि के अनुसार क्या है पर ये इनके मुख्य घर है
says: In a real birth chart the signs rotate according to the child's birth, so the fifth box may hold sign 3 (Mercury's) or sign 10 (Saturn's) instead of sign 5, and the box then follows that sign's lord; but the fixed boxes remain these planets' main homes.
cells_derived_method: The house keeps its natural owner while the sign in it supplies the actual lord. For the 5th house: with Gemini it is Mercury's sign (lagna Aquarius) and with Capricorn it is Saturn's (lagna Virgo).

derived_examples.reading: Derived: 5th house holds Gemini (lagna Aquarius), so Mercury becomes its lord while the Sun stays the natural owner of the 5th.
Derived: 5th house holds Capricorn (lagna Virgo), so Saturn becomes its lord while the Sun stays the natural owner.
Derived: 10th house holds Aries (lagna Cancer), so Mars becomes its lord while Saturn stays the natural owner of the 10th.

ambiguity: 'यहां वाले घर में पांच के बजाय' is a gesture; it is read as the 5th house, since the Sun's fixed sign is 5.
classical_check: Agrees with the difference between natural house lord (karaka) and the actual sign lord.

hindi: उसके बाद किराए पे दिए हुए घर है एक प्रकार से मान के चलें
says: After that come the rented-out houses, as it were; when another sign sits in a box, its lord is like a tenant in the planet's own house.
classical_check: Silent; an analogy for the natural-lord versus sign-lord difference.

hindi: तो हमारी कुंडली के अंदर प्रमुखतः यह होता है मैं मायसेल्फ खुद यह मेरा होता है कार्य यह होता है मेरा घर। यह मेरा साथी, पत्नी या पति।
says: In our chart the main points are: this is me, myself; this is my work; this is my home; this is my partner, wife or husband; the four pillar houses (1, 10, 4, 7) he points to.
ambiguity: The house numbers are spoken by pointing; the topics (self, work, home, partner) point to houses 1, 10, 4 and 7.
classical_check: Agrees: 1 self, 10 karma, 4 home, 7 spouse.

hindi: यह हमारे
says: Begins to point to the next house, saying this is our; the topic follows in the next chunk (death, dharma, loss).
ambiguity: Fragment cut at the chunk edge; it carries no meaning on its own and is continued in the next row.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: मृत्यु, धर्म, लॉस या खर्चा।
says: Lists death, dharma, and loss or expense as the houses he is pointing at, which are the 8th, 9th and 12th.
ambiguity: House numbers are not spoken; they follow from the standard topics.
classical_check: Agrees: 8th death, 9th dharma, 12th loss and expense.

hindi: यह मोक्ष का खाना भी यही है। यह शत्रु का है।
says: This box is also the moksha house, and this other one is the box of enemies; the 12th is moksha and the 6th is enemies.
ambiguity: House numbers are gestures; read from topics.
classical_check: Agrees: 12th is moksha and loss, 6th is enemies.

hindi: यह विद्या, पुरुषार्थ और वैभव यह पुरुषार्थ है। यह आपका धन इत्यादि।
says: This box is learning, effort and splendour, this one is purushartha (self-effort), and this is your wealth; he points to the 5th, 3rd and 2nd houses.
ambiguity: House numbers are gestures; the 5th, 3rd and 2nd are inferred from learning, effort and wealth.
classical_check: Agrees: 5th vidya, 3rd effort or courage, 2nd wealth.

hindi: वैभव मित्रता सेवक यहां मित्र होता है मां होती है पिता होते हैं बहुत सारे
says: Lists splendour, friendship and servants, and the places where a friend, mother and father sit; the caption mixes the 11th (friends and gains), the 4th (mother) and the 9th or 10th (father).
ambiguity: Garbled and gesture-driven; the exact houses for father and servants are not recoverable.
classical_check: Agrees in part: 4th mother, 11th friends; father is the 9th or 10th and servants the 6th.

hindi: यह हमारा लाभ जो हमारा सूर्य है यह सूर्यकि मैं ही है सब कुछ वही है सारा आधारभूत है
says: This is our gain, and our Sun, the Sun is everything and is the base of all; the garbled phrase says the Sun is the foundation of all the houses.
ambiguity: Garbled; 'सूर्यकि मैं ही है' is unclear and the gesture to 'gain' (11th) is a guess.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: तो सूर्य यानी कि एक नंबर में लग्न में सर्वश्रेष्ठ है बेस्टेस्ट है सूर्य की पोजीशन यहां पर बेस्ट है सूर्य एक नंबर में उच्च उच्च है यहां सूर्य एक नंबर का उच्च होता है।
says: So the Sun in number 1, the lagna, is the best of all; the Sun's position is best here; and the Sun is exalted in number 1 (Aries).
cells_derived_method: Sun in the 1st house in any sign is given a high rating, and Sun in Aries in any house is exalted; the two best cells combine as Sun in Aries in the 1st house (lagna Aries).

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Sun in Aries in the 1st house (lagna Aries) is the maximum case, both lagna-placed and exalted.
Derived: Sun in Libra in the 1st house (lagna Libra) gains from lagna placement but loses from its weak sign, so the mix is uneven.
Derived: Sun in Aries in the 7th house (lagna Libra) is exalted but not in lagna, so strong through sign but weaker by house.

ambiguity: 'एक नंबर में' is both the lagna house box and the sign number 1 here; he does not separate the two.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Sun exalted in Aries is classical; Sun in the lagna is generally mixed, with some texts calling it a mild affliction.

hindi: बेस्ट आपके लग्न में पड़ा हुआ सूर्य आपकी कुंडली के हजारों दोषों को उड़ा देता है। घर के
says: A Sun sitting in your lagna blows away thousands of doshas of your chart; the lagna Sun is a general cancellation of faults.
cells_derived_method: Applies to the Sun in the 1st house in any sign; stronger in Aries and Leo, and weaker in Libra.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Sun in own sign Leo in the 1st house (lagna Leo) is the case where the dosha-cancelling power is strongest.
Derived: Sun in Libra in the 1st house (lagna Libra) is the weakest case, where the dosha-removing power is doubtful.

ambiguity: The sentence is cut off ('घर के') and may continue with the home or house matters.
classical_check: Differs: classical texts treat Sun in the lagna as mixed; the blanket dosha-removal claim is his.

hindi: अंदर E5 जो होता है उसे सूर्य का स्थान कहा गया है।
says: Inside the house, the zone called E5 is said to be the Sun's place; in the vastu grid the fifth east pada belongs to Surya.
ambiguity: 'E5' is how the caption renders the vastu east pada number 5; the house chart is not involved.
classical_check: Agrees with the 32-pada Mahavastu grid where E5 is Surya.

hindi: सूर्य है, सत्य है, वृष है। इस प्रकार अंतरिक्ष ऐसे देवता चलते हैं।
says: Lists the vastu deities of the east side in order: Surya, Satya, Bhrisha and Antariksha, so the Sun's pada is followed by these three.
ambiguity: Caption has 'वृष' for Bhrisha and 'अंतरिक्ष' for Antariksha.
classical_check: Agrees with the east padas E5 to E8 (Surya, Satya, Bhrisha, Antariksha) in the Mahavastu 32-pada grid.

hindi: E5 का देवता सूर्य पांच नंबर E5 बंद होना चाहिए घर के अंदर।
says: The deity of E5 is the Sun, number five, and the caption says E5 should be closed inside the house; the caption may have flipped open and closed, so the instruction for the Sun's zone is unclear.
ambiguity: 'बंद होना चाहिए' (should be closed) contradicts the next sentence, which treats a missing E5 door as harmful; probably the original was 'should be open' or 'should not be closed'.
classical_check: Classical vastu allows an entrance at E5 (Surya pada) as a good one; blocking it is not recommended.

hindi: यदि वहां से सूर्य के लिए E5 का द्वार रह जाता है, तो उस घर में कोई कम्युनिकेशन नहीं होती, कोई मान सम्मान नहीं, कोई इज्जत नहीं।
says: If the door for the Sun at E5 is left out (or blocked), that house has no communication, no honour and no respect; vastu failure of the Sun's zone shows up as loss of dignity and speech at home.
ambiguity: The verb 'रह जाता है' (is left) is garbled and may stand for 'is not there' or 'is closed'; the loss of respect is the stated result.
classical_check: Silent in classical Jyotish; vastu tradition links the east Sun zone to honour and status.

hindi: यानी कि सूर्य आपका मान देता है, सम्मान देता है। धन का हिसाब, बड़े बुजुर्गों की इज्जत, प्रेम और आशीर्वाद देने की शक्ति।
says: The Sun gives you esteem and honour, and also governs accounting of money, respect for elders, love and the power to give blessings.
classical_check: Agrees on honour and elders (Sun as father and authority); money accounting is his addition.

hindi: पांचवा घर पांच नंबर की राशि सूर्य की बाय डिफॉल्ट है।
says: The fifth house, the box of sign number 5 (Leo), belongs to the Sun by default; the natural zodiac gives the 5th house to the Sun.
cells_derived_method: The 5th box with its default sign Leo is the Kalapurusha pairing (lagna Aries); in actual charts the 5th house holds other signs, and the Sun stays its natural karaka.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: in a chart with Libra in the 5th house (lagna Gemini) Venus is the sign lord, while the Sun remains the natural owner of the house.
Derived: in a chart with Aries in the 5th house (lagna Sagittarius) Mars is the sign lord, with the Sun still the house karaka.

ambiguity: 'पांच नंबर की राशि' is sign 5 (Leo) in the natural zodiac.
classical_check: Agrees: Sun is karaka of the 5th house and Leo is the 5th sign.

hindi: यहां से हमारे पूर्व जन्म के संस्कार देखते हैं। यहां से इंट्यूटिव पावर्स देखते हैं।
says: From the 5th house we read our past-life impressions (sanskars) and our intuitive powers.
cells_derived_method: A planet in the 5th house, or the 5th lord, shows the past-life impressions; the sign in the 5th modifies the type of intuition (water signs emotional, fire signs inspired, air signs mental).

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Pisces in the 5th house (lagna Scorpio) gives deep, dreamy intuition and strong past-life memory.
Derived: Aries in the 5th house (lagna Sagittarius) gives quick, instinctive and bold intuition.
Derived: Virgo in the 5th house (lagna Taurus) gives analytic, discriminating intuition tied to detail.

classical_check: Agrees: the 5th is purva punya (past merit) and intelligence.

hindi: इंट्यूशन संतान पितृ कृपा भी यहीं है।
says: Intuition, children and the grace of ancestors are all in the 5th house as well.
cells_derived_method: Benefic planets in the 5th (or aspecting it) show ancestral grace and healthy children; malefics show trouble. The sign in the 5th adds flavour.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Cancer in the 5th house (lagna Pisces) with a benefic gives a caring, emotionally supportive child and ancestral blessing.
Derived: Capricorn in the 5th house (lagna Virgo) gives slow or delayed children and a duty-bound link to ancestors.

classical_check: Agrees: 5th is putra (children) and purva punya.

hindi: पितृ दोष भी यहीं है। दोष या कृपा पितरों का स्थान यह है।
says: Pitru dosha is also in this house; the 5th house is the place of the ancestors, where either their fault (dosha) or their grace shows.
cells_derived_method: Sun, Rahu or Saturn affecting the 5th shows the dosha; Jupiter or Moon aspecting it shows grace.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Rahu with the Sun in Leo in the 5th house (lagna Aries) is a pitru dosha picture in the 5th.
Derived: Jupiter in own sign Sagittarius in the 5th house (lagna Leo) is a strong grace from ancestors.

classical_check: Differs partly: classical pitru dosha is mostly judged from the 9th house and the Sun, though the 5th also shows purva punya.

hindi: राहु लेकिन पितृ दोष और कृपा पांचवें घर से मंगल भी दे सकता है। राहु भी, बुध भी, केतु भी कुछ भी दोष भी दे सकता है, फायदा भी, नुकसान भी।
says: Pitru dosha or grace from the 5th house can also come through Mars, Rahu, Mercury or Ketu; any planet sitting there can give fault or benefit, gain or loss, not only the Sun.
cells_derived_method: The planet in the 5th decides the colour: Rahu confusion about children, Ketu detachment from them, Mars harshness, Mercury clever but changeable.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mars in own sign Aries in the 5th house (lagna Sagittarius) gives bold, energetic children and impulsive judgement.
Derived: Mercury in own sign Gemini in the 5th house (lagna Aquarius) gives clever, talkative children and quick learning.
Derived: Ketu in Scorpio in the 5th house (lagna Cancer) gives detachment around children and strong past-life pull.

ambiguity: The first words are garbled ('राहु लेकिन') and the sentence looks like a restart.
classical_check: Agrees in general that any planet in the 5th changes the children and merit results.

hindi: यहां सूर्य का ही खाना है।
says: Still, this box belongs only to the Sun; whatever other planets give, the 5th house is the Sun's own box.
classical_check: Agrees that the Sun is the natural karaka of the 5th house.

hindi: यानी सूर्य के पास यह सारी रिस्पांसिबिलिटीज़ भी है। आप कितने पोटेंट हैं। क्या आपको संतान प्राप्ति हुई? क्या संतान होने के बाद लाभ हुआ? घाटा हुआ। ये सूर्य के पास है।
says: So the Sun carries all these responsibilities: how potent you are, whether you get children, and whether gain or loss followed after children; all of this lies with the Sun. A tradition claim about fertility, not a medical statement.
cells_derived_method: The Sun's strength in the 5th house, or the Sun as lord of the 5th (Aries lagna would have the Sun as 5th lord), shows potency and the result of children.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Sun in own sign Leo in the 5th house (lagna Aries) gives strong potency and gain through children.
Derived: Sun debilitated in Libra in the 5th house (lagna Gemini) shows struggle with children and a loss afterwards.

ambiguity: Potency is a medical-sounding term; recorded as a tradition claim only.
classical_check: Agrees that Sun in the 5th is a classical putra-affecting placement (often reducing children).

hindi: इस घर ये लग्न मैं हो गया। खुद अपने बारे में सूर्य बताता है।
says: This house, the lagna, is the I; the Sun tells about yourself; the 1st house and the Sun are the self.
classical_check: Agrees: lagna is the self and Sun is atma karaka.

hindi: और यह हमारी विद्या। इस पांचवें से पुनः पांचवा गुरु है। यह धर्म है।
says: This is our learning (5th house); the fifth from this fifth is the guru and dharma, which is the 9th house.
ambiguity: House numbers are spoken only as 'fifth from the fifth'; the 9th is derived by counting.
classical_check: Agrees: 5th is vidya and the 9th is guru and dharma.

hindi: यह इस जन्म का भाग है। यह उस जन्म का भाग है। इस प्रकार लगा लो। कोई उसे पिछले जन्म का भाग कहता है। कोई इसे इस जन्म का भाग कोई फर्क नहीं।
says: One of these boxes is this birth's share and the other is that birth's share; some call it the previous birth's portion and some this birth's, and it makes no difference; the 5th and 9th houses carry fortune from different births.
ambiguity: He does not say which house is which birth; the 5th and 9th are inferred from the sentence before it.
classical_check: Agrees that the 5th is purva punya and the 9th is bhagya; the exact split is not defined here.

hindi: यानी भाग्य का जितना भी निर्धारण है चंद्रमा के पास भाग्य है।
says: All determination of fortune rests with the Moon; the Moon holds fortune (bhagya) in his scheme.
classical_check: Differs: classically fortune is the 9th house, Jupiter and the 9th lord; the Moon as chief fortune planet is his view.

hindi: ये जन्म पत्री है। प्रारब्ध है। 12% है। ये 100 को ले ली लेता है आपके जीवन के अंदर।
says: The birth chart is prarabdha, fate, and it is 12 percent; yet this 12 percent takes over the whole 100 in your life; a small fixed fate share can swallow all of life if left uncorrected.
ambiguity: 'ले ली लेता है' is a stammer; the figure of 12 percent is stated, not derived.
classical_check: Silent; the 12 percent share is his number.

hindi: इसे 12% ही रखना है, बढ़ने नहीं देना है। इसको करेक्टिव मेजर पे लाना है।
says: This share must be kept at 12 percent and not allowed to grow; bring it under corrective measures; remedies are meant to cap fate at its fixed part.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: इसके द्वारा सत्यानाश नहीं करना है। आशीर्वाद लेना है, कृपा लेनी है।
says: Do not let this fate share ruin you; take blessings and grace instead; blessings are the means of keeping fate from destroying life.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: यह आपके सूर्य के पास ताकत है। और इस सूर्य की ताकत को इनक्ट करने के लिए बृहस्पति काम आता है।
says: That power lies with your Sun, and to enact (put into effect) the Sun's power Jupiter is what is used; Jupiter is the planet that carries out the Sun's strength.
ambiguity: 'इनक्ट' (enact) is a garbled English word.
classical_check: Silent; consistent with Jupiter as the friend of the Sun.

hindi: यानी आपके जीवन का जो भी धर्म निभाना है, वह सारी की सारी कृपा सूर्य देवता की कृपा से ही हो सकती है।
says: Whatever duty (dharma) you have to fulfil in life can only be done through the grace of the Sun deity; the Sun is the source of the strength to perform one's dharma.
classical_check: Agrees with Sun as dharma and soul karaka.

hindi: आपके कुंडली के अंदर एक नंबर का सूर्य यदि होता है, दो नंबर होता है, तीन नंबर होता है। हम यह बात कर रहे हैं। एक नंबर का
says: Introduces the next topic: the Sun placed in your chart at number 1, number 2 and number 3; here 'number' means house (bhava), as the following lines make clear, not sign.
ambiguity: Earlier in the batch 'number' meant sign; here the later text says 'दूसरे नंबर दूसरे भाव में', which shows it means house.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: सूर्य होता है, तो वह राजा समान व्यक्ति होता है। राजा राज दरबारी होगा। राजा के समान होगा, जैसे राजा रहता है।
says: If the Sun is in the 1st house, the person is king-like; he will be a king or a courtier, living as a king lives; Sun in the lagna gives royal bearing.
cells_derived_method: Sun in the 1st house in any sign gives royal bearing; Aries and Leo add most, while Libra reduces it.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Sun in own sign Leo in the 1st house (lagna Leo) gives a truly regal, commanding nature.
Derived: Sun exalted in Aries in the 1st house (lagna Aries) gives a bold, leader-like king figure.
Derived: Sun in Libra in the 1st house (lagna Libra) gives royal pretension with a weak base.

ambiguity: The sentence begins mid-thought; 'एक नंबर का सूर्य' comes from the end of the previous chunk.
classical_check: Agrees in general: Sun in the lagna gives authority and a regal appearance.

hindi: यानी आप समाज की सेवा में इतना काम करेगा वो आदमी समाज को देने वाला।
says: Such a man works so much in the service of society; he is a giver to society; the lagna Sun person is a public provider.
classical_check: Silent; Sun as protector and giver is a general karaka.

hindi: किसी भी राशि का हो अभी यह बात नहीं हो रही। अच्छी बुरी राशि की बात है। राशि अपसेट होने से आप कर्म चेंज कर सकते हैं। उसके उपाय अभी बात कर करेंगे।
says: Whatever the sign is, that is not being discussed now; good or bad sign is a separate matter; if the sign is upset you can change your actions; remedies will be discussed later; house placement is judged apart from sign.
classical_check: Differs from the classical joint reading of sign and house; he separates them in this section.

hindi: यहां राजा होता है व्यक्ति। आप राजसी राजपाट की जॉब कर सकते हैं।
says: Here the person is a king, and you can take up a royal, administrative-power job; Sun in the lagna points to work in positions of authority.
classical_check: Agrees that Sun in the 1st or 10th gives authority and administrative careers.

hindi: अगर एक नंबर का सूर्य या पांच नंबर का सूर्य आपका राशि चेंज करके आ रहा है। भाव चलित में आ रहा है। केपी में आ रहा है तो आपको गवर्नमेंट जॉब लग सकती है।
says: If the Sun of house 1 or house 5 arrives there after a sign change, in bhava chalit or in KP, you can get a government job; the Sun reaching the 1st or 5th house in the shifted chart gives government employment.
cells_derived_method: A Sun that is in the 12th or 4th house in D1 but moves into the 1st or 5th house in the bhava chalit or KP view gets this result. The sign of the D1 placement differs from the chalit house sign, so the sign-house pair changes.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Sun late in Pisces in the 12th house (lagna Aries) may fall into the 1st bhava in chalit; government work is promised.
Derived: Sun late in Scorpio in the 4th house (lagna Leo) may fall into the 5th bhava in chalit or KP; government work is promised.

ambiguity: 'राशि चेंज करके' is read as the Sun's sign-house changing in the chalit or KP view, not the D1 sign.
classical_check: Agrees that the Sun in the 10th or strong houses shows government service; the chalit and KP route is his addition.

hindi: यानी सूर्य ही आपकी गवर्नमेंट है। आज हमारा सोलर सिस्टम में सूर्य क्या कर रहा है। सूर्य पूरी गवर्नमेंट चला रहा है।
says: The Sun is your government; in our solar system the Sun is running the entire government; the Sun is the karaka of state and government.
classical_check: Agrees: Sun is the karaka of government and rulers.

gist: If the Sun is there the whole government is there, if not nothing exists, everybody would die.

hindi: दूसरे नंबर का सूर्य धनवान बनाता है। कुटुंब देता है।
says: The Sun in the 2nd house makes a person wealthy and gives a family (kutumb).
cells_derived_method: The 2nd house Sun gives wealth and family, adjusted by the sign it sits in; Leo or Aries add strength while Libra reduces the wealth.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Sun in Taurus in the 2nd house (lagna Aries) gives steady wealth but sharp speech and some stubbornness in family.
Derived: Sun in Cancer in the 2nd house (lagna Gemini) gives wealth through emotional or nurturing work and a caring family.
Derived: Sun in Libra in the 2nd house (lagna Virgo) gives weakened wealth and strain in family speech.

ambiguity: Here 'number' means house; the sign is set aside in the next lines.
classical_check: Differs: classical texts treat Sun in the 2nd as a mixed placement, often harming family and speech though helping wealth.

hindi: कुटुंब यह दानवीर कर्ण की तरह कहा गया।
says: The 2nd-house family or kutumb quality is likened to Karna the great donor; the 2nd-house Sun gives the Karna type, a person of great giving.
classical_check: Silent; Karna is the Sun's son in the Mahabharata, which fits the analogy.

hindi: कर्ण जिसका दूसरा सूर्य होता है वो किसी की भी मदद के लिए पागल होता रहता है।
says: For a Karna-type person with the Sun in the 2nd house, he is crazy to help anybody at all.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: नीच तुल्य है। अगर बुरा फल दे रहा है तो नीच तुल्य करेगा।
says: The result is lowly-like (neech-tulya); if the Sun gives a bad result from the 2nd house, he will act in a lowly way; the 2nd house Sun can give base behaviour when afflicted.
cells_derived_method: Sun in the 2nd with Rahu, Saturn or Mars gives lowly speech and conduct, while Jupiter's aspect softens it.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Sun in Capricorn in the 2nd house (lagna Sagittarius) with Saturn gives hard, base speech and miserliness.
Derived: Sun in Scorpio in the 2nd house (lagna Libra) with Rahu gives manipulative speech.

ambiguity: 'नीच तुल्य' means 'like debilitation' and is not a sign claim here.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: करण ने भी नीच तुल्य ही काम किए हैं। लेकिन होता दानवीर करण है। करण ने बुरे का ही साथ दिया।
says: Karna too did lowly deeds, yet he remains the great donor, and he sided with the bad one (Duryodhana); the 2nd-house Sun person gives generously but allies with the wrong side.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: लेकिन करण ने ही अपने सत्यानाश भी कराया। बेफालतू में दुख पाया। कुटुंब का सत्यानाश किया।
says: But Karna also ruined himself, suffered needlessly and destroyed his family; the 2nd-house Sun type causes his own and his family's ruin through misplaced loyalty.
classical_check: Agrees with the classical view that Sun in the 2nd can harm family.

hindi: कुटुंब उस व्यक्ति का होता ही नहीं ढंग से। कुटुंब में उसकी किसी से नहीं बनती कटती।
says: Such a person does not really have a proper family and gets along with no one in it; the 2nd-house Sun shows a strained or absent family bond.
ambiguity: This contradicts the earlier line that the 2nd-house Sun gives a family; he later reconciles it with sign dependence.
classical_check: Agrees that Sun in the 2nd can strain family ties.

hindi: लेकिन दानवीर कर्ण होता है। साथ देता है तो ऐसा साथ देता है कि मर जाऊंगा छोडूंगा नहीं। कोई भी भाव में हो। हां।
says: But he is still the Karna donor; once he stands with someone he says I will die but not leave; he is loyal to the death, in whatever house this applies.
ambiguity: 'कोई भी भाव में हो' (in any house) is vague; it may mean the loyalty trait shows in any house, or he is returning to the 2nd-house Sun.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: हां। दूसरे नंबर दूसरे भाव में राशि क्या है वो तो डिपेंड करती है। प्लस भी हो सकती है, माइनस भी।
says: In the 2nd house what the sign is matters; it can be plus or minus; the sign in the 2nd house decides whether the result is good or bad.
cells_derived_method: The 2nd house Sun in Leo, Aries or Sagittarius would be plus; in Libra or Taurus (his bad signs) minus.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Sun in own sign Leo in the 2nd house (lagna Cancer) shows a plus: honoured wealth and speech.
Derived: Sun in Libra in the 2nd house (lagna Virgo) shows a minus: wealth and family speech suffer.

classical_check: Agrees that sign dignity changes the house result.

hindi: दूसरे घर का सूर्य तो हम यहां घर भाव की बात कर। भाव की बात कर रहे हैं। राशि तो दो नंबर ही एक्टिव है। एक तरह से यह दो नंबर की राशि एक्टिवेट है।
says: For the Sun in the 2nd house he is talking about the house (bhava), and the sign that is active there is sign number 2, Taurus; in a way sign 2 gets activated by the house, so the 2nd house wakes the second sign's energy.
cells_derived_method: Each house activates its natural sign's energy regardless of the actual sign in it: the 2nd house activates Taurus's nature (wealth, speech, family) in any chart.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Sun in Aries in the 2nd house (lagna Pisces) is exalted by sign but the 2nd house also activates Taurus's wealth-speech nature, so both act together.
Derived: Sun in Scorpio in the 2nd house (lagna Libra) combines Scorpio's intensity with Taurus's wealth-speech activation.

ambiguity: This is close to the multi-sign idea (a house touched by its natural sign and the actual sign), but he does not use that wording.
classical_check: Agrees with the natural-zodiac link between a house and its Kalapurusha sign.

hindi: स्थान का जोर है कि इस स्थान के जोर में क्या होगा? ये इतना पावरफुल स्थान है कि यहां पर दानवीर कर्ण जैसा होता है व्यक्तित्व उस व्यक्ति का। वो इतना देने में विश्वास रखता है पूछो नहीं।
says: It is the force of the place: this place is so powerful that the person's character becomes like the donor Karna, believing in giving to an unbelievable extent; the 2nd house itself, not the sign, shapes the giving nature.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: और उस व्यक्ति की आंख की प्रॉब्लम होती है। कर्ण की आंख की दिक्कत थी।
says: Such a person has an eye problem, as Karna had trouble with his eye; the 2nd house (face, right eye) Sun is linked with eye trouble. A traditional claim, not a medical diagnosis.
ambiguity: Karna having an eye problem is the speaker's reading of the epic and is not found in the text; health claim flagged.
classical_check: Agrees partly: the 2nd house governs the face and right eye, and the Sun there can afflict eyes.

hindi: एक गलत दृष्टि थी। उसने गलत को मित्र बना लिया।
says: Karna had a faulty vision: he made the wrong person his friend; so the eye trouble is read as faulty judgement, and the 2nd-house Sun person may befriend the wrong people.
ambiguity: Sentence runs over the chunk break (1:12:06 to 1:13:03).
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: लेकिन था वो पक्का। होता धुन का पक्का है दूसरे घर का सूर्य वाला व्यक्ति गलत दोस्त से दोस्ती कर सकता है लेकिन आखिर तक छोड़ेगा नहीं साथ मरता मर जाएगा छोड़ेगा नहीं
says: But he was firm: the person with the Sun in the 2nd house is steadfast in purpose; he may befriend a wrong friend but will not leave him to the end, even if it kills him.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: और हाथ से देगा कुछ भी हो लुटा लुट जाए मुझे कोई परवाह नहीं यानी जीदार
says: He will give with his own hand, whatever happens, saying I do not care if I am looted; he is bold-hearted; reckless generosity is a mark of this Sun.
ambiguity: 'जीदार' is read as 'jigardar', meaning stout-hearted.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: दो नंबर का सूर्य वाला व्यक्ति कुंडली में कहीं भी बैठा हो जबरदस्त ईगो होती है भयंकर ईगोइस्ट उससे बहस नहीं की जा सकती
says: A person with a number-2 Sun, wherever it sits in the chart, has tremendous ego and is a terrible egoist who cannot be argued with; this time 'number 2' looks like a sign-based trait, not a house.
cells_derived_method: A Sun in Taurus in any house gives strong ego; the house shows the area where the ego flares.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Sun in Taurus in the 1st house (lagna Taurus) gives an egoist personality that cannot be argued with.
Derived: Sun in Taurus in the 7th house (lagna Scorpio) gives an egoistic partner or ego-driven business dealings.
Derived: Sun in Taurus in the 10th house (lagna Leo) gives ego clashes at work and an unyielding style of authority.

ambiguity: 'कुंडली में कहीं भी बैठा हो' (wherever it sits) points to number 2 meaning sign Taurus here, which differs from the house meaning in the earlier lines; it could also still mean the 2nd house.
classical_check: Differs: classically Taurus is an enemy sign for the Sun; strong ego fits Sun but is not tied to Taurus specifically.

hindi: मियां बीवी का साथ इससे लिंक्ड है मान लो किसी पति या पत्नी का दो नंबर का सूर्य है सात नंबर का सूर्य है वो दोनों में से एक भयंकर ईगोइस्ट होगा जिसका भी है
says: The husband-wife bond is linked to this: if one spouse has a number-2 or number-7 Sun, then whichever of the two has it will be a terrible egoist.
cells_derived_method: Sun in Taurus or Libra in any house of either spouse's chart marks that spouse as the egoist; Sun in the 7th house adds partner-ego.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Sun in Libra in the 7th house (lagna Aries) makes the native or spouse stubborn and ego-driven in marriage.
Derived: Sun in Taurus in the 2nd house (lagna Aries) makes the person ego-driven in family speech and marriage disputes.

ambiguity: Numbers 2 and 7 are read as signs here since the earlier lines named signs 2 and 7 as the Sun's worst; they could also be the 2nd and 7th houses.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Sun in the 7th is classically a harmful placement for marriage.

hindi: बीइंग लॉयल एंड बीइंग वेरी स्ट्रांगली सपोर्टिव हां लेकिन वो ईगोस्ट होते हैं ना सिर फोड़ देंगे फाड़ देंगे मर जाएंगे लेकिन ईगो रहेगी किसी और का
says: They are loyal and very strongly supportive, yes, but they are egoists who will break heads and die but keep their ego; the same person is both loyal and ego-driven.
ambiguity: The end 'किसी और का' is garbled.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: करण में भयंकर ईगो थी भयंकर ईगो थी करण के अंदर कंपटीशन ईगो में होगी सर हां
says: Karna had a terrible ego, and the competition inside him was one of ego; he shows the competitive, ego-driven side of the number-2 Sun type.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: Says the third Sun is very interesting and asks what the third Sun's position is.

hindi: यह हमारा मृत्यु का घर है। मौत का मालिक है प्लूटो और अध्यात्म का मालिक भी प्लूटो एक प्रकार से क्योंकि धर्मराज है वो।
says: This (pointing at the 8th house) is our house of death; the master of death is Pluto, who is also in a way the master of spirituality because he is Dharmaraja; the 8th house is Pluto's house of death and spirit.
ambiguity: 'यह' is a gesture; it is read as the 8th house from the later counting, not the 3rd.
classical_check: Agrees that the 8th is the house of death and occult; Pluto as lord is his scheme.

hindi: सारा का सारा ज्ञान किसके पास है? धर्मराज के पास है।
says: Who holds all the knowledge? Dharmaraja holds it; the lord of death and dharma is the keeper of complete knowledge.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: धर्म धर्मराज का पुत्र हुआ युधिष्ठिर। जो कहते हैं ना युधिष्ठिर से बड़ा कोई हुआ ही नहीं। धर्मराज ही हुआ वो भी।
says: Yudhishthira was the son of Dharmaraja, and people say there was never anyone greater than Yudhishthira; he too became a Dharmaraja himself; dharma passes to the Pluto-Yama line.
classical_check: Agrees with the epic fact that Yudhishthira is Dharma's (Yama's) son; the greatness claim is rhetoric.

hindi: इस घर से आठवां घर। यहां से एक दो तीन चार पांच छ सात आठ। मृत्यु की भी मृत्यु।
says: The house eighth from this house, counted one to eight, is the death of death; counting 8 houses from the 8th house gives the 3rd house (8th from 8th).
cells_derived_method: The 8th from the 8th house is the 3rd house (8, 9, 10, 11, 12, 1, 2, 3). Planets there are read as being at the 'death of death'.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Sun in own sign Leo in the 3rd house (lagna Gemini) is the strong case of death-of-death power.
Derived: Sun in Aries in the 3rd house (lagna Aquarius) is the same house, with the Sun exalted by sign.

ambiguity: The 3rd house is inferred from the count; he points and counts aloud but does not say 'third' in this sentence.
classical_check: Agrees with the classical 'bhavat bhavam' counting (8th from the 8th is the 3rd) for the 3rd as a house of longevity, called the house of ayu.

hindi: मृत्यु की मृत्यु कैसे होगी? मृत्यु भी मर गई।
says: How can death itself die? Death too has died here; the 3rd house is where death's power ends.
classical_check: Silent; the 3rd house is classically linked to longevity as the 8th from the 8th.

hindi: यहां यदि सूर्य 30 नंबर का बैठ जाए तो ऐसे व्यक्ति को मरते व्यक्ति के पास बिठाता वो मरता ही नहीं। यह इतना पावरफुल सूर्य है।
says: If the Sun sits here (the caption says '30 number', meaning the 3rd), then even if you seat such a person beside a dying man, the man does not die; the 3rd-house Sun is that powerful. A claim about life-giving presence, recorded as said and not a prediction.
cells_derived_method: Sun in the 3rd house in any sign gives this; the sign adds strength (Leo, Aries best).

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Sun in own sign Leo in the 3rd house (lagna Gemini) is the strongest case of a life-restoring presence.
Derived: Sun in Gemini in the 3rd house (lagna Aries) gives this effect through speech and healing words.
Derived: Sun in Scorpio in the 3rd house (lagna Virgo) gives it through intense will and courage.

ambiguity: '30 नंबर' is a caption error for the 3rd house. The claim that a dying man does not die is not a predictive statement and is not endorsed.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: यह ज्योतिषी है। ज्योतिषी मैथमेटिशियन थकी हुई राशि का है तो नेगेटिव।
says: This Sun in the 3rd house makes an astrologer, a mathematician; but if the sign is a tired or weak one, the result is negative; the astrologer type depends on the sign being healthy.
cells_derived_method: Sun in the 3rd in a healthy sign gives astrological and mathematical skill; in a weak sign (for example Libra) the result turns negative.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Sun in Virgo in the 3rd house (lagna Cancer) gives an analytic, mathematical astrologer.
Derived: Sun in Libra in the 3rd house (lagna Leo) gives a weak, confused astrological or mathematical ability.

ambiguity: 'थकी हुई राशि' (tired sign) is unclear; it may mean a weak or debilitated sign.
classical_check: Agrees in general that the 3rd house shows skills; astrology via the 3rd is his reading.

hindi: पांचव नौवें घर के राशियों का या ग्रह मालिकों का आपस में लिंक नहीं है तो टूटा फूटा ज्योतिषी होगा लेकिन होगा वह ज्योतिषी उसको मैथमेटिक्स की जबरदस्त नॉलेज होगी
says: If the signs or lords of the 5th and 9th houses have no link with each other, he will be a patchy astrologer, but still an astrologer with great mathematical knowledge; a 5th-9th link makes a complete one.
cells_derived_method: The 5th and 9th lords exchange, conjunct or aspect each other for a complete astrologer; without it the astrologer is incomplete. For example, Gemini lagna has Venus as 5th lord and Saturn as 9th lord; Aries lagna has the Sun and Jupiter.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: for lagna Aries the 5th is Leo (Sun) and the 9th is Sagittarius (Jupiter); Sun-Jupiter linked gives a complete astrologer.
Derived: for lagna Gemini the 5th is Libra (Venus) and the 9th is Aquarius (Saturn); unlinked, the astrologer is patchy.

classical_check: Agrees that 5th and 9th lord links (a dharma-trikona link) show learning and wisdom.

gist: Cut off: 'and such a person and such 8th house death' with the sentence ending at the end of the batch.

hindi: स्थान में यानी प्लूटो के घर में सूरज महाराज आकर बैठ गए।
says: Sun has come to sit in Pluto's house, which here means the 8th house (house of Yama, death and transformation in his scheme).
cells_derived_method: Sun in the 8th: the meaning is the Sun's life-giving nature placed in the house of death. The sign decides how comfortable the Sun is, e.g. exalted Aries versus debilitated Libra.

derived_examples.reading: Sun exalted in the 8th (lagna Virgo): life force is strong inside the death house, the protective reading is at its best.
Sun debilitated in the 8th (lagna Pisces): the same placement but the Sun is weak, so the protection is doubtful.

Cancer lagna: 7th is Capricorn, Saturn's sign; green acts on the 7th by calming it through Mercury, a friend of Saturn.
