ambiguity: 'Saat number' may be sign Libra or the seventh house; unclear which.
classical_check: Green for Mercury and Venus-Mercury friendship is classical; using skin-tone optics as a remedy is his own idea.

hindi: सूर्य डिस्ट्रॉय कर देता है शुक्र ग्रह पर 470 471 डिग्री टेंपरेचर है ये आपके हार्ट को खत्म कर देगा
says: The Sun destroys Venus: the planet Venus has a surface temperature of about 470 degrees, and that heat in the chart will finish your heart (love).
cells_derived_method: Venus is combust when near the Sun in any house or sign. The damage shows on Venus matters wherever Venus sits: marriage if in the 7th, wealth if in the 2nd, comforts if in the 4th.

derived_examples.reading: Libra lagna: Sun and Venus together in Aries in the 7th burns the marriage house.
Aries lagna with Sun-Venus in Taurus: family wealth and speech get the burn.
Aries lagna, Venus in Pisces (its own exaltation sign) with the Sun close by: Venus is combust, so pleasure is pushed into loss and bed comforts.

ambiguity: 'Dil' (heart) is figurative, meaning love and romance, not a medical heart statement.
classical_check: Combustion of Venus within about 10 degrees of the Sun is classical; the Venus-temperature analogy is his own.

hindi: ऐसे ही यहां सात नंबर राशि का सूर्य पड़ा हुआ है राशि है सात नंबर मान लो तो एक किडनी में स्टोन दे रहा है
says: Taking the Sun in sign number 7 (Libra, where it is debilitated): this can give a kidney stone. (Medical claim as he stated it, not a diagnosis.)
cells_derived_method: Sun in Libra is debilitated; Libra is the 7th natural sign and rules kidneys (Venus). The house it falls in shows where the burn lands: 1st gives bodily effects, 4th gives home and inner peace, 10th gives career.

derived_examples.reading: Libra lagna: debilitated Sun in the lagna, Sun is 11th lord; the body shows the weakness.
Cancer lagna: debilitated Sun in the 4th, 2nd lord; home and family funds strained.
Capricorn lagna: debilitated Sun in the 10th, 8th lord; career shaky and sudden shifts.

ambiguity: Medical claim; recorded as stated without endorsement. 'Raashi 7' is sign Libra here (confirmed by 'sign').
classical_check: Libra and Venus ruling the kidneys is classical; Sun in Libra causing stones is a stretch beyond classical texts.

hindi: तो यहां क्या दो चाय की पत्ती धर्म स्थान में चाय की पत्ती दे दो अगर बृहस्पति दूषित नहीं हो रहा क्योंकि राहु बृहस्पति को डिस्टर्ब करता है बृहस्पति को डिस्टर्ब नहीं कर रहा है तो चाय की पत्ती पत्ती दे दो।
says: Remedy: give tea leaves at a religious place, provided Jupiter is not being spoiled by Rahu. If Rahu is not disturbing Jupiter, tea leaves can be donated.
cells_derived_method: Condition check: first see whether Rahu hurts Jupiter (conjunction, aspect or Rahu in a Jupiter sign), which depends on the cell. Where Jupiter is clean the tea leaf offering is allowed.

derived_examples.reading: Aries lagna: Jupiter in its own sign in the 9th is strong and unspoiled, so tea leaves are fine.
Scorpio lagna: Rahu in Pisces in the 5th spoils Jupiter's own sign, so the tea-leaf remedy is skipped.

ambiguity: Whether tea leaves are Rahu or Jupiter things is not stated; he implies tea leaves belong to Jupiter's temple side.
classical_check: Not a classical remedy; donating to a religious place for Jupiter is classical.

gist: Assures that the stone will pass by itself, 'there is no fight in it' (a reassurance line).

hindi: यहां पर और क्या दे सकते हैं हम? घी दे सकते हैं। पेट्रोल, तेल, शनि की चीजें दे सकते हैं।
says: Other things that can be given as the remedy here: ghee, and Saturn's items such as petrol and oil.
cells_derived_method: Libra is ruled by Venus and Saturn is exalted there, so both Venus and Saturn items fit a Sun-in-Libra remedy in any house.

derived_examples.reading: Aries lagna: Sun debilitated in the 7th; ghee for Venus and oil for Saturn both work on the partnership house.
Capricorn lagna: Sun debilitated in the 10th; Saturn items (oil, petrol) suit career as Saturn is lagna lord.

ambiguity: Not stated which of these suits which house.
classical_check: Oil for Saturn and ghee for Venus are classical; giving them for a Sun-in-Libra problem follows from Libra being the home of Venus and Saturn's exaltation.

hindi: तो ये शुक्र हो गया। घी शुक्र है। शुक्र को बल देंगे ना या शुक्र से शुक्र स्थापित करेंगे हम।
says: Ghee belongs to Venus; the idea is to strengthen Venus by using Venus's own substance and so re-establish Venus.
classical_check: Ghee as a Venus item is common in upaya lists, though some texts put it with Jupiter or the Moon.

hindi: और सबसे बढ़िया क्या है? फूल दे दो। पर फूल बहुत जल्दी मर जाएंगे। तो स्थापित रहने वाली चीजों में हमारे पास घी है। बहुत सुंदर।
says: Flowers are the best Venus offering but they perish quickly; among things that last, ghee is our choice.
classical_check: Flowers as a Venus significator are classical; the durability argument for ghee is his own.

hindi: मजे की बात क्या है? अगर आपके सूर्य के अंदर दोष आ रहा है और आप धुए की रुई की बत्ती में घी डालकर जलाते हो तो शुक्र नष्ट हो रहा है।
says: Catch: if your Sun is afflicted and you light a ghee lamp with a cotton wick, you are burning Venus (cotton and ghee are both Venus things) and destroying it.
cells_derived_method: Matters most where Venus is already weak, such as Venus in Virgo or combust Venus; there the habit of daily ghee lamps hurts marriage and comforts further.

derived_examples.reading: Pisces lagna: debilitated Venus in the 7th with daily ghee lamps would worsen marital strain.
Aries lagna: Venus in its own sign in the 2nd can bear it; the warning is mild.

ambiguity: He ties it to 'Sun dosha' but the logic burns Venus; the link is unclear.
classical_check: Contradicts the common Hindu view that ghee lamps are beneficial; he states this knowingly as a difference.

hindi: अब बताओ कहा जाता है पूजा पाठ करने से फायदा होगा। आपको पूजा पाठ करने से नुकसान होगा। आप धूप जलाओ केतु सेट होगा। नारियल फोड़ो राहु सेट होगा।
says: Though people say puja brings benefit, in this condition it harms you: lighting incense sets Ketu, breaking a coconut sets Rahu, and lighting a cotton wick with ghee burns Venus.
cells_derived_method: Incense = Ketu and coconut = Rahu, so the cell decides harm: if Ketu or Rahu is already strong or placed in a bad house for the chart, these puja acts add to it.

derived_examples.reading: Aries lagna: Ketu in Pisces in the 12th with daily incense strengthens detachment and expenses.
Aries lagna: Rahu in Virgo in the 6th is usually good, so coconut-breaking does little harm.

ambiguity: Not clear whether he means all puja is harmful or only when Sun, Rahu or Venus are in trouble.
classical_check: Contradicts the conventional view that incense and coconut are auspicious offerings.

hindi: आप रुई की बत्ती जला रहे हो तो रुई शुक्र घी भी शुक्र सत्यानाश बर्बाद। आपका शुक्र नष्ट होगा।
says: Burning a cotton wick means burning cotton (Venus) with ghee (Venus), so your Venus will be wiped out.
classical_check: Silent in classics; planet assignments for cotton are his own.

hindi: आप मंदिर होकर पूजा पाठ करके आए हो। घर आकर पति लड़ाई कर रहा है या पत्नी लड़ाई कर रही है। आप कहोगे मैं भगवान का नाम ले आया हूं। तू लड़ रहा है मुझसे या तू लड़ रही है? तू दुश्मन है। अरे भाई अभी भी शुक्र पीट के आए हो तुम।
says: Example: after puja at the temple you come home and quarrel with your spouse and blame them; but you just came from beating up your own Venus, which is why the quarrel arose.
cells_derived_method: Venus matters (spouse) show up in the 7th house; the sign on the 7th decides how the quarrel appears.

derived_examples.reading: Libra lagna: Mars sign on the 7th makes the quarrel loud and sudden.
Capricorn lagna: Moon sign on the 7th makes the quarrel emotional and sulky.

ambiguity: Narrative illustration, not a rule.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: क्यों छेड़ रहे हो? आग लगा रहे हो उसके अंदर। उसको मत छेड़ो। इसलिए बहुत ज्यादा दिया बत्ती करने वालों की लाइफ में फिजिकल लाइफ नहीं होती। रोमांस की लाइफ जल के खत्म हो जाती है।
says: Do not provoke Venus; people who do a lot of lamp and wick worship end up with no physical or romantic life because their Venus has been burned away.
cells_derived_method: Strongest effect where Venus rules the 7th, 2nd or 8th (marital, family and intimacy matters), and when Venus is already weak.

derived_examples.reading: Aries lagna: Venus in own sign in the 7th is robust, so the burn shows only after heavy lamp worship.
Aquarius lagna: debilitated Venus in the 8th is easily burned, intimacy suffers fast.

ambiguity: Claim about intimacy is not a medical statement; recorded as a tradition claim.
classical_check: Opposite of mainstream devotional practice.

gist: Says the remaining remedies are very long, including piercing and threads, and moves on.

hindi: कई सूर्य के कलर के लिए हम ऑरेंज कलर का धागा पहनाते हैं।
says: For the Sun's colour we have the person wear an orange-coloured thread.
classical_check: Orange or red-orange for the Sun is classical; threads are a folk adaptation.

gist: Struggles with time: points at sign two and sign seven on his board, says he cannot cover both, no time.

hindi: तो ऑरेंज रंग की स्टेशनरी बच्चा यूज़ ना करे। बहुत सारे सूर्य के रिलेटेड चीजें यहां से भी एड्रेस।
says: A child with a Sun problem should not use orange-coloured stationery, and many other Sun-related items can be handled the same way.
cells_derived_method: Child and study items link to the 4th and 5th houses; the cell decides whether orange is harmful (afflicted Sun) or helpful (strong Sun).

derived_examples.reading: Aries lagna with Sun troubled in the 4th: avoid orange stationery.
Aries lagna with Sun in own sign in the 5th: orange can be used.

ambiguity: He does not say which Sun condition triggers the avoidance, only that it is for a troubled Sun.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: Takes a question from a viewer, 'Yes, your question?'

hindi: फ्री गिफ्ट नहीं लेने चाहिए। कैसे? कैसे करें? फ्री गिफ्ट कभी मत लो। आपको कोई भी कुछ देता है। उसको उसके बदले कुछ और दे दो।
says: Answering the question, he says not to accept free gifts; whenever someone gives you something, give them something in return.
classical_check: Silent; reciprocal giving is a general dharma idea.

hindi: और अगर आप फ्री गिफ्ट ले रहे हैं तो आगे बांट दो। आपको फ्री गिफ्ट लेने से सूर्य खराब होता है। अगर आपका सूर्य ठीक है तो जम के फ्री गिफ्ट लो।
says: If you do take a free gift, pass it on to others, because taking free gifts spoils the Sun; but if your Sun is fine, take free gifts freely.
cells_derived_method: Depends on Sun's condition: a strong or well-placed Sun (own sign Leo, exalted in Aries, or in the 1st, 9th, 10th) can take gifts; an afflicted Sun in Libra or in dusthana houses should not.

derived_examples.reading: Cancer lagna: Sun exalted in Aries in the 10th, free gifts are fine.
Taurus lagna: debilitated Sun in the 6th, avoid freebies and pass them on.

ambiguity: Not stated how to judge whether the Sun is 'fine'.
classical_check: Silent; Sun as giver and receiver of honour is a karaka idea only.

hindi: अब आपको देने वाले ने गिफ्ट दिए। ये एक डिस्टिंशन है। आपको कोई चीज दी है किसी ने वो गिफ्ट आवश्यक नहीं है। ऐसे तो भाई भाई को कुछ नहीं दे सकता। बहन भाई को नहीं दे सकती। वो गिफ्ट थोड़ी है। वो प्रेम है।
says: Distinction: something handed over is not necessarily a 'gift'; a brother giving a brother something, or a sister giving to a brother, is love, not a gift, so the rule does not apply.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: गिफ्ट कोई किसी के लिए उपहार लाता है। अब कहा आप गुरु के घर गए। गुरु के घर जाकर के मतलब मैं अपनी सेटिंग के लिए कर रहा हूं। आप बढ़िया सी चीजें लेकर आ गए। अब आप गिफ्ट दे रहे हैं। किस भाव से दे रहे हैं?
says: A gift is when someone brings a present for another with an aim; for example, when you visit a guru with fine things to give, the question is what intention you give them with.
classical_check: Intent of the giver is the test; silent in classics.

hindi: हमें तो खैर पता है जिस भाव से देगा उस भाव से ही हमारा स्वीकार होगा। इसलिए अपने तो टेंशन है नहीं। हमें तो आता पता है। लेकिन अगले बंदे ने किस भाव से दिया? अगर आप उसे एक्सेप्ट करके दीवाने पागल हो रहे हो एक्सेप्ट हो गया।
says: He notes that a gift is accepted in the spirit in which it is given and he himself has no tension about it; the real test is the giver's intention, and if you accept it with total delight, it has been truly accepted.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: अगर आपने सिर्फ लिया बहुत बढ़िया रख लो। वो एक्सेप्टेंस नहीं है। वो मात्र आया है। आया और गया है। अदर वाइज आप उसके लिए मोल दो। संसार में फ्री कुछ नहीं होता।
says: Merely taking and keeping an item is not real acceptance; it only came and went, so otherwise you must pay a price for it, because nothing in the world is free.
classical_check: Echoes the karmic-debt idea of classical texts; no direct rule.

hindi: आपको मोल देना है। कई लोग आपको इसलिए दे सकते हैं कि वह आपसे फायदा कराना चाहते हैं। कुछ लोग इसलिए देना चाहते हैं कि वो आपके साथ नाम और मान चाहते हैं।
says: You must pay the price; people give for hidden reasons, some wanting benefit from you, others wanting name and respect through you.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: कुछ लोग इसलिए दे रहे हैं कि मैंने कहां दिया? काम की चीज है भाई तू उठा ले। वो गिफ्ट नहीं है। गिफ्ट एक अलग चीज है।
says: When someone just hands over a useful item saying 'take it, it is useful', that is not a gift; a gift is something different.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: Anecdote: sister brings her brother a shirt, he says he won't take free gifts, she scolds him; says it is love not a gift.
Joke: father offers the property after death, the son declines a free gift, so it can go to Brajesh Gautam; son says no, I want it.

hindi: डिस्काउंट डिस्काउंट लेने नहीं चाहिए उतना पैसा हमारे पे जमा कराओ कहां ले आ जाओगे इतना पैसा बचा के सब मोह माया है
says: Do not take discounts either; if you save so much money, where will you take it, it is all illusion; the speaker jokes that the saved money should be deposited with him.
ambiguity: Sun-affliction remedy: avoid discounts. Part of the line is a joke.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: जो ऑफर हो रहे हो जो ऑफर हो रहा है डिस्काउंट सोचो एक बहुत बड़ी कंपनी आपको डिस्काउंट पे कुछ दे रही है। क्या वो पागल है? वो लॉलीपॉप है।
says: Think about it: a huge company offering you a discount is not mad; the offer is a lollipop, a bait.
classical_check: Silent, a worldly-wise comment rather than astrology.

hindi: वो आपको बेवकूफ बना रहा है। अपनी माल क्लीयरेंस कर रहे हैं। डिस्काउंट जैसी कोई चीज नहीं होती। इसी चक्कर में हम यूज़लेस शॉपिंग कर बैठते हैं। सूर्य डिस्टर्बड है।
says: The seller is fooling you and clearing old stock; there is no such thing as a real discount, and this is how we end up with useless shopping, which comes from a disturbed Sun.
classical_check: Silent; linking impulse shopping to a disturbed Sun is his own idea.

gist: Banter: if you fall for the lollipop discount, or your husband falls for a discount rather than another woman, 'it is OK', it keeps your control at home.

hindi: फसो डिस्काउंट अलाउड है जी आपको डिस्काउंट में नहीं वो आप तो आग लगाओ आपको सब अलाउड है आप तो नीले रंग को भी कहोगे यही मेरा वाला पिंक है वो बंदा सिर मार के भी देगा
says: Joking aside, he says women can be allowed to fall for discounts since they are allowed everything and will even call blue pink and get the husband to accept it.
ambiguity: Humorous aside; low relevance.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: Introduces the second question from the audience.

hindi: आप जैसे कह रहे थे कि लेजीनेस होता है अगर किसी को बहुत ज्यादा एनर्जी है और वो नींद ही नहीं आती नींद ही नहीं आती खेलने दो उसे वो एनर्जी कहां बर्न करे उसे बोलो बेटा बॉक्सिंग करने जा तू एनर्जी एनर्जी होती है क्या करें आग लगी हुई है
says: On laziness versus excess energy: a restless person who cannot sleep should be allowed to play and burn the energy outside, for example sent to boxing, since the fire inside has to go somewhere.
cells_derived_method: Excess restless energy points to strong Mars or an afflicted Sun/Mars axis; fire signs (Aries, Leo, Sagittarius) or the 1st/3rd/10th houses make this more intense, so the advice to use physical outlets matters more there.

derived_examples.reading: Aries lagna with Mars in the 1st: strong physical energy needs a sport outlet.
Virgo lagna: Mars-ruled 3rd gives courage and restlessness, a boxing-type outlet fits.

ambiguity: Question and answer are mixed in the caption; the planet is inferred as Mars. Sleep issues are noted only as part of the remedy, not diagnosed.
classical_check: Mars as the energy planet is classical; sports as a remedy is a modern reading.

gist: Says he has said this three times already and tells the class to stop him.
Acknowledges a viewer's question ('okay sir, question', 'yes, so don't stop').

hindi: नींद नहीं आती रात को तो गलती करते हो आप गाने गाया करो डांस करो भजन करो किताब लिखो स्लीप साइकिल चेंज कर लो कोई फर्क नहीं है
says: If someone cannot sleep at night, the fault is theirs: they should use the energy by singing, dancing, devotional singing or writing a book, and simply shift the sleep cycle, which makes no difference.
cells_derived_method: Not house or sign dependent as spoken. A strong Mars or fire-sign emphasis (Aries, Leo, Sagittarius, or planets in the 1st, 3rd, 10th) would make restless nights more likely and this advice more relevant.

derived_examples.reading: Aquarius lagna: Mars-ruled Aries on the 3rd gives courage and drive that overflow at night, so singing or writing is the outlet.
Scorpio lagna: Sun-ruled Leo on the 10th, ambition keeps the mind awake, a creative project fits.

ambiguity: This is lifestyle advice and not a diagnosis of any sleep disorder; planet link is inferred.
classical_check: Silent in classical texts; modern lifestyle advice presented as a Mars remedy.

hindi: आप 3:00 बजे सो के सुबह 8 घंटे की नींद पूरी करके उठ जाओ स्लीप साइकिल सेट रखो
says: Even if you sleep at 3 am, complete eight hours of sleep and wake up; the point is to keep the sleep cycle fixed and regular.
ambiguity: Contradicts his own later stress on waking at Brahma muhurta; he does not reconcile the two here.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: Banter that the audience takes his advice casually, thinking 'my style is different, I say anything while having tea with crossed leg', which is big ego.

hindi: आई एम कैपेबल यू आर कैपेबल जो बोल दिया वो हो जाता है हम कैपेबल है हम कुछ और बात कर रहे हैं।
says: Everyone thinks 'I am capable, you are capable, whatever I say will happen', but that is ego and he says he is talking about something else.
ambiguity: Ego-based belief in one's own capability is treated as a Sun matter.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: आपकी कैपेबिलिटी को कौन पूछता है? कभी दूसरे की कैपेबिलिटी मत पूछो। सूर्य अपना सेट करो। वो आपकी कैपेबिलिटी देगा। दूसरे को बोलने मात्र से कार्य होगा।
says: Nobody asks about your capability and you should never question another person's; set your own Sun right and it gives you capability, then work happens just by speaking to others.
cells_derived_method: A well-set Sun gives authority and capability; shown through the 1st (self), 10th (command) and 9th (authority) houses. In Aries or Leo it gives it easily, in Libra it needs repair.

derived_examples.reading: Cancer lagna: Sun in Aries in the 10th gives the strongest command in public work.
Leo lagna: Sun in Leo in the 1st gives natural authority and ready compliance.
Libra lagna: the Sun in the lagna is weak, so capability and authority come late and with effort.

ambiguity: 'Setting the Sun' is not defined; likely refers to the remedies he has listed (water at dawn, etc.).
classical_check: Sun as karaka of authority and self-confidence is classical.

gist: Announces that the story of Markandeya will be taken in the next class.
Congratulates a participant and asks 'yes, tell me your order'.
Audience question: does offering water to the Sun make the Sun strong?
Praises the question as a lovely one.

hindi: सूर्य जो होता है यह सुबह-सुबह का सूर्य सूर्य होता है। फिर वह मंगल बन जाता है।
says: Only the Sun of the early morning is truly the Sun; as the day advances it turns into Mars.
classical_check: Day-phase mapping is his own; classical day lordship is by hora, not by the heat of the Sun.

hindi: सूर्य मॉर्निंग में आता है अल्ट्रावायलेट रेज लेकर। जब सूरज देवता सुबह-सुबह आ रहे आते हैं तो यहां से शुरू करते हैं वो अल्ट्रावायलेट रेज से जिसके लिए ब्रह्म मुहूर्त बनाया गया है।
says: The Sun comes in the morning carrying ultraviolet rays, and the Brahma muhurta was set aside to receive exactly that.
classical_check: Brahma muhurta is classical; the ultraviolet explanation is his own reading.

hindi: घर के बीच का आंगन खुला रखो। कभी भी किसी को हार्ट अटैक नहीं होगा।
says: Vastu claim: keep the central courtyard of the house open and nobody will ever have a heart attack. (Medical claim as he stated it.)
ambiguity: Medical outcome is as he claimed; recorded without endorsement.
classical_check: Open Brahmasthan is classical Vastu; the heart-attack link is his own.

hindi: जिस घर के बीच के सेंटर ब्रह्म स्थान में दीवारें खड़ी होती है, हार्ट पेशेंट बनते हैं। हार्ट अटैक से मरता है कोई ना कोई। क्योंकि सूर्य खत्म हो जाता है। आंखों की प्रॉब्लम आती है।
says: Vastu claim: walls in the central Brahmasthan of a house create heart patients, someone there dies of heart attack and eyes have trouble because the Sun element is finished. (Medical and death claim as stated.)
ambiguity: No direct date or person is given; recorded as a generic vastu-to-body claim.
classical_check: Brahmasthan should stay open is classical Vastu; heart and eye links to the Sun are common karaka claims.

hindi: पतिप में भयंकर फ्रिक्शन रहती है।
says: Probably 'husband and wife': there is severe friction between spouses in such a house with walls in the centre.
ambiguity: The word 'patip' is garbled; probably 'pati-patni' (husband-wife). Not certain.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: घर के अंदर स्त्री पहले गुजरती है। पुरुष दादा पहले बाद में मरता है। और फिर वो दादा-दादी के रहने के बाद में अगली डेथ्स होती है। दादा रह जाता है। दादी चली जाती है। ऐसे अक्सर होता है।
says: Vastu claim: in such a house the women usually pass away first and the grandfather later, with the grandmother often going before the grandfather. (Death-order claim as stated, no dates.)
ambiguity: Caption order is confusing: he first says the woman goes first, then the grandfather later, then the next deaths follow.
classical_check: Silent in classical texts.

gist: Says this is a long detail and repeats that this is about ultraviolet rays.

hindi: जिसके लेने के लिए सूर्य के जो बहुत दूर चील उड़ती है ना और वो बहुत छोटे से इलाके के अंदर घास के कणों के बीच एक 1 मिलीमीटर के कीड़े को देख लेती है और ऊपर से झपट्टा मार के खा जाती है पकड़ के वो अल्ट्रावायलेट विज़न है
says: Analogy: a kite flying very high spots a 1 mm insect among blades of grass and swoops on it, because it has ultraviolet vision, which is a gift of the Sun's ultraviolet rays.
classical_check: Silent; a modern science analogy.

hindi: उसकी अल्ट्रावायलेट रेज की कृपा है उसको जो सूर्य से लेती है जिसकी वजह से उसको दिखता है यह अल्ट्रा विज़न है वायलेट अल्ट्रा या वायलेट है ये है सहस्त्रार
says: The kite sees because of grace from the ultraviolet rays it receives from the Sun; this ultra-vision is tied to violet, which corresponds to the sahasrara crown centre.
ambiguity: Caption jumbles 'violet ultra or violet', so whether he means violet or just before violet is unclear.
classical_check: Sahasrara as violet is a tantric and modern chakra mapping; not in classical jyotish texts.

hindi: सहस्त्रार की रेज एंटर करने से ठीक ठीक पहले अल्ट्रावायलेट रेज होती है जो हमारे लिए सबसे उत्तम
says: Just before the sahasrara (violet) rays enter, the ultraviolet rays arrive, and these are the best ones for us.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: इसलिए कहते हैं ब्रह्म मुहूर्त में उठ जाओ 3 4 बजे 5:00 बजे जो जो भी है सूरज निकलने से ठीक पहले सूर्य की रश्मियां आती है अल्ट्रावायलेट ये आपको विज़न देती है
says: That is why one is told to wake in Brahma muhurta, between 3 and 5 am, just before sunrise, when the ultraviolet rays of the Sun arrive and give you vision.
ambiguity: Clock times vary (3, 4 or 5), he gives them as a range.
classical_check: Brahma muhurta being roughly 96 minutes before sunrise is classical.

hindi: भयंकर वायलेट इंडिगो ब्लू ग्रीन येलो ऑरेंज रेड ये विपगोर में अल्ट अल्ट्रावायलेट रेज है जिसका मुहूर्त जिसका बहुत बड़ा महत्व है।
says: In the spectrum VIBGYOR the ultraviolet band sits before violet, and the muhurta of those rays is of very great importance.
classical_check: Silent; spectral order is science, not jyotish.

gist: Asks the questioner 'what did you actually ask?'.

hindi: अब सूर्य को आप जल देते हैं तो जल देने के लिए आपको सूर्य को जल देना है। यह वाला जब सूर्य को हमने जल दिया तो सूर्य को जल नहीं दिया। हमने उसके अंदर शिव
says: When you offer water to the Sun, you are actually not giving it to the Sun but to the Shiva principle inside it.
ambiguity: Sentence is cut at the slice boundary, so 'Shiva' is read from the next clause.
classical_check: Surya as a form of Shiva or Shiva within the Sun is a puranic idea, not a jyotish rule.

hindi: जो कर्म को बदलने की प्रारब्ध को बदलने की शक्ति कहीं नहीं है। वह शिव कृपा में है।
says: The power to change karma and destiny is found nowhere else; it lies only in Shiva's grace.
classical_check: Classical jyotish treats destiny as fixed by karma; grace of Shiva altering it is a devotional claim.

hindi: अब शिव जी फ्री फंड में कृपा नहीं देते। इतने अरबों खरबों साल में सिर्फ मार्कंडेय को उन्होंने दिए। बाकी तो नहीं देते भाई।
says: Shiva does not hand out grace free: in billions of years only Markandeya got the karma-changing gift, the rest do not.
ambiguity: Story point; Markandeya to be explained in the next class.
classical_check: Silent in jyotish; puranic story.

hindi: अब कोई नहीं जानता। हम तो कहते हैं फ्री व्हील जैसी कोई चीज नहीं होती। बट यस कृपा की चीज जैसी चीज होती है।
says: No one knows how it works; he says there is no 'free will' in the sense of free choice, though 'grace' is a real thing.
ambiguity: 'Free wheel' in the caption is probably 'free will'; he says free will does not exist but grace does.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: अब वायलेट और अल्ट्रावायलेट को जब जल दिया जाता है तो सूर्य की रश्मियां शीतल होती हैं। यह सांकेतिक है।
says: When water is offered to the violet and ultraviolet band, the Sun's rays become cool; this is symbolic.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: तो आपके ब्रेन में भी 90% वाटर ही है। तो आपका ब्रेन ठंडा रहता है। सूर्य सेट रहता है। आपके जीवन के अंदर इसके नाश होने से आपके शरीर के अंदर आपके जीवन के अंदर कुछ खराब नहीं होता।
says: Your brain is about 90 percent water, so the water offering keeps the brain cool and the Sun set, and nothing in your body or life is spoiled by the Sun's destruction.
ambiguity: The brain-water figure is his own statement; not verified here.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: इसलिए ब्रह्म मुहूर्त में जल देना ही जल देना है। बाकी टाइम जो 9 10:00 बजे 11:00 बजे दे रहे हैं बाद की डेट में आपको किडनी शुगर इत्यादि के रोग आएंगे ही आएंगे।
says: Only water given in Brahma muhurta counts; if you offer water at 9, 10 or 11 am you will later surely get diseases like kidney problems and sugar. (Medical claim as stated.)
ambiguity: Medical claim recorded as he stated it; no endorsement.
classical_check: Silent; classics prescribe Sun worship at sunrise.

hindi: सुबह-सुबह जब सूरज निकला ही नहीं है। 5:00 बजे पांच बोल रहे हैं हम। कभी चार समझो कभी छह समझो। अल्ट्रावायलेट। सूरज नहीं
says: The right time is early morning when the Sun has not yet risen, about 5 am, but this can be 4 or 6 depending on the season, and it is the ultraviolet phase.
ambiguity: Season-dependent clock time; he gives it as an average.
classical_check: Sunrise offering is classical, a pre-sunrise window is not.

hindi: है। रश्मियां है। जो लालीमा आई है सूरज नहीं आया है। वो अल्ट्रावायलेट रेज है आपकी। वही सूर्य को जल देना है। बाकी जल देना तो फॉर्मेलिटी है।
says: The reddish glow before the Sun has actually appeared is the ultraviolet phase; offering water at that moment is the real offering, and water at any other time is a formality.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: दिन चढ़ गया लेकिन सूरज नहीं दिख रहे तो मतलब नहीं नहीं सूरज दिख नहीं रहा तो बादलों से छुपा हुआ है। केतु महाराज आए होंगे।
says: If the day has advanced but the Sun is not visible because it is hidden by clouds, Ketu has come, meaning clouds are a Ketu matter.
ambiguity: Clouds as Ketu is stated lightly, in an aside.
classical_check: Ketu as eclipser of the Sun is classical, clouds as Ketu is his own phrasing.

hindi: कि दिन चढ़ गया यानी कि तभी धूप कहीं भी सूरज की लाली में आई है। धूप नहीं आई। सूर्य अभी शुरू हुआ है। आग का गोला नहीं बना। सिर्फ रोशनी आई है। रोशनी आई है। कालापन हुआ है। रात का रात का कालापन। अंधेरा हट गया। अल्ट्रावायलेट शुरू।
says: At the dawn glow there is no sunshine yet; the Sun has only just begun, not yet a ball of fire, only light has come and the night's blackness has gone, and the ultraviolet phase has begun.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: इसके बाद जो लास्ट में रेड है ना इसके नीचे इंफ्रारेड है। ये इतनी डेंजरस है इंफ्रारेड कि ये खत्म कर देती हैं। फिर माइक्रोवेव एनर्जी वगैरह है जो अंतरिक्ष में खत्म। डेथ ये डेथ की एनर्जीज़ हैं।
says: After red, beyond it lies infrared, which is so dangerous it can destroy, then microwave energy and the like in space; these are the energies of death.
ambiguity: Not a specific death prediction; a general statement on harmful energies.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: इसलिए सुबह-सुबह देना जल बाकी जल देना ही। किसको नहीं देना? हर कोई दे सकता है। वैसे जरूरत किसी को नहीं है।
says: So give the water early in the morning; anybody may do it, though strictly speaking nobody really needs to.
ambiguity: 'Baaki jal dena hi' is a broken fragment; read as 'the rest is just giving water'.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: अगर सूर्य दूषित है। सूर्य दूषित है तो ये जो चीजें गिनवाई है देखो। तब सूर्य को जल दो।
says: If the Sun is afflicted, and the signs he has listed are present, then offer water to the Sun.
cells_derived_method: Afflicted Sun means debilitated in Libra, combust-free but eclipsed by Rahu, Saturn's aspect and so on; the effect differs across houses.

derived_examples.reading: Libra lagna: Sun in the lagna afflicted, water at dawn is recommended.
Cancer lagna: Sun in Saturn's sign in the 8th is afflicted, so water at dawn is advised.
Aries lagna: debilitated Sun in the 7th is afflicted, so water at dawn is advised for marriage and partnerships.

ambiguity: The 'listed things' refer to earlier slices, not given here.
classical_check: Surya arghya for a weak Sun is classical.

hindi: अदरवाइज सूर्य को मुफ्त में ठंडा मत करो।
says: Otherwise, if the Sun is not afflicted, do not cool the Sun needlessly.
classical_check: Silent; classics advise Sun worship for everyone, so this differs.

hindi: अगर आपका सूर्य अच्छा है और आप सूर्य की चीजें दान कर रहे हैं तो आपकी जिंदगी नर्क हो जाएगी।
says: If your Sun is good and you give away Sun-related items in charity, your life will turn into hell.
cells_derived_method: Strong Sun cells (Aries, Leo, or the Sun in the 1st, 9th, 10th, 11th houses) are where this warning applies.

derived_examples.reading: Leo lagna: Sun in its own sign in the lagna is strong, so donating Sun items drains it.
Cancer lagna: Sun exalted in the 10th, donating Sun items weakens career standing.

ambiguity: He does not define 'Sun items' here; next sentence names wheat.
classical_check: Classical texts recommend dana of Sun items only for a weak or afflicted Sun, so this agrees.

hindi: सूर्य गेहूं है। आप आटा ही गेहूं ही दान करते रहते हैं अक्सर और सूर्य अच्छा है और आप दे रहे हैं तो गए काम से।
says: Wheat is the Sun's grain; if you keep donating wheat or flour while the Sun is good, you are finished.
classical_check: Wheat for the Sun is classical.

hindi: फिर आप कहोगे हम तो जब से दान कर रहे हैं बहुत बर्बाद हो गए।
says: Then people complain that they have been ruined ever since they started giving in charity.
ambiguity: Observation, not a rule on its own.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: चंद्रमा अच्छा है। लोग पऊ बनवाते हैं। जब सड़क पे आ जाते हैं मौत हो जाती है।
says: If the Moon is good and people set up water stalls, they end up on the road, ruined, and may even die of it; i.e. giving Moon's things (water) when the Moon is already strong is harmful.
cells_derived_method: Strong Moon cells: Cancer, Taurus, or the Moon in kendras (1st, 4th, 7th, 10th) show where this warning applies.

derived_examples.reading: Aries lagna: Moon in its own sign in the 4th is strong; charity of water would drain it.
Taurus lagna: Moon exalted in the lagna, water charity should be avoided.

ambiguity: 'Pau' probably means 'pyau', a free drinking-water stall; 'maut' (death) could be figurative for ruin.
classical_check: Water charity (jaldan) is normally a Moon remedy for a weak Moon, so this agrees.

gist: Jokes that this is why his shop runs, who will pay him fees, he also needs something, says he said it out of greed, and that Pluto speaks, it is not his fault.
Acknowledges the next question: what happens when Sun's debilitation is cancelled (neecha bhanga)?

hindi: सूर्य का नीच भंग हो रहा है। बुरे स्थान में सूर्य नीच राशि का हो के बैठा है तो वो डूब गया। सो दिस इज़ गुड।
says: When the Sun is debilitated and sits in a bad house, it has sunk, and he calls this good (the Sun's fire is drowned).
cells_derived_method: House decides how bad the placement is: 6th, 8th and 12th are the bad houses. Sun is debilitated only in Libra.

derived_examples.reading: Taurus lagna: debilitated Sun in the 6th, 4th lord drowned in a dusthana, enemies lose but home comfort dims.
Pisces lagna: debilitated Sun in the 8th, 6th lord, a classic reversal-type placement where the bad house lord sits in a bad house.
Scorpio lagna: debilitated Sun in the 12th, 10th lord, status falls through loss and expenses.

ambiguity: 'Bure sthan' is not defined; most likely 6th, 8th or 12th but could include any non-kendra. 'This is good' could also refer to the cancellation.
classical_check: Classical neecha bhanga needs conditions like the lord of the sign in a kendra; the rule that a debilitated planet in a dusthana drowns and is good is his own and partly echoes viparita raja yoga.

hindi: लेकिन सूर्य जैसा ग्रह खत्म नहीं होता। इसलिए इसके नीच भंग का मुद्दा मत लो। सूर्य नीच होने के बाद इसको ठंडा ही करना पड़ता है भैया।
says: But a planet like the Sun never finishes, so do not take the neecha bhanga issue for the Sun: once the Sun is debilitated it must still be cooled.
cells_derived_method: Applies to the Sun in Libra in any house; the cell decides which house topics are affected.

derived_examples.reading: Libra lagna: debilitated Sun in the lagna needs cooling even if the sign lord Venus supports.
Capricorn lagna: debilitated Sun in the 10th is still to be cooled despite apparent cancellation.
Aries lagna: debilitated Sun in the 7th, with Venus (an enemy of the Sun) as sign lord, so the Sun is still cooled by remedy.

ambiguity: 'Cooled' means remedial action such as water offering or ruby; not defined here.
classical_check: Classical texts hold that neecha bhanga can give raja yoga; he rejects relying on it for the Sun.

hindi: तो इसमें रेमेडीज भी चलती है। साथ-साथ ले सकते हैं जो रेमेडीज चलती है।
says: So remedies are also valid in this case, and the remedies can be used side by side with any cancellation.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: इसके लिए सबसे बढ़िया रेमेडी है माणिक पहनो। आजकल ग्लास फील्ड
says: For a debilitated Sun the best remedy is wearing a ruby; he begins to warn that nowadays stones are glass-filled (sentence continues into the next slice).
ambiguity: Sentence cut at the slice boundary.
classical_check: Ruby for the Sun is classical.

hindi: माणिक बनता है क्योंकि 34 लाख से कम नहीं आता।
says: A genuine good ruby does not come for less than about 34 lakh rupees, which is why made or treated rubies are sold in the market.
ambiguity: The sentence is clipped at the slice start ('manik banta hai kyonki'), so the exact subject (synthetic versus real) is inferred.
classical_check: Silent; price is a market remark.

hindi: अच्छा माणिक ग्लास फील्ड माणिक 2000 का वो पहन सकते हैं। टेंपरेरी इंपैक्ट के लिए बहुत अच्छा है।
says: A glass-filled ruby costing around 2000 rupees can be worn; it is very good for a temporary effect.
classical_check: Classical texts want a natural unheated ruby; glass-filled stones are a modern cheap substitute he accepts.

hindi: वो रिंग फिंगर में पहना जाता है। पांच सात रत्ती का सोने में पहनो चाहे तांबे में पहनो चांदी में नहीं।
says: The ruby goes on the ring finger, five to seven ratti in weight, set in gold or copper but not in silver.
classical_check: Ring finger, gold or copper and 5-7 ratti are common classical-style norms; silver is avoided because it is the Moon's metal.

hindi: उस माणिक को पहनना है संडे सुबह। गंगाजल से धो लो। कच्चे दूध से धो लो।
says: Wear the ruby on a Sunday morning after washing it with Ganga water and raw milk.
classical_check: Sunday morning for a Sun gem and washing in Ganga water or milk are standard gem-wearing rites.

hindi: अगर आपको बिलीफ है नहीं है तो सादा पहनो।
says: If you have no belief in the ritual, simply wear it plain without any rites.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: या हाइड्रोकार्बन होते हैं सेल्फ चार्ज्ड। उसमें कुछ नहीं है। उसमें ग्लास फिल्ड है। ग्लास भरा है ताकि उसकी चटे ना फूटे।
says: Gems are hydrocarbon matter that charges itself; the cheap one has nothing special inside, only glass filling its cracks so it does not split.
ambiguity: Caption is garbled around 'hydrocarbon self-charged'; the sense is that the stone needs no charging, while the cheap one is just filled with glass.
classical_check: Silent; a modern gemmology remark.

hindi: वो काम करता है, हल्का करता है लेकिन उतना भी काफी।
says: Even the glass-filled ruby works by lightening the problem, and that much is enough.
classical_check: Contrasts with the classical insistence on an unflawed natural stone.

hindi: पांच नंबर राशि छठे, आठवें, 12व घर में नहीं होनी चाहिए। नवंश में हो सकती है।
says: Condition for the ruby: sign number 5 (Leo, the Sun's sign) should not fall in the 6th, 8th or 12th house of the birth chart, though in the navamsha it may.
cells_derived_method: Leo falls in a bad house for lagnas Pisces (6th), Capricorn (8th) and Virgo (12th). Then the Sun lords a dusthana and the ruby would boost a house of loss, so it is not worn.

derived_examples.reading: Pisces lagna: Sun is 6th lord in its own sign in the 6th, ruby avoided as it feeds debts and enemies.
Capricorn lagna: Sun is 8th lord in the 8th, ruby avoided as it feeds sudden events and obstacles.
Virgo lagna: Sun is 12th lord in the 12th, ruby avoided in this rule though he later praises this placement.

ambiguity: 'Panch number rashi' could be sign Leo (confirmed by the later 'Sun's sign') or the fifth house; 'navamsha mein ho sakti hai' is unclear on whether it is allowed or possible.
classical_check: Classical gem rules avoid gems of dusthana lords, which agrees; his added clause about navamsha is his own.

gist: States a conditional: if the Sun is very good in your chart but is debilitated or afflicted in the navamsha (case introduced, answer follows later).

hindi: सातवें घर का स्वामी 12व घर में बैठा है। ये टाइम लगेगा। आपकी गलती है।
says: If the lord of the 7th house sits in the 12th, results take time and the fault lies with the person.
cells_derived_method: The 7th lord changes with lagna: Venus for Aries, Mars for Libra. The sign it occupies in the 12th decides the flavour.

derived_examples.reading: Aries lagna: Venus, 7th lord, in the 12th in Pisces, exalted but in loss house, marriage delayed and partner linked to foreign or secluded matters.
Libra lagna: Mars, 7th lord, in the 12th in Virgo, partnership hurt by expense and conflict.

ambiguity: The caption is very short and the connection to the ruby discussion is not clear.
classical_check: A 7th lord in the 12th giving delay or loss in marriage is classical; 'your fault' is his own wording.

hindi: आपका इस घर का मालिक सूर्य यहां बैठ गया। यहां बैठ गया। यहां बैठ गया। आपको माणिक चाहिए हर हालत में चाहिए। कुछ भी कर लो। कोई दान, कोई पूजा, कोई पाठ कुछ नहीं करेगा।
says: If the Sun, owner of this house, has gone and sat in the bad positions he points at on his board, you need a ruby in every case; no charity, puja or recitation will do anything.
cells_derived_method: Which houses the Sun owns depends on lagna; Leo is the 1st for Leo lagna, 4th for Taurus, 12th for Virgo and so on.

derived_examples.reading: Taurus lagna: Sun is 4th lord and sits debilitated in the 6th; ruby is the main remedy.
Scorpio lagna: Sun is 10th lord debilitated in the 12th; career status is lost and only the ruby is said to help.
Leo lagna: Sun is lagna lord sitting in the 8th in Pisces; health and self-confidence suffer and the ruby is stressed.

ambiguity: The planet's exact positions ('here, here, here') were pointed on the board and are not audible.
classical_check: Classical texts usually allow dana and mantra for the Sun; his 'only ruby works' is a stronger claim.

hindi: यह माणिक ही पहनना पड़ेगा। फूंको दो चार 5 लाख नहीं फूंक सकते। 15, 20, 25,000 का माणिक पहनो। पहनो जरूर पहनना पड़ेगा। किसी हालत में नहीं हो सकता।
says: A ruby has to be worn, you cannot burn five lakh but can buy one for 15, 20 or 25 thousand, and it must be worn, because there is no other way.
ambiguity: Amounts are rupee price points he suggests, not investment advice.
classical_check: Silent on price.

hindi: आपका पांच नंबर का यहां है। अगर आपका सूर्य की राशि पांच नंबर यहां है और यहां सात नंबर का नीच का सूर्य है। तब भी आपको माणिक पहनना ही पड़ेगा।
says: Even if the Sun's own sign (5, Leo) sits in a good place in your chart and the Sun itself is debilitated in sign 7 (Libra), you still must wear a ruby.
cells_derived_method: Libra is the debilitation sign, the Sun's sign Leo being in a good house is a separate condition. Examples show which lagna pairs Leo in a kendra or trikona with Libra Sun in some house.

derived_examples.reading: Libra lagna: Leo is the 11th house, a gain house, yet the Sun is debilitated in the 1st; ruby needed.
Aries lagna: Leo is the 5th house, a trine, yet the Sun is debilitated in the 7th; ruby needed.
Cancer lagna: Leo is the 2nd house of wealth, yet the Sun is debilitated in the 4th; ruby needed.

ambiguity: 'Yahan' (here) refers to a place on the board, so the house of Leo is not stated.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: माणिक पहन लिया है यहां सूर्य पावर पकड़ लेगा। ये बेवकूफ बनाया जाता है। स्टोन पहनने से इतना बड़ा पावर पकड़ लेगा डाउन होगा। नहीं वो बैलेंसिंग होती है।
says: It is a myth that wearing the ruby makes the Sun suddenly powerful; people are fooled this way. In truth a stone only balances.
classical_check: Classical texts claim stones strengthen a planet; he disagrees and calls it a balancing effect.

hindi: ये फिल्टर है। छलनी है। वो बैलेंसिंग करेगा। ना वो अच्छा करेगा ना बुरा। वो न्यूट्रलाइज्ड इफेक्ट देता है।
says: A gemstone is a filter or sieve: it balances, does neither good nor bad, and gives a neutralised effect.
classical_check: Differs from the classical view that a gem of a friendly planet adds strength.

hindi: इस घर के मालिक को जगाएगा। बस यह दारू पी के बेहोश पड़ा हुआ है। ऐसे मान के चलो।
says: The ruby will wake the owner of the house (the Sun), who is lying unconscious like a drunkard; take it that way.
ambiguity: Figurative; 'house owner' means the Sun as lord of a house.
classical_check: Silent.

Jokes he will not be sent to hell, he teaches others, he is scared, 'Pluto zindabad'.

hindi: चौथे घर का स्वामी छठे घर में बैठा है। आठवें में बैठा है। पांच नंबर राशि को जगाने के लिए आपको माणिक पहनना ही पड़ेगा।
says: If the 4th lord is in the 6th or 8th house, you must wear a ruby to awaken the Leo (5) sign.
cells_derived_method: Leo is the 4th house for Taurus lagna, so the Sun is the 4th lord there; the 6th and 8th placements fall in Libra or Aquarius for the Sun.

derived_examples.reading: Taurus lagna: Sun as 4th lord debilitated in the 6th, home comfort disturbed, ruby suggested.
Taurus lagna: Sun as 4th lord in the 8th in Sagittarius, mother and property matters unstable, ruby suggested.

ambiguity: He does not say the 4th lord is the Sun; likely for Taurus lagna where Leo is the 4th, since the sentence ends with 'wake the sign 5'.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: जिस लड़की का पांच नंबर राशि है या पति लड़के का है और सूर्य कहीं बैठा है शादी का सत्यानाश है और सर पांच माणिक पहनते ही शादी में प्रेम शुरू
says: If a girl or a boy has sign 5 (Leo) as the partner's house and the Sun is badly placed, the marriage is ruined; wearing the ruby brings love back into the marriage.
cells_derived_method: Leo is the 7th house for Aquarius lagna; the sign-5 house being the marriage house is inferred, the sentence does not say it.

derived_examples.reading: Aquarius lagna: Leo is the 7th house and the Sun its lord; if the Sun is afflicted, marriage suffers and a ruby is the cure.
Aquarius lagna: the Sun, 7th lord, is debilitated in the 9th; partner and fortune are weakened and the ruby is said to restore love.

ambiguity: 'Panch number rashi' as 7th house is not stated; the sentence is garbled ('pati ladke ka').
classical_check: A Sun-afflicted 7th causing marital friction is classical; the ruby cure is his remedy.

hindi: पांच नंबर राशि 12वें घर में ही है और 12वा घर में ही सूर्य भी है तो बहुत बढ़िया है पांच नंबर का सूर्य पांच नंबर राशि ये तो इससे शानदार क्या होगा मोक्ष होगा
says: If Leo (5) falls in the 12th house and the Sun also sits in the 12th in Leo, it is excellent, and nothing is better than this: it gives moksha.
cells_derived_method: Leo is the 12th for Virgo lagna; Sun is 12th lord in own sign in the 12th. Other houses where the Sun sits in Leo give different results.

derived_examples.reading: Virgo lagna: Sun as 12th lord in its own house, expenses go to dharma and liberation.
Leo lagna: Sun in the lagna in own sign gives strength and royal bearing, not moksha.
Sagittarius lagna: Sun as 9th lord in the 9th in own sign gives fortune and father's support.

ambiguity: He says Sun sits 'in the 12th house' and the sign is Leo; he does not mention the lagna Virgo.
classical_check: Lord of the 12th in the 12th is the classical Vimala yoga; it agrees with the moksha and charitable-spending result.

hindi: ये बंदा इतना पैसा फूंके इतना पैसा फूंके इस पे चलके आएगा इसने क्या कर दिया खर्चे फिक्स कर दिए बंदा जो ये बेहोश वाला स्पाइट नहीं जागा हुआ सूर्य बैठा है सूर्य नष्ट तो होएगा नहीं
says: This person will burn a lot of money (on charity and dharma), his expenses are fixed by this placement, and the Sun is awake rather than unconscious and cannot be destroyed.

Cancer lagna: Sun in Leo in the 2nd is the 2nd lord in its own sign, so the same money is saved rather than burnt.

hindi: एक्चुअली चार नंबर का चंद्रमा यहां होगा तो सत्यानाश है क्योंकि चंद्रमा तो दूसरे के रूप पे चलता है बुध होगा भटक गया वो दूसरे के हिसाब से चलता है
says: If the Moon in sign 4 (Cancer) sits here instead, it is a disaster because the Moon follows another's form; Mercury would also lose its way, since both depend on others.

hindi: सूर्य तो किसी के हिसाब से चलता ही नहीं ये पांच नंबर का यहां बैठा है यह बंदा अरबों रुपए अरबों रुपए लेगा इसको अरबों रुपए आएंगे
says: The Sun does not follow anyone else; with the Sun in sign 5 sitting here, this person will get billions of rupees. (Wealth claim as he stated it.)

classical_check: A Sun in its own sign in the 12th giving billions is not a classical outcome; the 12th is a loss house.

hindi: इसमें जी सूर्य की डिग्री अच्छी होनी चाहिए जिदार हो बंदा लेगा
says: In this case the Sun's degree must be good wherever it sits, otherwise the person does not get the result.
ambiguity: Caption fragment 'jidhar ho banda lega'; read as 'wherever the person gets it'.
classical_check: Degree strength (shadbala by degree) is classical in spirit.

hindi: 22 साल की ऐज से सूर्य पावर पकड़ना शुरू करता है किसी किस्म के दोष भी हो तो 22 के बाद मध्यम हो जा ऑटोमेटिक िकली ऐसा होता है
says: From the age of 22 the Sun begins to gain power, and whatever faults it has become moderate after 22 automatically.
cells_derived_method: Age-based: the Sun's maturity age is 22 in this scheme; it applies to the Sun in any cell and softens flaws in any house.

derived_examples.reading: Capricorn lagna: debilitated Sun in the 10th: career block eases after 22.
Aries lagna: Sun in Cancer in the 4th: mother-home issues soften after 22.

ambiguity: 'Working' and caption noise precede the sentence.
classical_check: The classical age of maturity for the Sun is 22 in the Lal Kitab-style planet-age lists; this agrees with that tradition.

hindi: डिग्री वाइज सूर्य जो है दो 3 डिग्री का सूर्य बहुत शुभ है। सातवें घर में भी पड़ा है तो तलाक नहीं करेगा।
says: A Sun at two to three degrees is very auspicious; even if it sits in the 7th house it will not cause divorce.
cells_derived_method: 7th-house Sun is usually a marriage-friction placement; the sign decides how, and low degrees remove the divorce risk. Aries gives the strongest result, Libra the weakest.

derived_examples.reading: Aries lagna: debilitated Sun in the 7th at 2-3 degrees, divorce risk removed by low degree.
Libra lagna: Sun in Aries in the 7th at 2-3 degrees, a strong dignified Sun, marriage stable.
Aquarius lagna: Sun in own sign in the 7th at 2-3 degrees, the best case.

ambiguity: Divorce is a marital outcome claim, recorded as stated, not a verified prediction.
classical_check: Classical texts treat Sun in the 7th as harmful to marriage with no degree exception; the 2-3 degree rule is his own.

hindi: अगर 7 8 डिग्री बियड 8 हो गया तो वो बिय्ड 6 7 आठ वैसे कई फैक्टर्स होते हैं इसलिए बोल रहा हूं मैं लेकिन हम 6 डिग्री वाले के भी कई बार फ्रिक्शन देखिए पतिपत्नी में फ्रिक्शन घर्षण है जहां देगा घर्षण देगा
says: Beyond about 7 or 8 degrees the protection weakens, but many factors decide it; he has seen friction between husband and wife even with a 6 degree Sun, because the Sun gives friction wherever it sits.
ambiguity: The caption is heavily garbled around the degree figures (7, 8, 6); thresholds are uncertain.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: और यहां पर अगर रगड़ देगा आग लगा देगा यहां भी वैसा ही होगा फिर यहां भी जो राशि अपनी है ना राशि अपनी है तो ज्यादा डिग्री भी चलेगी जो मर्जी डिग्री हो ये तो इसका घर है
says: Where the Sun rubs it sets fire, but if it is in its own sign any degree is fine, because it is its own house.
cells_derived_method: In own sign Leo the degree matters less; the house decides which life area is helped.

derived_examples.reading: Aquarius lagna: Sun in own sign in the 7th, high degree still tolerable for marriage.
Scorpio lagna: Sun in own sign in the 10th, high degree gives command without friction.
Gemini lagna: Sun in Leo in the 3rd, courage; degree matters little.

ambiguity: 'Yahan' is a board position; context says own sign (Leo).
classical_check: Planets in own signs being strong at any degree is classical.

hindi: धक धक के चलेगा और अंधा पैसा और धर्म के अंदर फूंकेगा अय्याशियां भी नहीं करेगा मर्यादा है ना
says: He will walk proudly and spend money blindly on dharma, without indulging in debauchery because he keeps discipline and propriety.
cells_derived_method: Likely the 12th house case from the earlier lines: 12th gives spending, Sun in Leo directs it into dharma.

Aries lagna: the same Sun in the 5th would show pride and spending on children and learning, not so much dharma.

hindi: हां बीमार नहीं पड़ेगा ये बीमारी का खर्चा है ही नहीं हॉस्पिटल एक्सपेंसेस हॉस्पिटल एक्सपेंसेस
says: Such a person will not fall ill, so there is no illness expense; hospital expenses are absent. (Health outcome as he stated it.)

says: Hospital expenses are dead, he will not incur them, but other expenses are many; the Sun makes him a big-hearted man.

hindi: तो नववांश के अंदर बैठ गया अगर तो उसके तो उपाय अलग होंगे पर यह वाला आपको

hindi: तो सारे बैलेंस नहीं पूछ लो ना किसी से कि भाई कैसे वाले रहे हमारे हमारा लीडिंग प्लनेट क्या है? लेकिन सूर्य चरित्र तो लेके चलो किसी भी कार्य में।

hindi: आप राजा सम्राट हो। आप माफ़ कर सकते हो। हम भूलते ही नहीं पुरानी बातें नहीं भूलते जलाते रहते हैं अपना खून का पानी बना देता है यह मंगल दोष के कारण
