gist: Viewer asks how to strengthen a Sun placed at 0 to 5 degrees.

hindi: स्ट्रांग नहीं करना वो स्ट्रांग है फिर तो आग का गोला बन जाएगा आगे 10 12 डिग्री फिर क्या अचार डालोगे उसका तो
says: Do not strengthen a Sun at 0 to 5 degrees, it is already strong and would become a ball of fire; he jokes that at 10 or 12 degrees you would have to pickle it.
cells_derived_method: Applies in any house or sign; in Aries or Leo an already strong Sun gets stronger still at low degrees.

derived_examples.reading: Aries lagna: Sun exalted in the lagna at 3 degrees, no strengthening remedy needed.
Capricorn lagna: debilitated Sun in the 10th at 3 degrees, still not strengthened by gem or charity.

ambiguity: The pickle remark is a joke on the case at 10-12 degrees.
classical_check: Degree below 5 meaning strength is his own; classical Gandanta or bala degrees differ.

gist: Viewer asks if a planet sitting near the Sun becomes combust.

hindi: होंगे। अस्त कर देगा उसको। 0 से 5° में भी। ज़ीरो से पांच नहीं वो सूर्य के पास है कि नहीं? अगर वो सूर्य 5° का है और दूसरा ग्रह 8 डिग्री का है तो उसके तो बिल्कुल पड़ोस में बैठा है। अस्त हो गया।
says: Yes, the Sun combusts any planet close to it, even at 0 to 5 degrees; the test is nearness to the Sun, not the Sun's own degree: with the Sun at 5 and another planet at 8 degrees, it is right next door and combust.
cells_derived_method: Combustion works in any house or sign where a planet is within a few degrees of the Sun; houses decide which topic is lost.

derived_examples.reading: Cancer lagna: Sun at 5 and Mercury at 8 degrees of Aries in the 10th, Mercury combust, speech and business support lost.
Aries lagna: Sun and Venus close in Libra in the 7th, Venus combust, marriage matters scorched.
Aries lagna: Sun and Venus in Taurus in the 2nd, Venus combust and family wealth strained.

ambiguity: He does not give a combustion orb in this sentence.
classical_check: Combustion by closeness to the Sun is classical, orbs differ per planet.

hindi: 10 डिग्री के बाद तो अस्त करना शुरू कर देता है सूर्य। 12 13 डिग्री के बाद 12 13
says: The Sun starts combusting planets from roughly ten degrees away and the effect continues to 12 or 13 degrees (sentence cut at the slice end).
ambiguity: Unclear whether 10 degrees is the start or the outer limit of the combust zone.
classical_check: Classical orbs: Moon 12, Mars 17, Mercury 14, Jupiter 11, Venus 10, Saturn 15 degrees, so his 10 to 13 range roughly agrees for some planets.

gist: Opening fragment 'degree tak' (up to ... degrees) carried over from the combustion orb sentence of the previous slice.

hindi: तो फिर ऐसे में जो अस्त हो रहा है उसकी रेमेडी चाहिए होगी। अस्त जो होगा उसकी रेमेडी चाहिए।
says: When the Sun combusts a planet, that combust planet is the one that needs the remedy.
cells_derived_method: The combust planet depends on who sits near the Sun, and the house shows which life area it damages.

derived_examples.reading: Virgo lagna: Mercury, lagna and 10th lord, burnt by the Sun in the 10th, so the remedy goes to Mercury for career and intellect.
Pisces lagna: Mercury, 4th and 7th lord, combust with the Sun in Virgo in the 7th; Mercury's remedy for partner and home matters.
Gemini lagna: Mercury as lagna lord combust with the Sun in the 1st, body and mind need Mercury's remedy.

classical_check: Remedying the afflicted planet rather than the afflicting one is the classical approach.

hindi: अगर मान लो उसने बुध को अस्त कर दिया तो पन्ना पहनाओ।
says: If the Sun has combusted Mercury, make the person wear an emerald.
classical_check: Emerald for Mercury is classical.

hindi: अगर राशियां बुध की तीन नंबर ठीक है तो छह नंबर नॉट अ प्रॉब्लम। तीन नंबर ठीक है तो पन्ना पहनाना पड़ेगा
says: Emerald is judged by Mercury's sign Gemini (3): if Gemini is well placed in the chart then Virgo (6) is not a problem and the emerald must be worn.
ambiguity: He treats Gemini as the deciding Mercury sign; whether the same test covers Virgo separately is not said beyond 'not a problem'.
classical_check: Silent on a Gemini-only test; classically the lagna lord and house of the stone's planet are judged.

hindi: नहीं तो उसकी बुद्धि अस्त रहेगी सारे टाइम अस्त रहेगी वह दूसरा सूर्य ढूंढता रहेगा कोई ना कोई
says: Without the emerald the person's intellect stays combust all the time, and he keeps looking for some other Sun, meaning someone else to lean on for authority and direction.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: 24 राशि ठीक है मतलब वो 6 8 12 में प्लेस ना हो 6 8 12 में
says: A sign is 'fine' for the stone when it is not placed in the 6th, 8th or 12th house; here Gemini must not be in those houses.
cells_derived_method: Gemini falls in the 6th for Capricorn lagna, in the 8th for Scorpio lagna and in the 12th for Cancer lagna; in those cases Mercury lords a dusthana and the emerald is held back.

derived_examples.reading: Capricorn lagna: Mercury lords the 6th (Gemini) and 9th (Virgo); the Gemini side sits in the 6th, emerald not automatic.
Scorpio lagna: Mercury lords the 8th (Gemini) and 11th (Virgo), emerald not automatic.
Cancer lagna: Mercury lords the 12th (Gemini) and 3rd (Virgo), emerald not automatic.

ambiguity: The caption '24 rashi' is garbled, probably 'to rashi theek hai'; reading follows the previous sentence.
classical_check: Avoiding gems of lords of 6, 8, 12 is the classical rule.

gist: Viewer asks which planet causes cervical spondylitis.

hindi: अच्छा शनि सर इसमें राहु भी रहेगा शनि का एजेंट है हड्डी और नसों की प्रॉब्लम नर्व्स है ये नर्व्स सारे के सारे बुध के और शनि के पास है
says: For neck and nerve trouble he points to Saturn, with Rahu also involved as Saturn's agent; bones and nerves are Saturn's and all the nerves belong to Mercury and Saturn. (Body-part karaka mapping, not a diagnosis.)
ambiguity: Medical mapping only; no diagnosis made.
classical_check: Saturn for bones and Mercury for nerves is classical; Rahu as Saturn's agent is his usual line.

gist: Defers the Saturn question: will do it in the Saturn class, Mercury will come up in class [noise marker in the caption].

hindi: बेसिकली धागे बताए थे मैंने पिछली क्लास जो की थी हमने तो मुनीम जी धागे हां मुनीम जी धागे बेस्ट होते हैं उसी से करना चाहिए
says: As the remedy he points back to the threads taught in the earlier class, the 'accountant's threads', which are best for this and should be used.
ambiguity: 'Munim ji dhaage' is a name from his earlier class and is not explained here; the planet link is inferred from the nerve discussion.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: Next viewer question: what exactly is called lottery or speculation (satta).
Viewer continues: some speculators calculate properly and run it like a profitable business, so is that also satta and lottery?

hindi: जो डिफरेंस जो कैलकुलेशन करके कर रहे हैं वो मैथमेटिशियन है। वो आप कैलकुलेशन करके कर रहे हो वो कार्यक्रम डिफरेंट है। है वो भी सट्टा लेकिन इट्स अ कैलकुलेटेड सट्टा
says: Those who calculate are mathematicians and their programme is different; it is still speculation but a calculated one. (Speculation statement, not investment advice.)
ambiguity: Definition only; he is not recommending any trade.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: लेकिन उनको वो सूट करना चाहिए। उसके लिए शनि का हिसाब होता है। यदि शनि का सपोर्ट नहीं होगा तो प्रीलिव करा देता है। आपकी कुंडली में शनि की प्रेश पावरफुल होना शनि का बहुत ज्यादा जरूरी है।
says: It must suit the person, and that depends on Saturn: without Saturn's support it makes things go wrong, so a powerful Saturn in the chart is very necessary for speculation.
cells_derived_method: A powerful Saturn means own sign (Capricorn, Aquarius), exaltation (Libra) or good house placement; the result differs by house.

derived_examples.reading: Aries lagna: Saturn exalted in the 7th, strong, calculated risk suits.
Aries lagna: Saturn in its own sign in the 10th, strong, steady speculative gain through work.
Sagittarius lagna: Saturn in its own sign in the 3rd, strong, effort-led risk-taking suits.

ambiguity: 'Prelive' is a garbled word; probably 'ruins' or 'beats' the person. Speculation guidance is not investment advice.
classical_check: Saturn as karaka of risk, luck-through-effort and the dark world is his own view; classics tie gambling to Rahu and the 5th house.

hindi: आपके घर का वेस्ट डायरेक्शन सेट होता है तो आपको सट्टा सूट करता है। नॉर्थ वेस्ट सेट होता है। चंद्रमा का डिस्क चंद्रमा का हेल्प मिलती है।
says: Vastu link: if the west direction of your house is set right then speculation suits you, and also the north-west, from which the Moon's help comes.
classical_check: West for Saturn and north-west for the Moon is classical Vastu direction lordship; the link to speculation is his own.

hindi: पांचवें घर के अंदर बहुत अच्छा कोई ग्रह हो जो चंद्र जो सूर्य है जहां का मालिक बेसिकली ओनरशिप उसकी है तो वहां वो कहता है कोई शुद्धि रहनी चाहिए।
says: A very good planet should sit in the 5th house, ideally the lord of that place, and there should be purity there; the Sun is named in the garbled caption as the owner.
cells_derived_method: The 5th house is a different sign for each lagna, so the best lord differs: Sun for Aries lagna, Venus for Gemini lagna, Jupiter for Leo lagna.

derived_examples.reading: Aries lagna: Sun owns the 5th, a strong Sun there is good for speculation if kept pure.
Gemini lagna: Venus owns the 5th, a clean Venus is the helper.
Leo lagna: Jupiter owns the 5th, a clean Jupiter is the helper.

ambiguity: Caption is garbled ('chandra jo surya hai'); the planet is not certain and 'shuddhi' (purity) is not defined.
classical_check: 5th lord and 5th house for speculation is classical.

hindi: पितरों की कृपा हो तो आपको सट्टा सूट करेगा।
says: If you have the grace of your ancestors, speculation will suit you.
classical_check: Pitru grace through the 5th and 9th and the Sun is a classical theme.

hindi: वो सट्टे वाला सट्टा नहीं है वो वो वाला जैसे जुए के अंदर कोई अमीर नहीं बना आज तक ये कहने की बात है जुआ खेल के अमीर बने देर सवेर बंदा फंस फंसा के मारा ही जाता है
says: Ordinary gambling is different: nobody has ever got rich by gambling, claims of this are only talk; sooner or later the gambler gets trapped and is finished.
ambiguity: 'Mara hi jata hai' is figurative for ruin; not a death claim.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: तो जो कैलकुलेट करके समझदारी तरीके से कर रहे हैं अहंकार नहीं कर रहे बृहस्पति खराब नहीं कर रहे उनका सूर्य खराब नहीं हो सकता
says: Those who do it with calculation and sense, without ego, are not spoiling Jupiter, so their Sun cannot be spoiled.
classical_check: Silent; ego spoiling Jupiter is his own link.

gist: Viewer mentions that even Henry Sugar (the Roald Dahl gambler) gave up gambling.

hindi: अगर अहंकार नहीं कर रहे बृहस्पति के बिना नहीं सूर्य सर्वाइव करेगा जीवन धरती पे सूर्य और बृहस्पति के बीच ही है
says: The Sun cannot survive without Jupiter, because life on earth exists between the Sun and Jupiter.
classical_check: Silent; a modern-physics-style argument.

hindi: अहंकार नहीं किया तो बृहस्पति डिस्टर्ब नहीं होगा फॉल्स ईगो एनी टाइप ऑफ ईगो तो आपका बृहस्पति डिस्टर्ब नहीं होगा। आप ये वाला सट्टा कैलकुलेटेड खेलो। कोई प्रॉब्लम नहीं।
says: If you have no ego of any kind, false or otherwise, Jupiter is not disturbed, and then he says calculated speculation can be played without any problem. (His statement on speculation, not a recommendation to trade.)
ambiguity: Speculation permission is his remark; not investment advice.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: Viewer adds that in Henry Sugar the man first strengthened the Sun out of greed and then lost his attachment once the Sun grew strong, as knowledge comes.

hindi: बृहस्पति या तो अहंकार करके नष्ट हो जाएगा केतु के अंडर। और नहीं तो फिर ज्ञान हो गया तो मोह ही नहीं रहता। फिर क्या मोह है?
says: Jupiter either gets destroyed through ego, coming under Ketu, or knowledge arises and attachment itself vanishes; then what attachment remains?
classical_check: Jupiter under Ketu as a spiritual or ruinous fork is his own framing.

gist: Viewer says it is also said that gambling should be no one's habit; he replies that is just words and mostly it is so.
Remarks that politicians are playing nothing but gamble and the whole world runs on gamble.

hindi: क्योंकि काली दुनिया का मालिक शनि है। बृहस्पति के नीचे वो जुआ ही खेलता है।
says: Saturn is the owner of the dark world and under Jupiter he does nothing but gamble.
classical_check: Saturn as the dark-side karaka is common; gambling under Jupiter is his own phrase.

hindi: लोगों को तुक्के से हीरा मिल जाता है। जितने तुक्के से कहते हैं अरे बड़ी अच्छी लड़की मिल गई। शादी हो गई। अरे तुक्के से नौकरी मिल गई। अरे यार सोचा भी नहीं था एडमिशन मिल गया। यह सब जुआ है। यह काली दुनिया का मालिक है। यह है शनि।
says: Luck-based gains such as finding a diamond, a good spouse, a job or an admission by chance are all gambling and belong to Saturn, the master of the dark world.
classical_check: Sudden luck is classically attributed to Rahu and the 5th/9th houses rather than Saturn.

hindi: सूर्य तो रोशनी की दुनिया का मालिक है। ये आज उसकी बात हो रही है।
says: The Sun, in contrast, is the master of the world of light, and today's class is about him.
classical_check: Sun as the soul and light is classical.

gist: Viewer asks whether a ruby should also be worn for a Sun that is only 'debilitation-like', as is done for retrograde planets.

hindi: यस उसके लिए भी माणिक नीच सूर्य है। राशि चंद पांच नंबर ओके है। माणिक आंख मूंद के पहन लो। मत सोचो
says: Yes, for a debilitated Sun also wear the ruby, provided Leo (5) is in an acceptable place; he says to wear it with closed eyes and not to think about it.
cells_derived_method: Debilitation is in Libra; Leo's house changes with the Sun's house, and the ruby is allowed when Leo is not in the 6th, 8th or 12th.

derived_examples.reading: Libra lagna: Leo is the 11th, fine, so wear the ruby.
Aries lagna: Leo is the 5th, fine, so wear the ruby.
Cancer lagna: Leo is the 2nd, fine, so wear the ruby.

ambiguity: The caption 'rashi chand paanch number' is garbled; read as 'rashi, Leo, sign five, is okay'.
classical_check: Classical practice also allows a gem for a debilitated planet if it lords a good house.

hindi: आठवें घर में नीच आठवें घर में नीच में तो छठा घर में पांच राशि होगी। छठे घर में या 12व घर में नीच का भी सूर्य पड़ा है। माणिक पहन लो वो उसी से ही हल्का होगा।
says: Even if the debilitated Sun sits in the 8th (which puts Leo in the 6th), or in the 6th or 12th, wear the ruby; that is what lightens it.
cells_derived_method: Libra Sun in the 8th puts Leo in the 6th (Pisces lagna); in the 6th it puts Leo in the 4th (Taurus lagna); in the 12th it puts Leo in the 10th (Scorpio lagna).

derived_examples.reading: Pisces lagna: Sun is 6th lord debilitated in the 8th and Leo falls in the 6th; ruby still advised.
Taurus lagna: Sun is 4th lord debilitated in the 6th; Leo falls in the 4th and ruby advised.
Scorpio lagna: Sun is 10th lord debilitated in the 12th; Leo falls in the 10th and ruby advised.

ambiguity: This overrides his earlier condition that Leo must not be in the 6th, 8th or 12th, and he does not reconcile the two.
classical_check: Contradicts his own earlier gem rule and the classical rule against gems of dusthana lords.

hindi: कोई शास्त्र नहीं, कोई कुछ नहीं। यह बहुत सालों की स्टडी है। देखा ये 100% रिलीफ देगा।
says: He says no scripture backs this; it is based on many years of his own study and he claims the ruby gives 100 percent relief.
ambiguity: The 100 percent figure is his own claim, not measured data.
classical_check: Explicitly outside classical texts, by his own words.

gist: Viewer asks whether the Sun also causes acidity-related problems in the body.

hindi: एसिडिटी भी आती है।
says: Yes, acidity also comes from a troubled Sun. (Body-karaka mapping, not a diagnosis.)
ambiguity: Short reply; no further conditions given.
classical_check: Sun as the karaka of digestive fire and pitta is classical.

gist: Remarks that a lot of syllabus is covered, he feels the class could run two more hours, but viewers' questions have wound up.
Course-planning talk: threads and charity points left incomplete, to be continued; plans to cover the planets first one by one and then the houses, about one hundred classes in mind.
Viewer asks about Sun and Ketu sitting together in the lagna or in sign 5 or any sign.

hindi: डिग्री अगर है तो केतु ढाप लेगा मान लो केतु 2 डिग्री का है सूर्य 22 डिग्री का है तो वो इतनी दूर है कि कोई है ही नहीं इफेक्ट
says: For a Sun-Ketu conjunction the degrees decide: if they are close Ketu covers the Sun, but if Ketu is at 2 degrees and the Sun at 22 they are too far apart and there is no effect.
cells_derived_method: Applies in any sign and house; the house shows where the eclipsing hurts.

derived_examples.reading: Leo lagna: Sun and Ketu within a few degrees in the lagna covers the self and vitality; 20 degrees apart does nothing.
Cancer lagna: Sun with Ketu close in Aries in the 10th hides status and authority; far apart, career is untouched.
Taurus lagna: Sun and Ketu in Leo in the 4th cover home comfort only if close; apart there is no effect.

ambiguity: He does not give an orb in degrees, only the 2 versus 22 example.
classical_check: Orb-based conjunction strength is classical; Ketu as eclipser of the Sun is classical.

hindi: केतु केतु यहां काम करेगा केतु यहां काम करेगा है वो बैठा यहां और हो सकता है सूर्य यहां काम करेगा दिखेंगे यहां
says: Ketu will work in one house while the Sun may work or show its results in another, because planets sit in one house in the sign chart but act in a shifted house.
cells_derived_method: Planets near a house boundary shift to the neighbouring house in the bhava chalit, so conjoined planets can act in different houses.

derived_examples.reading: Aries lagna: Sun at the start of Taurus stays in the 2nd, while Ketu at the end of Taurus shifts to the 3rd in the chalit.
Aries lagna: Sun at the end of Pisces moves to the 1st in the chalit while Ketu at the start stays in the 12th.

ambiguity: Board positions ('here') are not audible; reading follows the next sentence about the chalit chart.
classical_check: Bhava chalit shifting planets is classical.

hindi: इसीलिए मुन्ना भाई की कुंडली बनती है जो ज्योतिषी बनाते नहीं वो कहते हैं सूर्य केतु है इफेक्ट आते नहीं इफेक्ट मिलते ही नहीं और ये खिसके हुए चलित चलित केपी मुन्ना भाई की कुंडली जो राशि भी घूम रही है।
says: That is why the 'Munna Bhai chart' is made: astrologers who do not make it say the Sun-Ketu effects are not coming, but in the shifted chalit and KP chart, where the signs also move, the effects are found.
ambiguity: 'Munna Bhai ki kundli' is his own name for the chalit and KP chart with sign numbers; he does not define it fully here.
classical_check: Bhava chalit and KP are classical or modern systems; the nickname is his.

hindi: अगर चलित और उसके अंदर यह मुन्ना भाई की राशि नंबर भी डाल दोगे तो आपको इतने कंक्रीट इफेक्ट मिलते हैं कि इंसान हैरान परेशान हो जाए।
says: If you take the chalit chart and also put the sign numbers inside its houses, the effects found are so concrete that the person is astonished.
cells_derived_method: A house in the chalit touches two or three signs, so placing sign numbers inside each house gives more precise readings; this matches the multi-sign-house idea.

derived_examples.reading: Aries lagna: the 1st house in the chalit holds the end of Pisces and most of Aries, so both signs carry weight.
Aries lagna: the 7th house holds Libra and part of Virgo or Scorpio depending on the ascendant degree.

ambiguity: 'Concrete effects' is an accuracy claim; no figures are given.
classical_check: Houses spanning more than one sign in chalit is classical; the amazement claim is his own.

hindi: यह तो कॉस्मोस की फोटोग्राफ 3 डी बनानी पड़ेगी हमें। ग्रह ऐसा गोल है। पूरे गोल घूम रहे हैं इतने बड़े।
says: We would really need a 3D photograph of the cosmos, since the planets are round and move around in a full sphere.
classical_check: Silent; a modelling remark.

hindi: तो वह राशियां बहुत डिफरेंटली चलती हैं। कोई कोई राशि स्टार्टिंग एंडिंग 10° के कोई 20° की है। कोई 25 30 ऐसे चलता है। अलग-अलग है।
says: Signs run very differently in the actual sky: some signs span only about 10 degrees, some 20 and some 25 to 30, so houses are of unequal size and are touched by different numbers of signs.
cells_derived_method: Sign widths on the ascendant vary with latitude and time, so each house takes a different share of its signs; the readings must weight signs by share.

derived_examples.reading: Aries lagna: if Aries is short on the horizon, the 1st house takes a larger share from Pisces and Taurus.
Aries lagna: a long Capricorn on the mid-heaven fills the 10th house almost alone.

ambiguity: Uses the word 'rashi' for sign extent; not clear whether he means house cusp spans.
classical_check: Unequal house spans in Sripati or Placidus systems are classical; this fits the project's multi-sign-house rule.

gist: Viewer acknowledges 'yes' and introduces Jaimini.

hindi: जैमिनी का तरीका है सूर्य हमारा आत्मकारक ग्रह है। आत्म महात् भ्रांति कारक ऐसे ऐसे होते हैं। सूर्य आत्मकारक ग्रह है।
says: In Jaimini's method the Sun is our atmakaraka, the significator of the soul, the first of a series of karakas (atma, amatya, bhratri and so on).
ambiguity: The list 'atma mahat bhranti karaka' is a garbled version of the Jaimini karaka series (atma, amatya, bhratri).
classical_check: In Jaimini the atmakaraka is the planet of highest degree, not always the Sun; the Sun is the natural (naisargika) karaka of the soul. His statement is the natural-karaka sense.

gist: Closes the topic: what was covered on the soul is done, other matters remain and are endless, Jaimini also works, this is a rough outline and finer detail will come later.
Opening fragment 'jayega' (will go) carried over from the previous slice, no usable meaning.

hindi: इसलिए सूर्य के लिए आपको करना ही है तो हम तो चारित्रिक बात कर रहे हैं।
says: If you must do something for the Sun, he is talking about character and conduct as the remedy.
classical_check: Classics prescribe mantra, gem and dana for the Sun; a conduct-first remedy is his emphasis.

hindi: झूठ बोलने से सूर्य नष्ट होता है।
says: Telling lies destroys the Sun in a person's life.
classical_check: Truthfulness as the Sun's dharma is a common view, not a text rule.

hindi: दूसरे की स्त्री के साथ पर स्त्री गमन करने से सूर्य नष्ट होता है।
says: Going with another man's wife (adultery) destroys the Sun.
classical_check: Adultery harming reputation and the Sun is a general dharma claim; no classical rule is cited.

hindi: पिता का सम्मान ना करने से नष्ट होता है।
says: Not honouring your father also destroys the Sun, since the father is the Sun's relation.
classical_check: Sun as the father karaka is classical, so disrespect to the father hurting the Sun fits.

hindi: मान लो पिता ये आपका बहुत घटिया है। गिरा हुआ है। दारूबाज है अय्याश है तो गुरु का सम्मान कर लो। सूर्य की जरूरत ही नहीं है। दफा करो।
says: If your father is very low, fallen, a drunkard or a debauchee, honour a guru instead; then the Sun's remedy is not needed at all, forget it.
classical_check: Guru as a substitute for the father is his own remedy; classics do not state it.

hindi: मां का सम्मान करने से भी सूर्य सेट। मां के साथ तालमेल नहीं। मां मर गई। जिंदा नहीं या दूसरी मां गोद लो नहीं। तो वो फिर गुरु से।
says: Honouring your mother also sets the Sun right; if there is no rapport with the mother, she has died, or you have no second mother, then do it through the guru.
classical_check: Mother as the Moon and Sun-setting through her is his own link; the guru route repeats the previous rule.

hindi: तो गुरु के थ्रू रास्ता बृहस्पति जो है उसमें चंद्रमा और सूर्य लाजवाब है।
says: The route through the guru is Jupiter, and in Jupiter both the Moon and the Sun are covered excellently.
classical_check: Jupiter being friendly to both Sun and Moon is classical.

hindi: बेसिकली सूर्य सूर्य इज एवरीथिंग क्योंकि उसके बाद सब है लेकिन सूर्य मूवमेंट नहीं लेता। सूर्य के कारण से सब मूवमेंट ले रहे हैं तो पुरुष तत्व है।
says: The Sun is everything because all else comes after it; the Sun itself does not move, everything moves because of it, so it is the male (purusha) principle.
classical_check: Sun as purusha and atma is classical.

hindi: इसलिए पूर्ण पुरुष कृष्ण सूर्य के पास है। उन्हीं के पास सुदर्शन चक्र है।
says: So the complete man, Krishna, is linked to the Sun and he holds the Sudarshan chakra.
ambiguity: Mythic link, not a chart rule.
classical_check: Classical avatar mapping puts Rama with the Sun and Krishna with the Moon, so this differs.

hindi: हम यहां तो सूर्य की मेडिसिन की बात कर रहे हैं। सूर्य के लिए अगर इलाज करते हैं तो हम जैसे अभी हमने बताया ऑरेंज स्टेशनरी अवॉइड करते हैं।
says: Here he is giving the Sun's remedies; when treating the Sun, as already said, avoid orange stationery.
ambiguity: Repeats the earlier stationery rule; 'medicine' means remedy, not medical treatment.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: ऐसे ही सूर्य की चीजें पत्नी को नहीं देनी।
says: In the same way, do not give the Sun's things to your wife.
ambiguity: The wife is read through the 7th house and Venus; he does not name the houses here.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: मान लो यहां सात यहां सूर्य की राशि खराब है। यहां सूर्य ही बैठा है। अभी सूर्य को गर्म नहीं करना। पति पत्नी में झगड़ा होगा।
says: If sign 7 (Libra), the Sun's spoiled sign, is here and the Sun itself sits in it, do not heat the Sun further, or quarrels will arise between husband and wife.
cells_derived_method: A debilitated Sun in Libra in any house; the 7th house is the most sensitive for the husband-wife quarrel, other houses show other friction.

derived_examples.reading: Aries lagna: debilitated Sun in the 7th, most direct spousal quarrel, so keep Sun items away.
Libra lagna: debilitated Sun in the lagna, quarrels reach home through the native's own temper.
Cancer lagna: debilitated Sun in the 4th, quarrels over home and mother.

ambiguity: The caption splits 'yahan saat' (here seven) and 'yahan Sun hi baitha hai' over the slice boundary; read as sign 7 with the Sun in it.
classical_check: Sun in Libra giving marital friction is classical.

hindi: कभी पत्नी को गोल्ड मत दिलाओ। हालांकि सब पत्नियां मुझे गाली बकेंगी। बहन को डायमंड दिलाओ अब खुश होंगी क्योंकि आप सूर्य को पावर नहीं दे सकते यार
says: Never buy gold for the wife (wives will curse him for it); get diamond instead, because you must not give power to the Sun, which gold (Jupiter's metal) would do.
ambiguity: Applies when the Sun is troubled and linked to the spouse; he does not repeat that condition here.
classical_check: Gold as Jupiter and diamond as Venus are classical; the reasoning is his own.

hindi: बृहस्पति स्थाननाशक होता है
says: Jupiter destroys the house it occupies (sthana-nashaka).
cells_derived_method: Jupiter damages the house it sits in; the house affected changes by cell.

derived_examples.reading: Sagittarius lagna: Jupiter, lagna lord, in the 7th in Gemini, hurts partnership matters.
Pisces lagna: Jupiter, lagna and 10th lord, in the 4th in Gemini, hurts home peace and mother.
Gemini lagna: Jupiter, 7th and 10th lord, in its own sign in the 10th, hurts career standing by this maxim.

ambiguity: He says only 'sthananashak' with no house list.
classical_check: Classical maxim 'karako bhava nashaya' applies to karakas in their own houses; Jupiter in the 2nd and 5th is an exception.

hindi: उच्च का बृहस्पति उच्च का शुक्र वाली लड़की का घर नहीं बसता नर्क है उसकी जिंदगी
says: A girl with an exalted Jupiter and an exalted Venus does not get a settled home and her life is hell. (Marriage claim as stated.)
cells_derived_method: Jupiter is exalted in Cancer and Venus in Pisces; the house they sit in decides whether the loss falls on home (4th), marriage (7th) or family (2nd).

derived_examples.reading: Capricorn lagna: Jupiter exalted in the 7th, by his rule the marriage does not settle.
Aries lagna: Jupiter exalted in the 4th, by his rule home life does not settle.
Virgo lagna: Venus exalted in the 7th, by his rule the home does not settle.

ambiguity: He says only 'exalted Jupiter, exalted Venus'; whether both must be in the chart or only one is unclear.
classical_check: Contradicts classical texts, where exalted Jupiter and Venus are generally auspicious, though Jupiter in the 7th of a woman's chart has mixed reports.

hindi: और सूर्य को के लिए बृहस्पति का भी दान दोगे वो सूर्य को ही जा रहा है इसलिए किसी हालत में भी सूर्य की चीज पत्नी को मत दो
says: Even if you donate Jupiter's things for the Sun's sake, they end up going to the Sun, so in no case give the Sun's things to the wife.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: झूठी रोटी भी पत्नी को खिलाओगे लड़ाई होगी पति को खिलाओगे तो भी लड़ाई होगी नमक नहीं देना।
says: Feeding leftover roti to the wife will cause a quarrel, and so will feeding it to the husband; also do not give salt.
ambiguity: 'Jhooti roti' means a half-eaten or leftover roti; 'namak nahin dena' could mean do not give salt to anyone or only to the spouse.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: ऊपर से नमक डाल के नहीं खाना। पका हुआ खा लो। लोग सलाद में डालते हैं। दही में डालते हैं। नेवर आपका सूर्य डिस्ट्रॉय हो रहा है। ऑटोमेटिकली कम होना शुरू होगा।
says: Do not sprinkle salt on top of food; eat what is already cooked, not salted salad or curd, because that destroys your Sun; stop it and the trouble starts reducing automatically.
ambiguity: 'Automatically start reducing' could refer to the Sun's trouble or to the salt habit.
classical_check: Silent; a diet restriction not in classical Sun remedies.

hindi: घर का आंगन खुला रखो। पीतल के बर्तन इस्तेमाल करो।
says: Keep the courtyard of the house open and use brass utensils.
classical_check: Open Brahmasthan is classical Vastu; brass is commonly linked to the Sun and Jupiter.

hindi: सूर्य नेवला है। सांप जो है वो शनि है।
says: The Sun is the mongoose and the snake is Saturn.
classical_check: Mongoose as the Sun is not classical; snake as Saturn or Rahu is common.

hindi: सांप को मारोगे शनि डाउन होगा। नेवले को मारोगे सूर्य डाउन होगा।
says: Killing a snake lowers Saturn and killing a mongoose lowers the Sun.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: वो अटैक मोड है। दोनों के बीच लड़ाई रहती है। पिता पुत्र हैं। अभी पिता पुत्र की क्लास होती है इसके अंदर। पर वो टाइम का अभाव है।
says: The two (Sun and Saturn, mongoose and snake) are in attack mode with constant fighting, as they are father and son; a father-son class would fit here but there is no time.
classical_check: Saturn as the son of the Sun and their enmity is classical.

hindi: पति किसी को जबरदस्ती समझाने बैठ गया। आपने उसको बेटा तू मेरे बेटे जैसा है। आपने शत्रु पैदा कर लिया। कोई बेटे जैसा नहीं है। बेटा भी बेटे जैसा नहीं है।
says: If someone sits down to lecture another by force, saying 'you are like my son', he has made an enemy; nobody is like a son, and even the son is not like a son.
ambiguity: 'Pati' (husband) here is probably 'a man' or 'father'; the caption is unclear.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: बेटा भी मेरा मित्र है। ये कहा जाता है बेटे को जब पांव बड़ा हो गया। पिता उसे मित्र माने मंगल बना ले। बेटा उसका गुलाम रहेगा सारी जिंदगी। कैसा? सेनापति वाला प्रेम से और शनि बना के रख।
says: When the son has grown up, the father should treat him as a friend and make him a Mars-type commander, and the son stays loyal for life through a commander's affection; the second half about making him Saturn is unclear.
ambiguity: Garbled: 'Shani bana ke rakh' (keep him as Saturn) contradicts the Mars idea or means keeping him as a disciplined subordinate.
classical_check: Silent; the 'friend after sixteen' idea echoes a Sanskrit proverb.

hindi: तू मेरा बेटा है। तो मेरे बेटे सुनता नहीं। बेटे से बेटे सुनने के लिए पैदा ही नहीं हुए। जो बाप यह कह रहा है बेटा सुनता नहीं उसने भी अपने बाप की नहीं सुनी है क्योंकि शनि सूर्य की सुनेगा ही नहीं अंधकार का देवता है
says: The complaint 'my son does not listen' is pointless since sons are not born to listen; the father making it did not listen to his own father either, because Saturn, god of darkness, will never listen to the Sun.
classical_check: Saturn as the Sun's son and rival is classical.

hindi: तो बेटे के सिर पे क्यों सवार हो रहा है बाप ये असंभव है इसलिए बाप बेटे की बन नहीं सकती बाप डराने के काम आता है प्यार करने के लिए मां होती है
says: So there is no point in the father riding on the son's head; a father and son cannot get on, the father serves to frighten while the mother is there for love.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: वो रखा होता है ना बेटा पापा से कह दूंगी तो पापा नहीं है वो पापी है उसको प्यार कहां से मिलेगा तो इसीलिए वो प्यार को रोता रहता है पुरुष पर अब यही समस्या है पुरुष होने की
says: A mother threatens 'I will tell your father', so the father becomes a sinner instead of a papa and gets no love; hence the man keeps crying for love, which is the problem of being male.
ambiguity: Contains a pun on 'papa' and 'paapi' (sinner); the thread is loose.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: पुरुष जो है स्टेबल है क्रिया करने वाली स्त्री है।
says: The male principle is stable and still; it is the female principle that acts.
classical_check: Purusha as passive witness and prakriti as active is Samkhya and agrees with the Sun-not-moving idea.

gist: Notices he has drifted from the topic ('where are we going').
Viewer asks: naval breathing is one way to move to the upper chakra, is there another technique?

hindi: ऊपर के चक्कर में जाने के लिए ऊपर ऐसे लटक के करो। पुश अप्स करो। वो ठीक हो जाएगा।
says: To move energy up into the upper chakras, hang from a bar like this and do push-ups, and it will get right.
ambiguity: The chakra meant is not named, nor is the planet; a physical-exercise tip.
classical_check: Silent; not a jyotish remedy.

gist: Says there are many more matters beyond this, and a viewer calls the class beautiful, long and detailed; they will see again.
Closing: with everyone's blessings classes on the Sun, Mars and others will be extended; ends today's class and thanks everyone for the long time and patience.
Quips that his own Sun is set now and he will set the viewers' too, so no worry; final thanks and namaste, music.
Closing chanting of Om with background music.
Closing chanting of Om with background music continues.
Last 'Om'.
